title: Does a weak social safety net hold back private consumption in China?
affiliations: Peterson Institute for International Economics

detail.title: Does a weak social safety net hold back private consumption in China?

publicationDetails.detailsText: Peterson Institute for International Economics Policy Brief 25-7
publicationDetails.journalName: Peterson Institute for International Economics (PIIE) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Many experts see China’s economy as constrained because of a weak social safety net, especially the retirement system, resulting in anemic domestic consumption spending. This view is out of date. Recent data indicate that China has expanded many parts of its social safety net and that consumption spending has accelerated. Social expenditures in China have more than doubled as a share of GDP since 2010 and are on par with Mexico and Turkey. But given China’s aging population, safety net spending and domestic consumption spending will need to expand further to put China’s economy on a more sustainable path. The latest data should clear the cobwebs of misunderstanding that have led to both complacency and unnecessary alarm about China’s economic prospects among observers in the United States and other countries. China’s government is hardly unaware of the importance of stronger household consumption and has announced policies to increase consumer spending, including more generous pension benefits for farmers and rural migrant workers. If these initiatives are implemented, the growth of household consumption is likely to accelerate.

AI.tldr: 该论文挑战了关于中国经济的传统观点，认为中国社会保障体系已显著改善，消费支出正在加速，但面对人口老龄化仍需进一步扩大社会保障支出和国内消费。
AI.research_question: 中国社会保障体系的改善如何影响国内消费支出？面对人口老龄化，中国需要采取哪些措施来促进更可持续的经济增长？
AI.motivation: 许多专家认为中国因社会保障体系薄弱导致国内消费不足，但这一观点已经过时。论文旨在澄清误解，展示中国社会保障的实际进展及其对消费的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会保障与消费关系理论、人口老龄化对经济影响理论、可持续经济发展理论
AI.method: 基于最新数据的实证分析，比较中国与其他国家（如墨西哥、土耳其）的社会支出占GDP比例，追踪消费支出趋势变化
AI.findings: 1. 中国社会保障支出自2010年以来占GDP比例已翻倍，与墨西哥、土耳其相当；2. 消费支出正在加速；3. 但面对人口老龄化，仍需进一步扩大社会保障和消费支出
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 挑战了关于中国社会保障薄弱导致消费不足的传统观点；2. 提供了中国社会保障体系实际进展的实证证据；3. 构建了人口老龄化背景下社会保障与消费关系的分析框架
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 澄清国际观察家对中国经济前景的误解；2. 为中国政府已宣布的提高农民和农民工养老金等政策提供支持；3. 指出未来需要进一步扩大社会保障支出以促进可持续经济增长

title: Open-Source Civil Law (OSCL): A Protocol Framework for Collaborative Legal Evolution

detail.title: Open-Source Civil Law (OSCL): A Protocol Framework for Collaborative Legal Evolution

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced the research, analysis, or conclusions of this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, personal data, or experimental intervention and therefore did not require ethics committee approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency, commercial entity, or not-for-profit organization.

detail.abstract:
Contemporary civil law relies heavily on private ordering to determine the substantive content of social and economic relationships. Yet the institutional environment in which this private norm production occurs is fragmented, opaque, and structurally incapable of evolving at the pace demanded by modern life. Statutory law changes slowly, while powerful private actors fill the resulting vacuum through standard-form contracts that function as de facto legislation. This asymmetry concentrates rule-making authority in the hands of parties with disproportionate bargaining power and prevents society from collectively improving the normative architectures that govern everyday relationships.

This paper introduces Open-Source Civil Law (OSCL) as a protocol-based framework that reconciles the adaptability of private ordering with the stability of public law. OSCL reconceptualizes civil law as a multi-layered system consisting of a state-controlled kernel of mandatory rules, a collaboratively governed protocol layer of modular legal components, and an application layer of private agreements that import and extend these components. Drawing on principles from open-source software development, semantic versioning, and distributed governance, OSCL supplies the infrastructure for transparent, auditable, and collectively refined evolution of civil norms.

The framework does not replace state authority; it formalizes the interface between autonomy and public oversight, enabling legal systems to evolve with greater granularity and responsiveness. By transforming private-law rule-making from a fragmented and asymmetric practice into a collaborative, versioned, and openly governed process, OSCL democratizes the production of civil norms and offers a new model for institutional innovation. The result is a structural blueprint for an “institutional GitHub,” through which society can continuously refine the legal architectures that shape its relationships.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"开源民法"(OSCL)框架，将民法重新概念化为多层系统，结合私人定制的灵活性与公共法律的稳定性，通过开源协作模式实现民法规范的透明、可审计和集体演进。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个框架，既能保持私人定制的灵活性，又能确保公共法律的稳定性，同时解决当前民法制度中规范制定权不对称、演进缓慢的问题？
AI.motivation: 当前民法制度严重依赖私人定制来确定社会和经济关系的实质内容，但规范产生的制度环境碎片化、不透明，无法跟上现代生活的节奏。法定法律变化缓慢，而强大的私人行为者通过标准格式合同填补真空，这些合同实际上起到了立法作用。这种不对称将规则制定权集中在具有不成比例议价能力的当事人手中，阻碍了社会集体改进治理日常关系的规范架构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 开源民法(OSCL)框架，借鉴开源软件开发、语义版本控制和分布式治理原则，将民法重新概念化为三层系统：1)国家控制的强制性规则内核；2)协作治理的模块化法律组件协议层；3)导入和扩展这些组件的私人协议应用层。
AI.method: 概念性框架设计方法，基于开源软件开发和分布式治理的理论原则，构建一个协议驱动的制度创新模型。
AI.findings: OSCL框架能够将民法规范制定从碎片化和不对称的实践转变为协作、版本控制和开放治理的过程，为法律系统提供更精细和响应性更强的演进能力，同时不取代国家权威。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出开源民法(OSCL)作为新的理论框架；2) 将民法重新概念化为多层系统；3) 将开源软件开发原则应用于法律系统设计；4) 提出"制度GitHub"的概念模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为法律系统提供透明、可审计和集体精炼的演进基础设施；2) 民主化民法规范的生产过程；3) 为制度创新提供新的结构蓝图；4) 正式化自治与公共监督之间的接口。

title: High Cost of Decarbonization in the Transport Industry
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: High Cost of Decarbonization in the Transport Industry
detail.abstract: Decarbonizing the transport sector is a central pillar of modern climate policy, yet full electrification of heavy-duty commercial fleets remains financially and operationally prohibitive in the near term. Current analyses estimate that upgrading the U.S. commercial vehicle fleet with high-power charging infrastructure, substations, and grid enhancements will require investments in the hundreds of billions of dollars, with per-vehicle infrastructure costs reaching tens or even hundreds of thousands. These barriers—combined with long deployment timelines and operational limitations of electric and hydrogen technologies—create a significant risk of delayed climate benefits. This case study examines FuelWell, a plug-and-play catalytic system that enhances combustion efficiency in existing internal-combustion engines, reducing fuel consumption by 10–20% without requiring engine modifications or infrastructure updates. Field and laboratory data show annual savings of 6,000–12,000 USD and 20–40 tons of CO₂ per truck, with payback periods from several months to under one year. Scaled to fleets of thousands of vehicles, the technology offers immediate, low-CAPEX emissions reductions in the order of millions of tons of CO₂ annually, complementing long-term electrification strategies. Positioned as a transitional measure, FuelWell enables rapid environmental gains, mitigates cost and grid-capacity challenges, and provides a pragmatic pathway for accelerating national decarbonization while long-horizon infrastructure projects mature.

AI.tldr: FuelWell催化系统通过提升现有内燃机燃烧效率，在不改造发动机或基础设施的情况下减少10-20%燃料消耗，为重型商用车队提供低成本、快速部署的过渡性减排方案，弥补长期电气化战略的不足。
AI.research_question: 在重型商用车队全面电气化面临高昂成本和基础设施挑战的背景下，如何通过过渡性技术实现快速、低成本的碳排放减少？
AI.motivation: 重型商用车队电气化需要数百亿美元的基础设施投资，每辆车基础设施成本高达数万甚至数十万美元，加上部署时间长、电动和氢能技术操作限制，导致气候效益延迟风险。需要寻找快速部署的过渡方案。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 过渡技术理论：在长期解决方案成熟前，采用低成本、快速部署的过渡技术实现即时减排
2. 燃烧效率优化理论：通过催化系统提升内燃机燃烧效率，减少燃料消耗和排放
3. 成本效益分析框架：评估技术投资回报期和规模化减排潜力
AI.method: 案例研究方法，结合实地测试和实验室数据分析FuelWell系统的性能。收集燃料消耗、成本节约和CO₂减排数据，计算投资回报期，并模拟规模化应用效果。
AI.findings:
1. FuelWell系统减少10-20%燃料消耗，无需发动机改造或基础设施更新
2. 每辆车年节约6,000-12,000美元，减排20-40吨CO₂
3. 投资回报期从几个月到一年以内
4. 规模化到数千辆车队，年减排量可达数百万吨CO₂
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出过渡性减排技术框架，填补长期电气化战略与即时减排需求之间的理论空白
2. 扩展燃烧效率优化理论在现有内燃机改造中的应用
3. 建立低成本快速部署减排技术的评估模型
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为重型商用车队提供即插即用的减排解决方案，降低CAPEX投资
2. 缓解电网容量和基础设施投资压力
3. 加速国家脱碳进程，在长期基础设施项目成熟前实现环境效益
4. 为企业提供可快速实施的减排途径，平衡环保目标与运营成本

title: Investment universe-level returns to scale and active fund management
affiliations: NHH Norwegian School of Economics

detail.title: Investment universe-level returns to scale and active fund management

publicationDetails.detailsText: NHH Dept. of Business and Management Science Discussion Paper No. 2025/14
publicationDetails.journalName: Norwegian School of Economics, Department of Business & Management Science Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Research shows that competition negatively impacts fund alpha. I derive that fund managers can counteract this impact by adjusting the level of active management. In an international sample, I find that the impact of competition in funds' investment universe depends on its source: funds face decreasing returns to the total size of active funds and increasing returns to the total size of passive funds. This implies that managers should increase active management when passive fund competition rises and reduce it when active fund competition increases. Empirical evidence suggests that managers adjust only to changes in competition from passive funds.

AI.tldr: 研究发现竞争对基金阿尔法有负面影响，基金经理可通过调整主动管理程度来应对。国际样本显示，竞争影响取决于来源：主动基金总规模带来递减回报，被动基金总规模带来递增回报。这意味着当被动基金竞争加剧时应增加主动管理，主动基金竞争加剧时应减少主动管理。实证证据表明基金经理只对被动基金竞争变化做出调整。
AI.research_question: 基金经理如何通过调整主动管理程度来应对不同类型的竞争（主动基金vs被动基金）对基金阿尔法的影响？
AI.motivation: 现有研究表明竞争对基金阿尔法有负面影响，但缺乏对竞争来源（主动基金vs被动基金）的区分，以及基金经理如何通过调整主动管理策略来应对不同类型竞争的研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于竞争对基金绩效影响的理论，区分主动基金竞争和被动基金竞争的不同机制，以及主动管理调整作为应对策略的理论框架。
AI.method: 使用国际样本的实证分析，检验主动基金总规模和被动基金总规模对基金回报的不同影响，并分析基金经理对竞争变化的调整行为。
AI.findings: 1. 竞争影响取决于来源：主动基金总规模带来递减回报，被动基金总规模带来递增回报；2. 理论上基金经理应在被动基金竞争加剧时增加主动管理，在主动基金竞争加剧时减少主动管理；3. 实证上基金经理只对被动基金竞争变化做出调整。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 区分了主动基金竞争和被动基金竞争的不同影响机制；2. 提出了基金经理通过调整主动管理程度应对不同类型竞争的理论框架；3. 丰富了基金竞争与绩效关系的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为基金经理提供了针对不同类型竞争的策略建议；2. 帮助投资者理解基金竞争环境对绩效的影响；3. 为基金公司制定竞争策略提供实证依据。

title: The Veiled Dolorosa of Mariano Madriñan: Uncovering Paete's Footprints in International Exhibitions
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Veiled Dolorosa of Mariano Madriñan: Uncovering Paete's Footprints in International Exhibitions

detail.abstract: This paper investigates the enduring enigma surrounding a Virgen Dolorosa sculpture attributed to Filipino master carver Mariano Madriñan in the late nineteenth century. Drawing upon archival catalogues, travel observations, and museum inquiries conducted in Madrid, Spain, the study examines whether the Virgen Dolorosa reportedly displayed at the Museo Nacional de Antropología corresponds to Madriñan's celebrated Mater Dolorosa. By analyzing discrepancies between historical accounts of the 1883 Amsterdam Exposition and the verified participation of the Philippines in the Exposición General de las Islas Filipinas (Madrid, 1887), this study argues that the Dolorosa listed under the Subcomisión Provincial de Santa Cruz may in fact be Madriñan's work. The findings underscore the importance of reassessing archival records, addressing cataloguing errors, and filling gaps in the historiography of Philippine art in international exhibitions.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过分析档案目录、旅行观察和马德里博物馆调查，探讨了菲律宾雕刻大师Mariano Madriñan在19世纪末创作的Virgen Dolorosa雕塑的身份之谜，认为马德里国家人类学博物馆的藏品可能是Madriñan的作品。
AI.research_question: 马德里国家人类学博物馆展出的Virgen Dolorosa雕塑是否确实是菲律宾雕刻大师Mariano Madriñan在19世纪末创作的著名Mater Dolorosa作品？
AI.motivation: 解决菲律宾艺术史中关于Madriñan的Virgen Dolorosa雕塑身份和下落的长久谜团，填补菲律宾艺术在国际展览中的历史空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 艺术史研究、档案学、博物馆学、殖民时期艺术交流理论、菲律宾艺术在国际展览中的历史地位研究。
AI.method: 档案目录分析、旅行观察记录研究、马德里博物馆调查、历史档案对比分析（特别是1883年阿姆斯特丹博览会和1887年马德里菲律宾群岛博览会的记录对比）。
AI.findings: 研究发现，Santa Cruz省分委员会列出的Dolorosa很可能是Madriñan的作品；揭示了1883年阿姆斯特丹博览会历史记载与1887年马德里菲律宾群岛博览会实际参与情况之间的差异；指出了档案记录中的分类错误。
AI.theory_contributions: 为菲律宾殖民时期艺术史研究提供了新的档案证据；提出了重新评估档案记录的方法论框架；丰富了菲律宾艺术在国际展览中的历史叙事。
AI.practical_contributions: 为博物馆藏品鉴定和分类提供指导；帮助纠正菲律宾艺术史中的记录错误；为未来菲律宾艺术研究提供档案研究范例；促进菲律宾文化遗产的保护和认知。

title: A Critical Analysis of Republic Act No. 10173: The Data Privacy Act of 2012
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: A Critical Analysis of Republic Act No. 10173: The Data Privacy Act of 2012
detail.abstract: This paper provides a critical analysis of Republic Act No. 10173, also known as the Data Privacy Act of 2012. The Act aims to protect personal information in both the public and private sectors, ensuring that individuals' rights to privacy are upheld in the digital age. This critique examines the key provisions, highlighting the strengths and weaknesses of the law, and explores its social, economic, and organizational implications. Additionally, specific recommendations are offered to enhance its effectiveness and enforcement. The paper concludes that while RA 10173 represents a significant step toward data protection in the Philippines, there remains room for improvement in clarity, accessibility, and enforcement mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本文对菲律宾2012年《数据隐私法》(RA 10173)进行批判性分析，评估其保护个人信息的条款、优缺点及社会、经济、组织影响，并提出改进建议。
AI.research_question: 菲律宾《数据隐私法》(RA 10173)在保护个人隐私方面的有效性如何？其条款存在哪些优缺点？如何改进该法律的实施效果？
AI.motivation: 随着数字时代个人数据收集和处理日益普遍，菲律宾需要有效的法律框架来保护公民隐私权。RA 10173作为重要立法，其实施效果和影响需要系统评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数据隐私权理论、个人信息保护法律框架、监管有效性理论、数字时代隐私权保护理论。
AI.method: 批判性法律分析、条款审查、优缺点评估、社会-经济-组织影响分析、比较法分析。
AI.findings: RA 10173是菲律宾数据保护的重要进步，但存在条款模糊、可及性不足、执行机制薄弱等问题，在社会、经济和组织层面产生复杂影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 为发展中国家数据隐私立法研究提供案例，丰富了数字时代隐私权保护理论在东南亚语境下的应用，提出了法律清晰度与执行力的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为菲律宾政府提供具体的法律修订建议，帮助企业更好地遵守数据隐私规定，为公民提供隐私保护指南，为其他发展中国家数据立法提供参考。

title: Employment Impacts of the CHIPS Act
affiliations: Northeastern University (USA), Columbia University - Columbia Business School, Finance and Columbia University - School of International & Public Affairs (SIPA)

detail.title: Employment Impacts of the CHIPS Act

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: The CHIPS and Science Act, enacted in August 2022, is a key element of the revival of U.S. industrial policy. We examine the short-term employment effects of the act. Drawing on quarterly industry-by-county data from the Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages (QCEW), we implement two county-level difference-in-difference designs, the first comparing counties with pre-existing semiconductor facilities to other counties with high-tech industries and the second comparing counties with semiconductor fabrication facilities (which were targeted for the bulk of the CHIPS funding) to counties with non-fabrication semiconductor facilities. Using both approaches, we find robust, positive employment impacts in affected counties. The effects began at the time of the passage in the Senate of a precursor bill, in anticipation of the signing of the CHIPS Act. Our preferred estimates suggest an increase of 110 jobs per affected county in the first design and 180 jobs per affected county in the second design. Simple back-of-the-envelope calculations suggest national direct employment effects of approximately 15,000-16,000 jobs in the core semiconductor sector and indirect effects of 28,000-35,000 jobs in related sectors.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了《芯片与科学法案》的短期就业效应，发现法案对受影响县份产生了积极的就业影响，核心半导体部门直接创造约15,000-16,000个工作岗位，相关产业间接创造28,000-35,000个工作岗位。
AI.research_question: 《芯片与科学法案》对短期就业产生了怎样的影响？
AI.motivation: 《芯片与科学法案》作为美国产业政策复兴的关键举措，其经济影响特别是就业效应需要实证评估，以了解产业政策在促进就业方面的实际效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 产业政策理论、就业创造理论、区域经济发展理论，以及基于预期效应的政策影响分析框架。
AI.method: 使用季度就业和工资普查（QCEW）的行业-县季度数据，采用两种县级双重差分设计：1）比较已有半导体设施县与高科技产业县；2）比较半导体制造设施县与非制造半导体设施县。
AI.findings: 研究发现法案对受影响县份产生了稳健的积极就业影响，效应在参议院通过前驱法案时已开始显现。第一种设计显示每县增加110个工作岗位，第二种设计显示每县增加180个工作岗位。全国直接就业效应约15,000-16,000个核心半导体工作岗位，间接效应28,000-35,000个相关产业工作岗位。
AI.theory_contributions: 为产业政策的就业效应提供了实证证据，验证了预期效应在政策实施前的重要性，丰富了产业政策评估的方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了《芯片与科学法案》就业影响的量化评估，有助于未来产业政策设计，为地方政府了解政策效应提供参考。

title: Case Study: Orbital Improvisation Under Fire -The Shenzhou-20/21 Crew Swap and Its Ripple Effects on Tiangong Operations

detail.title: Case Study: Orbital Improvisation Under Fire -The Shenzhou-20/21 Crew Swap and Its Ripple Effects on Tiangong Operations
detail.abstract: Picture this: You're 400 kilometers above Earth, your ride home's got a hairline fracture from a speck of cosmic shrapnel, and the clock's ticking on your oxygen and sanity. That's the nail-biter China Manned Space Agency (CMSA) faced in November 2025 with the Shenzhou-20 mission. What started as a routine six-month stint on the Tiangong space station turned into the first-ever in-orbit crew vehicle swap due to space debris damage. Drawing on real-time CMSA releases, crew debriefs, and orbital telemetry analyses, this case unpacks the incident's anatomy-from the "tiny cracks" in the return capsule to today's successful docking of the emergency Shenzhou-22 lifeboat, prepared in a blistering 16-day crash program We spotlight the human ingenuity behind it: pre-baked redundancies, lightning-fast decision loops, and a handover "sprint" that kept science rolling amid chaos. Lessons? In megaprojects-from space stations to megadams-treat debris (literal or figurative) as a feature, not a bug. This isn't just aerospace arcana; it's a blueprint for any team staring down black swans. Implications for PM practitioners: Bake in modularity early, rehearse the unthinkable, and remember-resilience isn't about avoiding storms, it's dancing in them.

AI.tldr: 中国载人航天工程在2025年11月面临神舟-20号任务返回舱被太空碎片损坏的紧急情况，通过16天紧急准备神舟-22号救援飞船，成功实施首次在轨乘员飞船更换，展现了危机管理中的模块化设计和应急响应能力。
AI.research_question: 在太空任务中，当主要返回舱因太空碎片损坏而无法安全返回时，如何通过紧急救援机制和模块化设计实现乘员安全转移和任务连续性？
AI.motivation: 太空碎片威胁日益严重，载人航天任务面临前所未有的安全挑战。神舟-20号任务事件为研究极端条件下的项目管理、应急响应和系统韧性提供了独特案例。
AI.theoretical_framework: 危机管理理论、黑天鹅事件理论、模块化设计理论、系统韧性理论、项目管理中的冗余设计原则。
AI.method: 案例研究方法，基于中国载人航天工程实时发布信息、乘员任务报告和轨道遥测分析，解剖事件全过程。
AI.findings: 1. 太空碎片造成的微小裂缝足以威胁返回舱安全；2. 16天紧急准备救援飞船的可行性；3. 在轨飞船更换技术的成功实施；4. 模块化设计和预置冗余在危机中的关键作用；5. 科学实验在危机中得以持续。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了极端环境下项目管理理论；2. 验证了模块化设计在危机响应中的有效性；3. 提出了"将碎片（字面或比喻）视为特征而非缺陷"的新视角；4. 丰富了系统韧性理论在太空工程中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为载人航天任务提供应急响应模板；2. 强调早期模块化设计的重要性；3. 提倡"预演不可想象情况"的训练方法；4. 为大型工程项目（如大坝、基础设施）提供风险管理借鉴；5. 展示快速决策循环在危机中的价值。

title: Design And Implementation of a Network Protocol for Real-Time Multiplayer Chess Game
affiliations: Vishwakarma Institute of Technology, Vishwakarma Institute of Technology, Vishwakarma Institute of Technology, Vishwakarma Institute of Technology, Vishwakarma Institute of Technology and Vishwakarma Institute of Technology

detail.title: Design And Implementation of a Network Protocol for Real-Time Multiplayer Chess Game
detail.abstract: This project presents the design, implementation, and validation of a custom-built, open-source, protocol focused on efficiency, reliability and simplicity. The protocol is designed to work within a client server architecture ensuring security, synchronization and scalability. The protocol operates over TCP (Transmission control protocol) leveraging its in-order delivery and retransmission guarantees to maintain synchronization without the need for custom reliability mechanisms. Evaluation of the protocol demonstrated that it can achieve about 70% reduction in network usage compared to text based representations and can maintain client synchronization even with simulated 5% packet loss and network delays. The proposed protocol provides an open, extensible alternative to existing proprietary systems and establishes a foundation for future standardization of multiplayer chess communication. Its combination of compact data encoding using bit-board encoding , reliable message delivery relying on TCP's retransmission, and concurrent design using concurrent util provided by java's utility package makes it a robust and efficient framework for scalable, real-time competitive play.

AI.tldr: 本文设计并实现了一个开源、高效、可靠的客户端-服务器协议，专为实时多人象棋游戏设计。该协议利用TCP的可靠传输特性，通过位棋盘编码减少70%网络流量，在5%丢包和网络延迟下仍能保持客户端同步，为多人象棋通信提供了可扩展的标准化基础。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个高效、可靠、可扩展的开源协议来支持实时多人象棋游戏的客户端-服务器通信？
AI.motivation: 现有专有系统缺乏开放性和可扩展性，需要建立一个标准化的多人象棋通信协议基础。文本表示的网络使用效率低下，需要更紧凑的数据编码方式。同时需要确保在不可靠网络环境下的客户端同步和实时竞争性游戏体验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 客户端-服务器架构理论、TCP可靠传输协议、位棋盘编码理论、并发编程理论、网络协议设计原则
AI.method: 1. 协议设计与实现：基于TCP构建客户端-服务器架构；2. 数据编码：采用位棋盘编码压缩游戏状态；3. 可靠性机制：依赖TCP的按序交付和重传保证；4. 并发设计：使用Java并发工具包；5. 验证测试：模拟5%丢包和网络延迟环境下的性能评估
AI.findings: 1. 网络使用减少70%：相比基于文本的表示；2. 强健的同步能力：在5%模拟丢包和网络延迟下仍能保持客户端同步；3. 协议效率高：结合紧凑编码、可靠传输和并发设计；4. 可扩展性好：为未来标准化奠定基础
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了基于TCP的多人游戏协议设计范式，避免自定义可靠性机制；2. 建立了位棋盘编码在实时游戏通信中的应用理论；3. 为开源游戏协议标准化提供了理论基础；4. 验证了并发设计在实时游戏服务器中的有效性
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供了开源、可扩展的多人象棋通信协议实现；2. 显著降低网络带宽需求，提升游戏性能；3. 在不可靠网络环境下保证游戏同步性；4. 为游戏开发者提供了替代专有系统的开放方案；5. 建立了未来多人象棋通信标准化的实践基础

title: SIRX™ -Systemic Influence & Resilience Index. Neurobehavioral Architecture of Corporate and Institutional Trustworthiness Under Strategic Uncertainty

detail.title: SIRX™ -Systemic Influence & Resilience Index. Neurobehavioral Architecture of Corporate and Institutional Trustworthiness Under Strategic Uncertainty

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper. This research was conducted independently, without external funding, sponsorship, or institutional affiliation that could bias the results. All analyses and interpretations represent the author’s own scientific and professional conclusions.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The research involved non-interventional, naturalistic social observation without collection of personal data. Ethical approval was not required in accordance with international research standards for non-invasive studies.
declarations.funderStatement: This study was fully self-funded by the author. No external financial support or institutional sponsorship was received.

detail.abstract: Complex corporate and governmental systems operate in environments where the velocity of change surpasses human cognitive limits. This makes human influence a primary source of strategic uncertainty. Most organizational failures emerge not from external shocks but from behavioral instability of individuals working under high dynamics and overload. Existing assessment frameworks capture declarative characteristics yet fail to measure the capacity to maintain systemic architecture when exposed to real managerial pressure. SIRX™-the Systemic Influence & Resilience Index-establishes a scientifically grounded neurobehavioral standard derived from the Psychoeconomic Resilience Model (PRM) and oriented toward the objective verification of human influence as a systemic variable. The index predicts behavioral patterns under overload without touching personal, value-based, or legally protected characteristics. SIRX™ creates an infrastructure of influence-driven reliability required by corporations and states to reduce risk and enhance controllability.

AI.tldr: SIRX™（系统性影响与韧性指数）是一个基于神经行为科学的评估框架，用于在高压动态环境中预测个体行为模式，而不涉及个人价值观或受法律保护的特征，旨在提升组织可靠性和可控性。
AI.research_question: 如何科学地评估和预测在高速变化、认知超载环境下个体的行为稳定性，以降低组织战略不确定性？
AI.motivation: 现代复杂组织面临的变化速度超过人类认知极限，人类行为成为战略不确定性的主要来源。现有评估框架只能捕捉陈述性特征，无法衡量在真实管理压力下维持系统架构的能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 心理经济韧性模型（Psychoeconomic Resilience Model, PRM），将人类影响作为系统性变量进行客观验证。
AI.method: 开发SIRX™指数，基于神经行为科学标准，预测超载条件下的行为模式，不涉及个人、价值观或法律保护特征。
AI.findings: SIRX™建立了科学基础的神经行为标准，能够预测超载下的行为模式，为企业和国家创建影响驱动的可靠性基础设施。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将人类影响概念化为可测量的系统性变量；2. 建立基于PRM的神经行为评估框架；3. 填补现有评估框架在动态压力下行为稳定性测量方面的空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业和国家提供降低风险、增强可控性的工具；2. 创建影响驱动的可靠性基础设施；3. 在不侵犯个人隐私的情况下预测行为模式，提高组织韧性。

title: The Attention-Driven Phillips Curve: Rational Inattention, Policy Errors, and Microfounded Welfare
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Attention-Driven Phillips Curve: Rational Inattention, Policy Errors, and Microfounded Welfare
detail.abstract: This paper demonstrates that ignoring firms' rational inattention to competing inflation drivers generates systematic policy errors and microfounded welfare losses. We develop a New Keynesian model where firms allocate limited attention across supply, financial, and structural inflation drivers, yielding a Phillips Curve with endogenously time-varying weights. We derive the social welfare function from household preferences and prove that using a fixed-weight Phillips Curve creates quadratic welfare losses during attention reallocations. Empirically, we estimate the model on 15 advanced economies (1990-2024) using the Global Financial Cycle for identification. The structural model outperforms benchmarks, particularly during attention shifts, and counterfactual analysis shows welfare losses of 15-30% during crises. Our results provide a rigorous justification for incorporating attention reallocation in monetary policy models.

AI.tldr: 本文证明忽略企业对竞争性通胀驱动因素的理性疏忽会导致系统性政策错误和微观基础化的福利损失。我们开发了一个新凯恩斯模型，企业将有限注意力分配到供给、金融和结构性通胀驱动因素上，产生具有内生时变权重的菲利普斯曲线。我们推导出基于家庭偏好的社会福利函数，并证明使用固定权重菲利普斯曲线在注意力重新分配期间会产生二次福利损失。实证上，我们使用全球金融周期作为识别工具，在15个发达经济体（1990-2024年）上估计模型。结构模型优于基准模型，特别是在注意力转移期间，反事实分析显示危机期间福利损失达15-30%。
AI.research_question: 忽略企业对竞争性通胀驱动因素的理性疏忽如何影响货币政策效果和社会福利？
AI.motivation: 传统货币政策模型通常假设企业对通胀驱动因素有固定关注模式，但现实中企业面临信息处理约束，需要在不同通胀驱动因素（供给、金融、结构性）之间分配有限注意力。这种注意力分配会随时间变化，忽略这一现实可能导致系统性政策错误。
AI.theoretical_framework: 新凯恩斯主义框架结合理性疏忽理论，企业面临信息处理约束，需要在供给、金融和结构性通胀驱动因素之间分配有限注意力，产生具有内生时变权重的菲利普斯曲线。
AI.method: 理论模型开发：构建包含理性疏忽的新凯恩斯模型；实证估计：使用全球金融周期作为识别工具，在15个发达经济体（1990-2024年）上估计结构模型；反事实分析：比较结构模型与固定权重基准模型的性能。
AI.findings: 1. 结构模型优于基准模型，特别是在注意力转移期间；2. 使用固定权重菲利普斯曲线在注意力重新分配期间会产生二次福利损失；3. 反事实分析显示危机期间福利损失达15-30%。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将理性疏忽理论整合到新凯恩斯模型中；2. 推导出具有内生时变权重的菲利普斯曲线；3. 从家庭偏好推导社会福利函数，证明固定权重模型的福利损失性质。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为货币政策模型纳入注意力重新分配提供严格理论依据；2. 量化忽略注意力转移的福利成本；3. 提供改进货币政策设计的实证证据。

title: Delay-and-Pay: Prolonging Pharmaceutical Patent Protection Without Paying the “Price”
affiliations: University of Oxford - Faculty of Law

detail.title: Delay-and-Pay: Prolonging Pharmaceutical Patent Protection Without Paying the “Price”
detail.abstract: This article argues that actors use the patent system as part of a “delay-and-pay” strategy to preserve drug prices for as long as possible by delaying generic/biosimilar market entry – and that they have a significant financial incentive to do so. This strategy is based on the notion that it is much more profitable for patentees to delay generic/biosimilar market entry by way of a patent infringement claim and ensuing injunction, then pay damages to the enjoined party should the infringement claim be defeated. Indeed, patentees have much to gain and little to lose under “delay-and-pay”. My analysis establishes that the money national health bodies  spent purchasing the more expensive, patented drug whilst the interim injunction remained in effect is not usually compensated following a patent revocation and discharged injunction. That is neither just, nor fair: the losses of national health bodies ought to be recovered.

AI.tldr: 本文认为制药公司利用专利系统实施"延迟-支付"策略，通过专利侵权诉讼和临时禁令延迟仿制药/生物类似药上市，以维持高价药品销售。即使最终专利被撤销，制药公司也只需支付有限赔偿，而国家医保机构在此期间购买高价药的成本通常无法获得补偿。
AI.research_question: 专利系统如何被用于"延迟-支付"策略来维持药品高价？这种策略对国家医保机构造成的不公平损失应如何解决？
AI.motivation: 制药公司通过专利侵权诉讼获取临时禁令，延迟仿制药竞争，即使最终专利无效也只需支付有限赔偿，而国家医保机构在此期间购买高价药的成本无法获得补偿，这种不公平现象需要关注。
AI.theoretical_framework: 专利战略理论、药品定价经济学、临时禁令法律分析、损害赔偿计算框架
AI.method: 法律分析、经济分析、案例研究、损害赔偿计算模型
AI.findings: 1. 专利持有人通过"延迟-支付"策略获得巨大经济利益；2. 临时禁令期间国家医保机构购买高价药的成本通常无法获得补偿；3. 现有法律体系对专利持有人有利，对国家医保机构不公平
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"延迟-支付"策略的理论框架，揭示了专利系统被滥用的新机制，为药品专利战略研究提供了新视角
AI.practical_contributions: 建议改革专利损害赔偿制度，确保国家医保机构的损失得到补偿，为政策制定者提供改进药品定价和专利执法的具体建议

title: The Islamic Governance and Secular State (Philosophical Tensions and Practical Possibilities)
affiliations: Superior University

detail.title: The Islamic Governance and Secular State (Philosophical Tensions and Practical Possibilities)
detail.abstract:
This article looks at how a modern secular state and an Islamic system of government interact. It focuses on the clashes that happen when God’s laws meet modern human reasoning, and also explores ways the two might work together.

Secularism is based on Enlightenment thinking; values human freedom, logical decision-making, and keeping the government neutral toward religion. Islamic governance, on the other hand, sees political power as a sacred duty (amanah) guided by God’s law (Shari‘ah – شریعت) and aimed at creating justice (‘adl – عدل) and public good (maslahah – مصلحہ).

Because of these differences, people continue to debate what makes a government truly legitimate, how religion should be part of public life, and what concepts like freedom and justice really mean.
This study looks at both classical Muslim thinkers; like al-Mawardi and Ibn Khaldun and modern reformers such as Fazlur Rahman and Abdullahi an-Na‘im. It argues that Islam and secularism don’t have to be in conflict. By examining countries like Turkey, Indonesia, Malaysia, and Tunisia, the study shows how mixed political systems have emerged ones that combine modern secular institutions with Islamic moral values. These examples prove that both approaches can work together when politics is built on shared ethics, mutual compromise, and an understanding of Shari‘ah’s broader goals (maqasid al-shari‘ah).

Ultimately, the paper proposes that secularism and Islamic governance should not be viewed as adversarial systems but as complementary moral frameworks that pursue justice and human dignity through distinct yet intersecting paths. For Muslim-majority societies, the real challenge lies not in choosing between religion and modernity, but in crafting political systems that uphold both spiritual integrity and civic liberty a goal attainable through sustained philosophical engagement, institutional innovation, and moral resolve.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨现代世俗国家与伊斯兰治理体系的互动关系，分析两者在神法与人理之间的冲突，并探索两者可能的合作路径。通过研究土耳其、印尼、马来西亚和突尼斯等案例，论文展示了结合现代世俗制度与伊斯兰道德价值的混合政治体系，认为两者可作为互补的道德框架共同追求正义与人类尊严。
AI.research_question: 现代世俗国家与伊斯兰治理体系如何互动？两者在神法与人理冲突的情况下能否找到合作路径？
AI.motivation: 世俗主义基于启蒙思想，强调人类自由、理性决策和政府宗教中立；而伊斯兰治理将政治权力视为神圣责任，受神法指导，旨在实现正义与公共利益。两者在政府合法性、宗教在公共生活中的角色、自由与正义概念等方面存在根本差异，引发持续辩论。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 世俗主义理论：基于启蒙思想，强调人类自由、理性决策、政府宗教中立
2. 伊斯兰治理理论：政治权力作为神圣责任（amanah），受神法（Shari'ah）指导，追求正义（'adl）和公共利益（maslahah）
3. 古典穆斯林思想家理论：如al-Mawardi和Ibn Khaldun
4. 现代改革者理论：如Fazlur Rahman和Abdullahi an-Na'im
5. 伊斯兰法目标理论（maqasid al-shari'ah）
AI.method:
1. 理论分析：比较世俗主义与伊斯兰治理的理论基础
2. 历史分析：考察古典与现代穆斯林思想家的观点
3. 案例研究：分析土耳其、印度尼西亚、马来西亚、突尼斯等国家的混合政治体系
4. 比较研究：探索不同政治体系中世俗制度与伊斯兰价值观的结合方式
AI.findings:
1. 伊斯兰与世俗主义不一定冲突，可以共存
2. 混合政治体系已在实际中出现，成功结合了现代世俗制度与伊斯兰道德价值观
3. 当政治建立在共同伦理、相互妥协和对伊斯兰法目标（maqasid al-shari'ah）的广义理解基础上时，两种方法可以协同工作
4. 土耳其、印尼、马来西亚和突尼斯等国的实践证明了这种可能性
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出世俗主义与伊斯兰治理可作为互补的道德框架而非对立体系
2. 重新定义两者关系：通过不同但交叉的路径共同追求正义与人类尊严
3. 扩展对伊斯兰法目标（maqasid al-shari'ah）的理解，作为两者融合的理论基础
4. 为穆斯林占多数的社会提供新的政治理论视角，超越宗教与现代性的二元对立
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为穆斯林占多数的社会提供实际政治模式参考：不必在宗教与现代性之间选择，而是构建同时维护精神完整性与公民自由的政治体系
2. 展示混合政治体系的可行性，为政策制定者提供实践案例
3. 提出实现这一目标的具体路径：持续哲学对话、制度创新和道德决心
4. 为解决宗教与世俗冲突提供实践指导，促进社会稳定与发展

title: Optimizing Handloom Price Prediction: Leveraging Diverse Features for Superior Accuracy Using Machine Learning
affiliations: Gangadhar Meher University

detail.title: Optimizing Handloom Price Prediction: Leveraging Diverse Features for Superior Accuracy Using Machine Learning
detail.abstract: This paper consolidates multivariate variables to offer a new approach to estimating the costs of handloom products. Data consisting of preprocessed handloom goods’ pricing, size, fabric type, colour, and design features were collected. Due to the highly intensive work characteristic of the handloom industry and its perceived cultural value, the latter struggles to establish appropriate prices mainly because of design density, fabrics used and colour options available. Therefore, the accurate prediction of prices is the best way to ensure the fairness of trades and the sustainability of crafts people’s lives. Based on these important variables, this study develops a forecast model of handloom prices by employing the Decision Tree Regression model which is a machine-learning technique. The stakeholders in the handloom organized sector can use the model because it reflects complex interrelationships of price and features with high accuracy. This research also shows that the integration of several features enhances the price forecast, thereby enabling the handloom market decision-makers to make the right decisions.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出一种基于多元变量的手织品成本估算新方法，使用决策树回归模型预测价格，帮助手织行业建立公平定价并保障工匠生计。
AI.research_question: 如何准确预测手织品的价格？哪些变量（尺寸、面料类型、颜色、设计特征等）对手织品价格有显著影响？
AI.motivation: 手织行业因其劳动密集特性和文化价值，难以建立合理的定价体系，主要受设计密度、使用面料和颜色选择等因素影响。准确的价格预测是确保交易公平和工匠生计可持续性的关键。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于机器学习中的决策树回归理论，该模型能够捕捉价格与特征之间的复杂非线性关系。
AI.method: 收集手织品的价格、尺寸、面料类型、颜色和设计特征等预处理数据，采用决策树回归模型建立价格预测模型。
AI.findings: 决策树回归模型能够高精度地反映价格与特征之间的复杂关系；多个特征的整合显著提升了价格预测的准确性。
AI.theory_contributions: 为手织品定价研究提供了基于机器学习的新方法框架；验证了多元变量整合在价格预测中的有效性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为手织行业利益相关者提供实用的价格预测工具；帮助市场决策者做出更明智的定价决策；促进交易公平和工匠生计的可持续性。

title: The Long Run Economic Effects of Medical Innovation and the Role of Opportunities
affiliations: University of Warwick, University of Oxford - Department of Economics and University of Pennsylvania

detail.title: The Long Run Economic Effects of Medical Innovation and the Role of Opportunities

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
We leverage the introduction of the first antibiotic therapies in 1937 to examine the long-run effects of early-childhood pneumonia on adult educational attainment, employment, income, and work-related disability. Using census data, we document large average improvements across all outcomes, alongside substantial heterogeneity by gender and race. Among women, health gains led to changes in marriage and fertility that partially offset their labor market improvements. Among Black Americans, we uncover a pronounced gradient linked to systemic racial discrimination in the pre–Civil Rights era: individuals born in more discriminatory Jim Crow states realized much smaller gains than those born in less discriminatory states, despite larger reductions in pneumonia exposure. There is no similar gradient among white Americans. Together, these findings highlight the central role of institutional environments in shaping whether investments in early-life health translate into long-run socioeconomic gains.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用1937年抗生素疗法的引入，考察了儿童期肺炎对成年后教育程度、就业、收入和残疾的长期影响。研究发现健康改善带来整体收益，但存在显著的性别和种族异质性：女性因婚姻和生育变化部分抵消了劳动力市场收益；黑人群体中，民权运动前种族歧视程度越高的州，健康改善带来的社会经济收益越小。
AI.research_question: 早期儿童肺炎对成年后社会经济结果（教育、就业、收入、残疾）的长期影响是什么？这些影响在不同性别和种族群体中如何异质？
AI.motivation: 理解早期健康投资如何转化为长期社会经济收益，以及制度环境（特别是系统性种族歧视）如何调节这种转化过程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 早期健康投资与人力资本积累理论；生命历程视角下的健康-社会经济地位关联；制度环境（特别是种族歧视）对健康收益转化的调节作用。
AI.method: 利用1937年抗生素疗法引入作为准自然实验，使用人口普查数据，采用差异中的差异方法，比较抗生素引入前后出生队列的长期社会经济结果。
AI.findings: 1. 抗生素引入显著改善了整体社会经济结果；2. 女性健康改善导致婚姻和生育行为变化，部分抵消了劳动力市场收益；3. 黑人群体中，吉姆·克劳法歧视程度越高的州，健康改善带来的社会经济收益越小，尽管肺炎暴露减少更大；4. 白人群体中无类似梯度效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了制度环境在调节早期健康投资转化为长期社会经济收益中的核心作用；2. 提供了系统性种族歧视如何削弱健康投资回报的经验证据；3. 拓展了健康-社会经济地位关联的异质性理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 强调了消除系统性歧视对实现健康投资公平回报的重要性；2. 为公共卫生政策设计提供了性别和种族敏感视角；3. 揭示了单纯医疗干预可能不足以实现社会经济平等，需要配套制度变革。

title: AI Adoption, Incentives, and Firm Value in General Equilibrium *
affiliations: and

detail.title: AI Adoption, Incentives, and Firm Value in General Equilibrium *
detail.abstract: We study how artificial intelligence adoption reshapes incentive contracts, employment relationships, and firm values in a dynamic general-equilibrium model with search frictions. Firms contract with skilled workers under moral hazard and outside options are endogenously determined through competitive rematching in the labor market. AI can either complement workers by increasing labor productivity or substitute for labor by providing firms with an alternative production technology. When AI adoption is firm-specific, labor-market conditions remain unchanged and contracts respond primarily through stronger incentives and uniformly higher effort. When complementary AI adoption is sector-wide, AI raises both firms' and workers' market values, alters the efficiency of termination, increases effort all the more as the agent has performed well, and increases termination payments. The anticipation of productivity shocks alters incentives and both labor market and firm outcomes. In contrast to complementary AI, substitutive AI strengthens termination threats. Even when employment continues, the * We would like to thank late friend Denis Gromb, Evgeny Lyandres, Marco Paganoand conference and seminar participants at the Firms, Organizations, and Markets conference at Dartmouth College, Paris-Dauphine Fintech chair conference, Singapore Management University, CUHK, Imperial Business School, and Luxembourg School of Finance Fintech conference (keynote) for very helpful comments. 1 threat of substitutive AI increases incentives for agents close to the termination boundary, compresses wages, and reduces termination payments. Substitutive AI adoption allows firm value to increase at the expense of workers' market values. Hence, firms sometimes benefit from substitutive AI adoption for parameter values for which the planner would prefer complementary AI adoption.

AI.tldr: 本文研究AI采纳如何通过动态一般均衡模型重塑激励合约、雇佣关系和公司价值。AI可以互补或替代劳动力，不同采纳方式对劳动力市场、激励设计和分配结果产生不同影响。
AI.research_question: 人工智能采纳如何重塑激励合约、雇佣关系和公司价值？不同AI采纳方式（互补vs替代）对劳动力市场均衡、激励设计和分配结果有何不同影响？
AI.motivation: AI技术正在改变工作组织和雇佣关系，但现有研究缺乏对AI如何影响激励合约设计和劳动力市场均衡的系统分析。需要理解AI作为互补或替代技术时的不同经济后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态一般均衡模型，包含搜索摩擦、道德风险、内生外部选择权。劳动力市场通过竞争性再匹配决定工人的外部选择价值。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建包含搜索摩擦的动态一般均衡模型，分析AI采纳（互补vs替代）对激励合约、雇佣关系和公司价值的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 企业特定AI采纳时，劳动力市场条件不变，主要通过强化激励和统一提高努力水平响应。2. 全行业互补AI采纳提高企业和工人的市场价值，改变解雇效率，绩效好的代理人努力程度更高，增加解雇补偿。3. 替代性AI强化解雇威胁，压缩工资，减少解雇补偿，使公司价值以牺牲工人市场价值为代价增长。4. 企业有时会采用替代性AI，即使规划者更偏好互补性AI。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次在动态一般均衡框架中分析AI采纳对激励合约的影响。2. 区分互补性和替代性AI的不同经济机制。3. 揭示AI采纳如何通过劳动力市场渠道影响激励设计和分配结果。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业AI采纳策略提供指导：互补性AI改善雇佣关系，替代性AI强化控制。2. 为政策制定者提供参考：AI采纳类型影响收入分配和劳动力市场效率。3. 帮助理解AI时代雇佣关系的演变趋势。

title: The effects of interbank market on Central Bank Digital Currency and Transmission of Monetary Policy
affiliations: , National Research University Higher School of Economics (HSE) and Central University of Finance and Economics (CUFE)

detail.title: The effects of interbank market on Central Bank Digital Currency and Transmission of Monetary Policy
detail.abstract: In this paper, we examine the transitional dynamics of central bank digital currency (CBDC) in an economy with heterogeneous banks and an interbank market, using a New Keynesian DSGE framework. Our findings show that the interbank market amplifies monetary policy shocks compared to a baseline scenario where the interbank market is absent or non-functional. Within the interbank setting, whether CBDC acts as a substitute for, or a complement to, bank deposits play a crucial role in either dampening or amplifying the transmission of monetary policy shocks. Furthermore, we find that the choice of policy instrument is critical in shaping outcomes in the presence of an interbank market.

AI.tldr: 本文在异质性银行和银行间市场的经济体中，使用新凯恩斯DSGE框架研究了央行数字货币的过渡动态。研究发现银行间市场放大了货币政策冲击，CBDC作为银行存款的替代品或补充品在冲击传导中起关键作用，政策工具选择在银行间市场存在时至关重要。
AI.research_question: 在异质性银行和银行间市场的经济体中，央行数字货币如何影响货币政策冲击的传导和过渡动态？
AI.motivation: 随着各国央行探索数字货币，需要理解CBDC在复杂金融体系中的影响，特别是银行间市场如何改变CBDC对货币政策传导的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 新凯恩斯动态随机一般均衡模型，包含异质性银行、银行间市场、CBDC作为货币工具。
AI.method: DSGE模型构建与数值模拟，比较有/无银行间市场的情景，分析CBDC作为存款替代品或补充品的不同角色。
AI.findings: 1) 银行间市场放大了货币政策冲击；2) CBDC作为存款替代品时减弱冲击传导，作为补充品时放大冲击传导；3) 政策工具选择在银行间市场存在时对结果有决定性影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了CBDC文献，首次在异质性银行和银行间市场框架中分析CBDC的过渡动态，揭示了银行间市场在货币政策传导中的放大效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行设计CBDC提供政策建议：需要考虑CBDC与银行存款的关系，谨慎选择政策工具，特别是在银行间市场活跃的环境中。

title: Beyond the Barrel- A Dance of Profit and Purpose
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Beyond the Barrel- A Dance of Profit and Purpose
detail.abstract: Petroleum taxation in Nigeria is a balancing exercise that attempts to simultaneously satisfy the State's right to extract maximum value from its natural resources and the investor's need for fiscal certainty and capital recovery. This objective is pursued through an evolving legislative framework, moving from the Petroleum Profit Tax Act (PPT) to the Petroleum Industry Act (PIA) 2021, and most recently the Nigeria Tax Act (NTA) 2025. Historical frameworks suffered from administrative complexity and overlapping regimes, hindering predictable cost recovery. This paper investigates whether the consolidation of petroleum fiscal logic into the NTA strengthens revenue certainty while preserving investor rights. Using a legislative and comparative analysis, the study reviews the Tax Reform Acts, specifically examining cost recovery mechanisms and gas incentives. Findings reveal that the NTA reduces administrative discretion by centralizing authority under the Nigeria Revenue Service. The 65% Cost Price Ratio (CPR) acts as a fiscal anchor, ensuring the State receives revenue "from the first barrel" by capping deductible costs. Furthermore, the system enforces compliance through US dollar-denominated payments and escalating penalties. In contrast to the field-level flexibility of the UK and Norway, Nigeria employs "Behavioural Engineering" via rigid ceilings. Ultimately, while the framework enhances stability, it limits project-specific flexibility, forcing a choice of predictability over negotiated relief.

AI.tldr: 尼日利亚石油税制改革从PPT到PIA再到NTA，通过集中管理、成本上限和美元支付等机制增强收入确定性，但牺牲了项目灵活性
AI.research_question: NTA（尼日利亚税法2025）对石油财政逻辑的整合是否在保护投资者权利的同时增强了收入确定性？
AI.motivation: 尼日利亚石油税制需要在国家资源价值最大化与投资者财政确定性之间取得平衡，历史框架存在行政复杂性和重叠制度问题，阻碍可预测的成本回收
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为工程理论（通过刚性上限规范行为）、财政确定性理论、成本回收机制理论、比较税制分析
AI.method: 立法分析和比较分析，审查税制改革法案，特别关注成本回收机制和天然气激励措施
AI.findings: NTA通过集中尼日利亚税务局权力减少行政自由裁量权；65%成本价格比作为财政锚点，通过限制可扣除成本确保国家"从第一桶油"获得收入；通过美元支付和递增罚款强制执行合规；与英国和挪威的油田级灵活性不同，尼日利亚采用刚性上限的"行为工程"
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"行为工程"在石油税制中的应用理论，发展了刚性上限与财政确定性之间的关系理论，为资源型国家税制改革提供了理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为尼日利亚政策制定者提供了税制改革效果评估，为投资者提供了新税制下的风险分析框架，为其他资源型国家提供了税制改革参考案例

title: The SRDB Framework for Inflation Forecasting: A Regime-Sensitive, Principled Approach with External Validation
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The SRDB Framework for Inflation Forecasting: A Regime-Sensitive, Principled Approach with External Validation
detail.abstract: This paper develops and validates an inflation forecasting framework grounded in the Systemic Risk of Doing Business (SRDB) principle. The central SRDB insight-that inflation reflects compensation for economy-wide risk generated by price adjustment frictions, financial intermediation constraints, and structural fragility-provides a unifying logic for organizing inflation dynamics across regimes. We translate this principle into a transparent, reduced-form Bayesian model that factorizes inflation into computational, financial, and structural risk channels with time-varying weights. The model demonstrates robust out-of-sample performance across eight advanced economies (1970-2024), achieving a 23.5 percent RMSE reduction against the standard BVAR benchmark. Crucially, it provides early warning of inflationary turning points with a 2.3quarter lead time, and its signals are externally validated by their ability to predict revisions in market inflation expectations and shifts in central bank communication. The SRDB framework offers a principled, coherent alternative to purely statistical or single-channel models for policymakers navigating structural transitions.

AI.tldr: 本文基于"系统性商业风险"原则开发并验证了一个通胀预测框架，将通胀分解为计算风险、金融风险和结构风险三个通道，在八个发达经济体(1970-2024)中实现了比标准BVAR基准模型低23.5%的RMSE，并能提前2.3个季度预警通胀转折点。
AI.research_question: 如何基于系统性商业风险原则构建一个统一、透明的通胀预测框架，以解释不同制度下的通胀动态？
AI.motivation: 现有通胀预测模型多为纯统计模型或单一通道模型，缺乏统一的理论框架来解释通胀在不同经济制度下的动态变化，特别是在结构性转型时期。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统性商业风险原则：通胀反映了对经济范围内风险的补偿，这些风险源于价格调整摩擦、金融中介约束和结构性脆弱性。
AI.method: 构建了一个透明的简化形式贝叶斯模型，将通胀分解为计算风险、金融风险和结构风险三个通道，并采用时变权重，在八个发达经济体(1970-2024)进行样本外预测验证。
AI.findings: 1. 模型在样本外预测中比标准BVAR基准模型降低了23.5%的RMSE；2. 能提前2.3个季度预警通胀转折点；3. 模型信号能有效预测市场通胀预期的修正和央行沟通的变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于系统性商业风险原则的统一通胀理论框架，将通胀分解为三个风险通道，为理解不同制度下的通胀动态提供了原则性、连贯的替代方案。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了在结构性转型时期导航的工具，能够早期预警通胀转折点，预测市场预期变化和央行政策沟通，具有实际政策指导价值。

title: How Enterprise Resilience Drives International Collaboration under Institutional Barriers: Evidence from Chinese Pharmaceutical Export Enterprises
affiliations: Chungnam National University and Chungnam National University

detail.title: How Enterprise Resilience Drives International Collaboration under Institutional Barriers: Evidence from Chinese Pharmaceutical Export Enterprises

publicationDetails.detailsText: East Asian Economic Review Vol. 29, No. 4 (December 2025) pp. 415-453, https://dx.doi.org/10.11644/KIEP.EAER.2025.29.4.455
publicationDetails.journalName: Korea Institute for International Economic Policy (KIEP) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: In the context of rising geopolitical tensions and complex regulatory environments, Chinese pharmaceutical export enterprises face growing institutional barriers that hinder their participation in Global Value Chains (GVCs). Drawing on dynamic capability theory and contingency theory, this study examines how enterprise resiliencecomprising anticipatory and adaptive capabilities-facilitates international collaboration under institutional pressure. Using survey data from 319 managerial respondents of Chinese pharmaceutical export enterprises and hierarchical regression analysis, the results show that both anticipatory and adaptive capabilities are positively associated with GVC participation and restructuring. Additionally, the empirical evidence partially supports the proposed moderating effects of institutional barriers-namely institutional distance, institutional uncertainty, and institutional stringency. While these barriers do not significantly affect the relationship between resilience and GVC participation, they selectively weaken its positive relationship with GVC restructuring. These findings suggest the conditional role of enterprise resilience in navigating complex institutional environments and offer preliminary insights for policymakers to improve institutional conditions and mitigate the constraining effects of institutional barriers.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨中国医药出口企业在制度障碍下如何通过企业韧性（前瞻性和适应性能力）促进全球价值链参与与重构，发现韧性对GVC参与有积极作用，但制度障碍会削弱韧性对GVC重构的正面影响。
AI.research_question: 在制度障碍背景下，企业韧性（前瞻性和适应性能力）如何影响中国医药出口企业的全球价值链参与与重构？
AI.motivation: 地缘政治紧张和复杂监管环境导致中国医药出口企业面临日益增长的制度障碍，阻碍其参与全球价值链，需要研究企业如何应对这些挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态能力理论和权变理论，聚焦企业韧性（包含前瞻性能力和适应性能力）
AI.method: 使用319名中国医药出口企业管理者的调查数据，采用层次回归分析
AI.findings: 1. 前瞻性和适应性能力均与GVC参与和重构正相关；2. 制度障碍（制度距离、制度不确定性和制度严格性）对韧性与GVC参与的关系无显著调节作用；3. 制度障碍会选择性削弱韧性与GVC重构的正面关系
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 整合动态能力理论和权变理论解释企业在制度障碍下的GVC参与；2. 揭示了企业韧性在复杂制度环境中的条件性作用；3. 拓展了制度障碍对企业国际战略影响的理论理解
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业管理者提供在制度障碍下增强韧性以促进GVC参与的策略建议；2. 为政策制定者改善制度条件、减轻制度障碍约束效应提供初步见解

title: Second Chance: Life with Less Student Debt
affiliations: Imperial College Business School, Indiana University - Kelley School of Business - Department of Finance and Georgia State University - J. Mack Robinson College of Business

detail.title: Second Chance: Life with Less Student Debt
detail.abstract: We exploit an episode of plausibly random debt discharge due to the loss of paperwork for thousands of borrowers to examine the effects of private student debt relief on borrower outcomes. We find that borrowers who receive debt relief (treated) experience declines in debt balances and delinquency rates on other accounts, and increases in mobility and income relative to those who bear the costs of default like wage garnishment and collections (control). Borrowers in both groups contribute to our findings through different mechanisms. Although we cannot quantify its costs, our results speak to the benefits of loan forgiveness in reducing the consequences of debt burden for defaulted borrowers.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用因文件丢失导致的随机债务免除事件，分析私人学生债务减免对借款人的影响。研究发现，获得债务减免的借款人债务余额和违约率下降，流动性和收入增加，而承担违约成本的借款人则相反。
AI.research_question: 私人学生债务减免如何影响借款人的财务结果和行为？
AI.motivation: 学生债务负担日益严重，但关于债务减免实际效果的研究有限。通过利用文件丢失导致的随机债务免除事件，可以更准确地评估债务减免的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 债务负担理论、财务约束理论、违约后果理论
AI.method: 利用文件丢失导致的准自然实验，采用随机债务免除作为处理组，与承担违约成本（工资扣押和催收）的对照组进行比较分析
AI.findings: 获得债务减免的借款人：1) 债务余额下降；2) 其他账户违约率降低；3) 流动性增加；4) 收入提高。两组借款人通过不同机制贡献研究结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 为债务减免的经济效应提供因果证据；2) 揭示债务负担缓解对借款人行为的系统性影响；3) 丰富财务约束理论在债务减免情境下的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供债务减免有效性的实证依据；2) 帮助金融机构理解债务减免的长期效益；3) 为借款人决策提供参考，尽管无法量化成本，但结果显示了债务减免在减轻违约后果方面的益处

title: Decision Friction: Why Evidence-Rich Health Systems Still Fail to Decide

detail.title: Decision Friction: Why Evidence-Rich Health Systems Still Fail to Decide
detail.abstract: Health systems today operate in an environment of unprecedented evidence abundance. Advances in biomedical research, health economics, and data analytics have expanded what can be known about interventions, risks, and outcomes. Yet many evidence-rich health systems continue to exhibit delayed action, repeated reassessment, and persistent failure to translate knowledge into timely decisions. Prevailing explanations such as data gaps, uncertainty, political interference, or cognitive bias, do not adequately explain why decision paralysis persists where evidence is strong, expertise is high, and incentives are broadly aligned. This paper advances a system-level explanation for this paradox. It introduces Decision Friction as a novel theoretical construct describing the cumulative degradation of decision quality as evidence, authority, and accountability move through fragmented institutional decision architectures. In complex health systems, decisions are rarely discrete moments of choice; they are constructed through multi-stage processes of evaluation, negotiation, authorization, and operational translation across multiple actors and organizations. As decisions progress through these pathways, ownership becomes diffused, risk is displaced, and delays compound, often without any single point of failure or irrational behavior. To clarify mechanism, the paper develops the Decision Friction Funnel, identifying four recurring processes: signal dilution, erosion of ownership, risk displacement, and delay amplification. A central implication is counterintuitive: under certain institutional conditions, producing additional evidence can intensify Decision Friction rather than resolve it. The paper reframes decision failure as an architectural problem and outlines non-prescriptive principles for designing lower-friction decision pathways. Although developed in health systems, Decision Friction is proposed as a general property of complex governance systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"决策摩擦"理论，解释为何在证据充足的健康系统中仍存在决策延迟和行动失败。决策摩擦是证据、权威和问责在碎片化制度架构中传递时决策质量累积性下降的过程，表现为信号稀释、所有权侵蚀、风险转移和延迟放大四个机制。
AI.research_question: 为什么在证据充足、专业知识高、激励基本一致的健康系统中，仍然存在决策延迟和行动失败？
AI.motivation: 健康系统面临前所未有的证据丰富环境，但许多证据丰富的系统仍表现出行动延迟、重复评估和知识转化失败。现有解释如数据缺口、不确定性、政治干预或认知偏差无法充分解释这一悖论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 决策摩擦理论：描述证据、权威和问责在碎片化制度决策架构中传递时决策质量累积性下降的理论框架。决策摩擦漏斗模型包含四个核心过程：信号稀释、所有权侵蚀、风险转移和延迟放大。
AI.method: 理论构建方法：通过概念分析和理论推导，提出决策摩擦作为系统层面的解释框架，并发展决策摩擦漏斗模型来阐明机制。
AI.findings: 1. 决策在复杂健康系统中不是离散选择时刻，而是通过多阶段评估、谈判、授权和操作转化过程构建的；2. 决策过程中所有权分散、风险转移、延迟累积，但没有单一故障点或不理性行为；3. 在某些制度条件下，产生更多证据可能加剧而非解决决策摩擦。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出决策摩擦作为解释证据丰富系统中决策失败的新理论建构；2. 将决策失败重新定义为架构问题而非信息或激励问题；3. 发展决策摩擦漏斗模型阐明机制；4. 提出决策摩擦是复杂治理系统的普遍属性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为非规范性原则提供基础，以设计低摩擦决策路径；2. 帮助决策者识别和缓解决策摩擦；3. 挑战"更多证据必然改善决策"的假设；4. 为健康系统改革提供新视角。

title: Port Blockade and Export Shutdown
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Port Blockade and Export Shutdown
detail.abstract:
Ukraine was one of the global leaders in agricultural production even before the full-scale invasion in 2022. According to the European Commission, the country was among the top three global exporters of barley, corn, sunflower oil, and sunflower meal, as well as the fourth largest supplier of wheat. Access to deep-water ports on the Black Sea allowed 90% of Ukrainian agricultural goods to be transported by sea, providing billions in foreign exchange earnings and vital food security for many countries. In peacetime, grain logistics relied on an efficient system of ports, railways, and road transport. Before the war, about 75-80% of grain was exported through the deep-water ports of Odesa, Pivdennyi, and Chornomorsk, with the rest going via the Danube and smaller ports, while domestic transportation was fully provided by railcars and special road trains. The so-called balance between modes of transport kept logistics costs at an optimal level and allowed for a rapid response to changes in demand on world markets [1].

After the full-scale invasion and blockade of Ukrainian ports, this model was destroyed. Instead of the usual sea supply routes, it was necessary to find land corridors, build new partnerships, invest in technology, and implement digital tools for tracking cargo. At the same time, Ukraine and international organizations sought global solutions to prevent the global food crisis from escalating. In this case study, we will take a detailed and clear look at the preconditions for the blockade, its impact on the global market, international measures to restore exports, and the anti-crisis actions of Agro Region, which was able to maintain exports and avoid losses of more than $10-15 million by reorienting its logistics and innovatively restructuring its logistics department.

AI.tldr: 乌克兰农业出口在2022年全面入侵前依赖黑海深水港，战争导致港口封锁，迫使企业转向陆路走廊并实施数字化物流创新，成功避免重大损失。
AI.research_question: 乌克兰农业企业在战争导致港口封锁后，如何通过物流重构和数字化创新维持出口并避免重大经济损失？
AI.motivation: 乌克兰是全球重要农产品出口国，战争导致传统海运物流中断，威胁全球粮食安全和乌克兰经济，需要研究危机应对策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 危机管理理论、供应链韧性理论、物流创新理论、国际组织协调机制
AI.method: 案例研究方法，以Agro Region公司为研究对象，分析其物流重构和数字化创新的具体措施
AI.findings: Agro Region通过重新定位物流路线、建立新合作伙伴关系、投资技术和实施数字化货物追踪工具，成功避免1000-1500万美元损失
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了危机情境下供应链韧性理论，为战争等极端事件下的物流重构提供理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为面临类似危机的农业企业提供可操作的物流重构方案，展示数字化工具在危机管理中的实际价值

reference: Swiss Finance Institute Research Paper No. 26-05
title: The Value of Pricing Power When Investors Benchmark to Headline Inflation
affiliations: and University of Zurich - Department of Finance

detail.title: The Value of Pricing Power When Investors Benchmark to Headline Inflation

publicationDetails.detailsText: Swiss Finance Institute Research Paper No. 26-05
publicationDetails.journalName: Swiss Finance Institute Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We study equity valuation when investors benchmark firms against headline inflation although pass-through varies across firms. In standard valuation, inflation is valueneutral even with heterogeneous pass-through if investors use firm-specific inflation. Benchmarking to headline inflation conflates nominal cash-flow growth with real performance and shifts discount rates at inflation announcements. Pricing power shapes both channels by enabling greater pass-through and reducing perceived inflation exposure. Empirically, higher-pricing-power firms exhibit smaller stock-price declines and smaller cost-of-capital increases following inflation surprises. The April 2025 tariff announcement yields similar pricing-power-based return differences. These results offer new insights into inflation's implications for asset pricing and valuation.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了当投资者以总体通胀为基准评估企业价值时，不同企业的通胀转嫁能力差异如何影响股票估值。研究发现，定价能力强的企业在通胀意外上升时股价下跌幅度更小、资本成本增加更少，因为更高的定价能力既能提高通胀转嫁率，又能降低投资者感知的通胀风险暴露。
AI.research_question: 当投资者使用总体通胀作为基准（而非企业特定通胀）来评估企业价值时，不同企业的通胀转嫁能力差异如何影响股票估值？
AI.motivation: 传统估值理论认为通胀是价值中性的，即使企业间通胀转嫁能力存在差异，只要投资者使用企业特定通胀率进行估值。然而现实中投资者通常使用总体通胀作为基准，这可能导致估值偏差，因为总体通胀基准混淆了名义现金流增长与实际业绩表现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于通胀转嫁异质性的股票估值理论，强调定价能力在通胀转嫁中的关键作用。理论框架包含两个渠道：1）名义现金流增长与实际业绩的混淆；2）通胀公告时的贴现率调整。定价能力通过提高转嫁率和降低感知的通胀风险暴露来影响这两个渠道。
AI.method: 实证分析方法，检验通胀意外对股票价格和资本成本的影响，特别关注定价能力差异的调节作用。使用2025年4月关税公告作为自然实验，验证定价能力对股票回报差异的影响。
AI.findings: 定价能力强的企业在通胀意外上升时表现出：1）更小的股价下跌幅度；2）更小的资本成本增加。2025年4月关税公告也产生了类似的基于定价能力的回报差异模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）挑战了传统估值理论中通胀价值中性的假设；2）建立了投资者使用总体通胀基准时的估值偏差理论；3）阐明了定价能力在通胀转嫁和风险感知中的双重作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为投资者提供了评估企业通胀风险暴露的新框架；2）帮助企业理解定价能力在通胀环境中的价值保护作用；3）为政策制定者评估通胀政策对不同企业的影响提供参考。

reference: East Asian Economic Review Vol. 29 No. 4 (December 2025) pp. 523-547, https://dx.doi.org/10.11644/KIEP.EAER.2025.29.4.458
title: Effects of Digitalization on Income Inequality across the Stage of ICT Development: Evidence from OECD Countries
affiliations: Keimyung University and Jeonbuk National University

detail.title: Effects of Digitalization on Income Inequality across the Stage of ICT Development: Evidence from OECD Countries

publicationDetails.detailsText: East Asian Economic Review Vol. 29 No. 4 (December 2025) pp. 523-547, https://dx.doi.org/10.11644/KIEP.EAER.2025.29.4.458
publicationDetails.journalName: Korea Institute for International Economic Policy (KIEP) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This study examines how digitalization influences income inequality in OECD countries, emphasizing that its effects depend on the stage of ICT development. Using panel data and a fixed-effects framework, we analyze four indicators of digitalization-fixed telephone subscriptions, mobile cellular subscriptions, individuals using the internet, and fixed broadband subscriptions-and interact them with a dummy capturing the transition to an advanced ICT era. The results show a clear stage-dependent pattern. In the early ICT-development period, digitalization reduces inequality by increasing income shares of the bottom four quintiles and reducing that of the top quintile. However, in the advanced ICT period, these equalizing effects weaken or reverse: digitalization becomes inequality-increasing, particularly for internet use and broadband subscriptions. The findings indicate that digitalization is not uniformly inclusive and underscore the need for policies that strengthen digital skills, broadband quality, and equitable participation in advanced digital ecosystems.

AI.tldr: 数字化的不平等效应在OECD国家呈现阶段性特征：早期ICT发展阶段数字化降低收入不平等，但进入高级ICT阶段后，数字化反而加剧不平等，特别是互联网使用和宽带订阅。
AI.research_question: 数字化如何影响OECD国家的收入不平等？这种影响是否随ICT发展阶段而变化？
AI.motivation: 数字化对不平等的影响存在争议，现有研究缺乏对ICT发展阶段的考虑。理解数字化效应的阶段性特征对制定包容性数字政策至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于数字鸿沟理论和ICT发展阶段理论，提出数字化对不平等的影响具有阶段性特征：早期普及阶段促进包容性，高级阶段可能加剧不平等。
AI.method: 使用OECD国家面板数据，采用固定效应模型，分析四个数字化指标（固定电话、移动电话、互联网使用、宽带订阅）与收入不平等的关系，并引入ICT发展阶段虚拟变量进行交互分析。
AI.findings:
1. 早期ICT发展阶段：数字化降低不平等，增加收入底部四个五分位数的份额，减少顶部五分位数份额
2. 高级ICT阶段：平等化效应减弱或逆转，数字化加剧不平等，特别是互联网使用和宽带订阅
3. 数字化效应具有明显的阶段性依赖特征
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 揭示了数字化对不平等影响的非线性、阶段性特征
2. 整合数字鸿沟理论和ICT发展阶段理论，提出"数字化不平等转折点"概念
3. 为理解数字技术与社会不平等的关系提供新的理论视角
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 政策制定者需根据ICT发展阶段采取差异化数字包容策略
2. 在高级ICT阶段需加强数字技能培训、提升宽带质量
3. 促进公平参与高级数字生态系统，防止数字化加剧社会分化

title: Lack Of Clear Structure in the Logistics Department
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Lack Of Clear Structure in the Logistics Department
detail.abstract: In today's agri-food sector, logistics is not limited to product delivery. It encompasses procurement planning, inventory management, transportation organization, supplier interaction, and document flow control. The logistics function is the “nervous system” of an enterprise, integrating production, finance, and marketing. Ukrainian studies have emphasized that the evolution of logistics organizational structures has gone through four stages: fragmentation (when logistics functions are scattered across different departments), functional aggregation (specialized logistics departments are formed), process integration (coordination of material, information, and financial flows), and networked integrated systems. In Ukraine, many companies still remain in the first two stages: logistics tasks are distributed across departments, which leads to conflicts, duplication of functions, and inflated costs [1]. The agro-industrial company Agro Region had a developed system for growing and selling grain, but its logistics operations were scattered. Different people were responsible for each area, namely purchasing, warehousing, and transportation. The lack of a single coordinator and KPIs led to errors in documentation, delivery delays, opaque costs, and a loss of trust among contractors. After the blockade of Ukrainian ports and the crisis, it became clear that without centralization and systematic evaluation of logistics processes, the company would not be able to remain competitive.

AI.tldr: 乌克兰农业企业Agro Region面临物流功能分散的问题，导致运营效率低下和成本增加。论文探讨了通过物流组织结构的演进和集中化来提升企业竞争力的必要性。
AI.research_question: 乌克兰农业企业如何通过物流组织结构的演进（从分散到集中）来提升运营效率和竞争力？
AI.motivation: 乌克兰许多企业仍处于物流功能分散的阶段，导致部门冲突、职能重复和成本膨胀。Agro Region公司作为案例，其物流操作分散在不同部门，缺乏统一协调和KPI，导致文档错误、交付延迟、成本不透明和承包商信任丧失。港口封锁和危机后，企业认识到没有物流流程的集中化和系统评估将无法保持竞争力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 物流组织结构的四阶段演进理论：1) 碎片化阶段（物流功能分散在不同部门）；2) 功能聚合阶段（形成专业物流部门）；3) 流程整合阶段（协调物料、信息和资金流）；4) 网络化集成系统阶段。
AI.method: 案例研究方法，以乌克兰农业企业Agro Region为研究对象，分析其物流组织结构的现状、问题和改进需求。
AI.findings: Agro Region公司的物流操作分散在采购、仓储和运输等不同部门，缺乏统一协调和KPI，导致文档错误、交付延迟、成本不透明和承包商信任丧失。乌克兰许多企业仍处于物流组织结构演进的前两个阶段。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了物流组织结构四阶段演进理论在乌克兰农业企业的适用性，强调了从分散到集中化演进的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为乌克兰农业企业提供了物流组织结构优化的实践指导，强调了建立统一协调机制、制定KPI和实现物流流程集中化的必要性，以提升运营效率和市场竞争力。

title: The Role of Social and Cultural Environments in Improving the Effectiveness of Student Entrepreneurship Activities in Samata, Gowa Regency

detail.title: The Role of Social and Cultural Environments in Improving the Effectiveness of Student Entrepreneurship Activities in Samata, Gowa Regency
detail.abstract: This study explores the role of the social and cultural environment in enhancing the effectiveness of student entrepreneurship activities in Samata, Gowa Regency. Using a qualitative approach with a descriptive-analytical design, this study involved participatory observation, in-depth interviews, and documentation analysis to identify the mechanisms of environmental involvement in the student entrepreneurship ecosystem. The results reveal that the social environment consists of five main components, including family networks, academic communities, student organizations, local businesses, and supporting institutions that interact to form a comprehensive support system. The cultural dimension, rooted in the values of siri' na pacce and sipakatau, sipakalebbi, sipakainge, shapes a work ethic and business orientation that considers social impact and collective responsibility. The environmental engagement model was identified through four mechanisms, namely family support, academic community empowerment, collaboration with local business actors, and the use of digital platforms. Effectiveness analysis shows that businesses with high environmental engagement have a sustainability rate of 83% with an average revenue growth of 32% per year. Supporting factors include geographical accessibility, digital infrastructure, and accommodative institutional policies, while inhibiting factors include socio-cultural expectation gaps, limited access to formal capital, and fragmentation of the entrepreneurial community. The research findings provide practical implications for the development of an inclusive and sustainable entrepreneurial ecosystem in higher education.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了社会文化环境如何提升学生创业活动的有效性，发现家庭网络、学术社区、学生组织、本地企业和支持机构等五个社会组件与基于当地文化价值观的文化维度共同形成了支持系统，环境参与通过四种机制实现，高参与度的企业可持续性达83%，年收入增长32%。
AI.research_question: 社会文化环境在增强学生创业活动有效性中扮演什么角色？具体机制和影响因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 探索如何通过社会文化环境的优化来提升学生创业活动的成功率和可持续性，为高等教育中包容性和可持续的创业生态系统发展提供实践指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于社会文化环境理论、创业生态系统理论和文化价值观理论，特别是当地文化价值观（siri' na pacce 和 sipakatau, sipakalebbi, sipakainge）对创业行为的影响。
AI.method: 定性研究方法，采用描述性分析设计，包括参与式观察、深度访谈和文献分析，以识别环境参与学生创业生态系统的机制。
AI.findings: 1. 社会环境包含五个主要组件：家庭网络、学术社区、学生组织、本地企业和支持机构；2. 文化维度基于当地价值观塑造了考虑社会影响和集体责任的工作伦理和商业导向；3. 环境参与通过四种机制实现：家庭支持、学术社区赋权、与本地企业合作、数字平台利用；4. 高环境参与企业可持续性达83%，年收入增长32%；5. 支持因素包括地理可达性、数字基础设施和包容性政策；阻碍因素包括社会文化期望差距、正式资本获取有限和创业社区碎片化。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了社会文化环境对学生创业活动影响的理论框架；2. 识别了环境参与的四种具体机制；3. 揭示了当地文化价值观如何塑造创业行为和工作伦理；4. 为创业生态系统理论提供了文化维度的补充。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为高等教育机构发展包容性和可持续的创业生态系统提供实践指导；2. 识别了支持因素和阻碍因素，为政策制定提供依据；3. 展示了环境参与与企业绩效的具体关联；4. 为其他地区类似创业生态系统建设提供可借鉴的模式。

detail.abstract:
This paper advances Jurisdictional Signal Integrity (JSI) as a constitutional diagnostic framework for understanding modern representative strain in the absence of constitutional violation. It argues that contemporary dysfunction within Congress and related institutions cannot be adequately explained by partisanship, polarization, or institutional misconduct alone. Instead, the paper identifies a structural condition—Representational Signal Misalignment (RSM)—in which the communicative signal environment surrounding representative institutions exceeds or bypasses the jurisdictional and deliberative architecture through which those institutions are constitutionally designed to operate.

RSM is introduced as a novel descriptive concept rather than a theory of liability, reform agenda, or regulatory proposal. It names a condition in which lawful speech, protected participation, and formal procedural compliance coexist with measurable degradation in deliberative capacity, accountability clarity, institutional endurance, and representative retention. Under conditions of RSM, translation gives way to performance, authority decouples from audience standing, and rational actors adapt through exit or architectural migration—even in the absence of bad faith, ideological extremism, or electoral defeat.

Drawing on constitutional structure, institutional economics, and systems analysis, the paper traces the emergence of RSM to a late-twentieth-century broadcast inflection (circa 1979–1981), when national visibility and continuous media exposure altered the incentive environment of legislative service without corresponding changes to constitutional design. Empirical patterns—including elevated congressional attrition, declining legislative throughput, and migration toward executive offices—are examined as systems-level signals rather than episodic political anomalies.

The paper further explains why existing constitutional doctrines—separation of powers, federalism, First Amendment jurisprudence, and election law—are ill-suited to identify or remediate RSM. Courts increasingly sense democratic instability yet lack vocabulary to distinguish architectural degradation from political disagreement. JSI supplies that vocabulary while respecting justiciability boundaries, enabling recognition without prescribing judicial intervention.

Importantly, the paper does not advocate speech restriction, institutional redesign, or enforcement mechanisms. It treats constitutional stability as dependent not only on lawful authority and protected expression, but on preserved coherence between signal scope and institutional role. By recovering foundational disciplines—jurisdictional fidelity, deliberative restraint, and bounded accountability—JSI reframes constitutional harm as a condition that may arise without breach, and constitutional fidelity as a practice that may require restraint rather than assertion.

In doing so, the paper offers a pre-crisis interpretive framework for courts, legislators, and scholars confronting lawful governance under transformed communicative conditions, and situates Representational Signal Misalignment as a durable analytic concept for understanding constitutional erosion without constitutional failure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"管辖权信号完整性(JSI)"作为宪法诊断框架，用于理解无宪法违规情况下的现代代议制紧张关系。文章引入"代表信号错位(RSM)"概念，描述合法言论、程序合规与审议能力退化并存的状况，并追溯其根源至20世纪末媒体环境变化导致的激励结构改变。
AI.research_question: 在无宪法违规的情况下，如何解释现代代议制机构（特别是国会）的功能失调？什么结构性条件导致了合法程序与审议能力退化并存的现象？
AI.motivation: 传统解释（党派对立、极化、制度不当行为）无法充分解释当代国会及相关机构的运作困境。需要新的框架来理解在宪法未受违反情况下的代议制紧张关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 管辖权信号完整性(JSI)框架；2. 代表信号错位(RSM)概念；3. 宪法结构理论；4. 制度经济学；5. 系统分析
AI.method: 概念分析框架构建，结合宪法结构、制度经济学和系统分析，追溯历史演变（1979-1981年广播转折点），并分析经验模式（国会人员流失、立法产出下降、向行政机构迁移）。
AI.findings: 1. RSM源于20世纪末媒体环境变化导致的激励结构改变；2. 现有宪法学说无法识别或纠正RSM；3. 法院缺乏区分制度退化与政治分歧的词汇；4. JSI提供诊断框架但不主张司法干预。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出JSI作为宪法诊断框架；2. 引入RSM作为描述性概念；3. 重新定义宪法损害（无需违规即可发生）和宪法忠诚（可能需要克制而非主张）；4. 提供危机前的解释框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法院、立法者和学者提供理解合法治理在变化沟通条件下的分析工具，帮助识别制度退化信号而非将其视为政治异常，同时尊重司法可诉性边界。

detail.title: High Cost of Transport and Logistics
detail.abstract: High cost of transport and logistics Introduction Until 2022, Ukraine's agricultural sector accounted for almost all of the country's export potential. The main route for grain delivery was by road from the fields to elevators and then by rail to the ports of Odesa, Chornomorsk, Pivdennyi, or Mykolaiv. The large-scale invasion and blockade of ports led to a significant restructuring of logistics. Farmers found themselves in a situation where delivering grain to port, with all the associated operating costs such as certification, loading, storage, and paperwork, cost twice as much as in European Union countries and 1.5 times more than in the United States [1]. As a result, logistics became the dominant cost component in the entire supply chain. This case study examines the problem of high transportation and logistics costs and the actions of the Agro Region team led by Khristina Gulida (initiator and project implementation manager), which made it possible to optimize costs and reduce them by 15-20%, as well as increase the predictability of logistics.

AI.tldr: 乌克兰农业物流成本过高，团队通过优化措施成功降低15-20%成本并提高物流可预测性
AI.research_question: 在战争导致港口封锁、物流成本激增的背景下，乌克兰农业企业如何优化运输和物流成本？
AI.motivation: 2022年大规模入侵和港口封锁导致乌克兰农业物流成本急剧上升，比欧盟国家高2倍，比美国高1.5倍，物流成为供应链中的主导成本因素
AI.theoretical_framework: 供应链管理理论、物流优化理论、危机管理理论、成本控制理论
AI.method: 案例研究法，分析Agro Region团队在Khristina Gulida领导下的具体优化措施
AI.findings: 通过团队优化措施，成功将物流成本降低15-20%，同时提高了物流的可预测性
AI.theory_contributions: 为战争和危机环境下的农业供应链管理提供了理论框架，扩展了危机物流管理的实证研究
AI.practical_contributions: 为乌克兰农业企业提供了具体的物流成本优化方案，展示了在极端条件下通过管理创新降低成本的可行性

title: Strategic Human-Centric Compliance (SHCC)

detail.title: Strategic Human-Centric Compliance (SHCC)
