detail.abstract: The rise of AI-enabled monitoring has reshaped organisational governance, fundamentally altering how compliance, oversight, and performance management operate in modern workplaces. While digital monitoring systems promise accuracy, auditability, and regulatory alignment, they also generate significant psychological and organisational risks. Employees increasingly report diminished autonomy, heightened performance pressure, and decreasing trust in leadership as algorithmic oversight becomes embedded in everyday work. These challenges reveal a paradox at the heart of contemporary governance: technologies intended to strengthen external legitimacy and operational control may simultaneously erode internal legitimacy and weaken the motivational foundations of work. This conceptual paper introduces Strategic Human-Centric Compliance (SHCC), a reflexive governance framework that reconciles accountability with autonomy in AI-enabled workplaces. Integrating institutional theory, self-determination theory, behavioural governance, and reflexive modernisation, the SHCC model identifies how compliance systems can be redesigned to support psychological need fulfilment, organisational trust, and long-term talent sustainability. The framework emphasises three interrelated mechanisms—transparency-based legitimacy, autonomy-supportive monitoring, and participatory reflexivity—that together transform compliance from a mechanism of control into a source of internal legitimacy. Six theoretical propositions articulate how SHCC enhances intrinsic motivation, strengthens perceptions of fairness, and reduces the negative behavioural consequences associated with intensive digital surveillance. The paper concludes with implications for organisational design, ethical AI governance, and future research on human-centric oversight systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了战略人本合规(SHCC)框架，旨在解决AI监控带来的组织治理悖论：技术虽增强外部合法性与控制，却可能削弱内部合法性与员工动机。SHCC通过透明度、自主支持性监控和参与式反思机制，将合规从控制工具转变为内部合法性来源。
AI.research_question: 如何在AI赋能的监控环境中设计合规系统，既能满足问责要求，又能支持员工自主性、信任和长期人才可持续性？
AI.motivation: AI监控系统在提高准确性、可审计性和监管合规性的同时，带来了心理和组织风险：员工自主性降低、绩效压力增加、对领导信任下降。这揭示了当代治理的悖论：旨在加强外部合法性和操作控制的技术可能同时侵蚀内部合法性并削弱工作动机基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合制度理论、自我决定理论、行为治理理论和反思性现代化理论，构建战略人本合规(SHCC)框架。
AI.method: 概念性论文，通过理论整合和框架构建，提出六个理论命题。
AI.findings: SHCC框架通过三个相互关联的机制——基于透明度的合法性、自主支持性监控和参与式反思——将合规从控制机制转变为内部合法性来源。六个理论命题阐述了SHCC如何增强内在动机、加强公平感知并减少数字监控的负面行为后果。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出战略人本合规(SHCC)这一新的反思性治理框架；2) 整合多个理论视角解释AI监控环境中的治理悖论；3) 阐明合规系统如何支持心理需求满足、组织信任和人才可持续性；4) 提出六个理论命题为实证研究提供基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为组织设计提供指导，平衡问责与自主性；2) 为伦理AI治理提供框架；3) 帮助组织将合规系统转变为内部合法性来源；4) 为人本监督系统的未来研究指明方向。

title: Is FDI a Panacea? Unveiling Spillover Effects on Efficiency and Risk in Indonesian Manufacturing
affiliations: Airlangga University, Airlangga University, Airlangga University and

detail.title: Is FDI a Panacea? Unveiling Spillover Effects on Efficiency and Risk in Indonesian Manufacturing
detail.abstract: This study builds on Javorcik (2004), who argues that countries attract foreign direct investment (FDI) with the expectation that spillovers will benefit local firms. However, empirical evidence on this effect remains inconsistent. This research addresses the gap by examining the impact of horizontal spillovers not only on production efficiency but also on production risk. It also accounts for firm heterogeneity in the manufacturing sector by classifying technological intensity using unsupervised machine learning, specifically K-means clustering, into three categories based on OECD (2011): high technology (HT), medium technology (MT), and low technology (LT). The study uses data from Statistik Industri (SI) for 2017, 2018, 2019, and 2021, analyzed with the stochastic frontier model developed by Greene (2005). The results show that the MT cluster achieves the highest production efficiency scores, outperforming HT. Labor elasticity exceeds capital elasticity across all clusters, including HT, when the food industry is included. Horizontal spillovers are found to enhance production efficiency in the MT and LT clusters and to mitigate production risk across all clusters. However, spillovers reduce production efficiency in the HT cluster. These findings highlight that, beyond attracting FDI, governments must ensure that local firms possess sufficient technical and managerial capabilities to absorb and adopt transferred technology and knowledge.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于Javorcik(2004)关于FDI溢出效应的理论，探讨了水平溢出不仅对生产效率的影响，还考察了对生产风险的影响。研究使用无监督机器学习(K-means聚类)将制造业企业按技术密集度分为高、中、低三类，采用随机前沿模型分析2017-2021年数据。发现中等技术集群生产效率最高，水平溢出对中低技术集群有正面效率影响，但对高技术集群有负面效率影响，同时能降低所有集群的生产风险。
AI.research_question: 水平溢出效应如何影响不同技术密集度制造业企业的生产效率和风险？
AI.motivation: 虽然Javorcik(2004)提出国家吸引FDI的预期是溢出效应将惠及本地企业，但实证证据并不一致。现有研究主要关注生产效率，忽略了生产风险维度，且缺乏对企业技术异质性的充分考虑。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Javorcik(2004)的FDI溢出效应理论，结合OECD(2011)的技术密集度分类框架，运用随机前沿生产函数理论(Greene, 2005)分析效率和风险。
AI.method: 使用无监督机器学习(K-means聚类)将制造业企业按技术密集度分为高、中、低三类；采用随机前沿模型分析Statistik Industri 2017-2021年数据；控制食品行业影响。
AI.findings: 1) 中等技术集群生产效率最高，超过高技术集群；2) 所有集群中劳动弹性均超过资本弹性；3) 水平溢出提升中低技术集群生产效率，但降低高技术集群效率；4) 水平溢出降低所有集群的生产风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将溢出效应研究从生产效率扩展到生产风险维度；2) 引入机器学习方法更精细地识别企业技术异质性；3) 揭示了溢出效应在不同技术密集度集群中的差异化影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 政府吸引FDI时需考虑本地企业的技术吸收能力；2) 中等技术企业可能从FDI溢出中获益最大；3) 高技术企业需要更强的技术和管理能力才能有效吸收FDI技术转移。

title: Reframing Healthcare Administration: Administrative Erosion, Risk Transfer, and Institutional Silence in U.S. Healthcare Systems

detail.title: Reframing Healthcare Administration: Administrative Erosion, Risk Transfer, and Institutional Silence in U.S. Healthcare Systems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced the research presented in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human subjects, clinical trials, or identifiable private data and therefore did not require institutional review board approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This study received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Over the past two decades, healthcare systems in the United States have pursued efficiency through consolidation, automation, outsourcing, and cost containment. While these strategies were intended to reduce administrative overhead, they also weakened administrative capacity essential to governance, coordination, documentation integrity, and escalation. This manuscript argues that healthcare administration was not eliminated but structurally eroded in ways that transferred risk downward onto clinicians, patients, and electronic records without corresponding redesign of accountability mechanisms. Drawing on public administration theory, health services research, health informatics scholarship, and equity literature, this article conceptualizes administrative erosion as a form of risk transfer that produces governance lag, institutional silence, retrospective compliance, distorted cost signals, and widened disparities. A documented case analysis is presented as illustrative evidence of these systemic dynamics. The manuscript concludes by reframing healthcare administration as patient safety infrastructure and outlines implications for system design, compliance, and preventive governance.

AI.tldr: 该论文认为，过去20年美国医疗系统追求效率的举措（合并、自动化、外包、成本控制）并未真正消除行政工作，而是结构性侵蚀了行政能力，将风险转移给临床医生、患者和电子记录，导致治理滞后、制度沉默、追溯性合规等问题。
AI.research_question: 医疗系统效率化改革如何导致行政能力结构性侵蚀，以及这种侵蚀如何影响医疗治理、患者安全和健康公平？
AI.motivation: 过去20年美国医疗系统追求效率的改革措施（合并、自动化、外包、成本控制）虽然旨在减少行政开支，但可能削弱了医疗治理所需的关键行政能力，导致系统性风险转移和患者安全威胁。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共管理理论、卫生服务研究、健康信息学、公平性文献，特别是风险转移理论和行政能力概念。
AI.method: 文献综述与案例分析法，通过记录性案例作为系统性动态的说明性证据。
AI.findings: 行政侵蚀导致五种系统性后果：治理滞后、制度沉默、追溯性合规、扭曲的成本信号和加剧的健康不平等。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"行政侵蚀"作为风险转移形式的概念框架，将医疗行政重新定义为患者安全基础设施，为理解医疗系统效率改革的意外后果提供了理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医疗系统设计、合规机制和预防性治理提供实践建议，强调需要重新设计问责机制，将行政能力视为患者安全的基础设施。

title: How Housing Search and Bargaining Unfold: Evidence from Offer-Level Data
affiliations: C. T. Bauer College of Business, University of Houston, UNC Kenan-Flagler Business School - Finance Area and Stockholm School of Economics - Finance Department

detail.title: How Housing Search and Bargaining Unfold: Evidence from Offer-Level Data
detail.abstract: We study the microstructure of the U.S. housing market using novel offer-level data. We empirically test key predictions from existing theories and find substantial support for core mechanisms. However, we also uncover patterns unexplained by these models, particularly involving listing prices, housing atypicality, and buyer entry and time-on-market. We further document the importance of non-price bid characteristics in predicting sale prices. Lastly, using a new measure of seller concessions, we find sellers capture surplus early in negotiations, while successive listing price revisions gradually shift surplus toward buyers. Overall, our paper significantly informs future theory development in housing search and bargaining.

AI.tldr: 使用美国房地产市场报价数据研究微观结构，验证现有理论预测，发现支持核心机制但存在未解释模式，揭示非价格投标特征对成交价的重要性，通过新度量发现卖方在谈判早期获取剩余价值而后续价格调整逐渐转向买方
AI.research_question: 美国房地产市场的微观结构特征是什么？现有理论能否解释实际交易模式？非价格投标特征如何影响成交价格？买卖双方在谈判过程中如何分配剩余价值？
AI.motivation: 现有房地产搜索和议价理论缺乏实证验证，需要利用新颖的报价级别数据深入理解市场微观结构，识别理论与现实的差距，为未来理论发展提供实证基础
AI.theoretical_framework: 住房搜索理论、议价理论、信息不对称理论、市场微观结构理论
AI.method: 使用新颖的报价级别数据进行实证分析，检验现有理论预测，开发卖方让步新度量，分析非价格投标特征对成交价的影响
AI.findings: 1. 现有理论的核心机制得到实质性支持；2. 发现挂牌价格、住房非典型性、买家进入和市场停留时间等模式无法被现有模型解释；3. 非价格投标特征对预测成交价很重要；4. 卖方在谈判早期获取剩余价值，而连续的价格修订逐渐将剩余价值转向买方
AI.theory_contributions: 为住房搜索和议价理论的未来发展提供重要实证依据，识别现有理论的局限性，提出需要解释的新模式，推动理论模型完善
AI.practical_contributions: 为房地产交易参与者提供策略指导：卖方应关注早期谈判优势，买方可通过价格修订获得更多剩余价值，市场参与者需重视非价格投标特征的重要性

detail.abstract: This paper introduces the Mini-Kamikaze UAV MRN-7, a palm-scale micro aerial platform designed as a compact, modular, and highly integrated unmanned system for research, inspection, and experimental robotics applications. The platform features a cube-shaped central body integrating propulsion, power management, thermal control, and communication interfaces within a minimal volumetric footprint. A top-mounted primary rotor provides vertical lift, while a short rear stabilizing arm equipped with a vertically oriented auxiliary rotor enhances yaw control and directional stability. The Mini-Kamikaze UAV MRN-7 emphasizes extreme miniaturization, structural simplicity, and mechanical robustness. Its monolithic housing reduces aerodynamic drag, improves impact resistance, and enables rapid deployment in confined environments. The system architecture prioritizes low power consumption, ease of modular expansion, and compatibility with autonomous control frameworks, making it suitable for swarm research, indoor navigation, environmental sensing, and educational experimentation. The design demonstrates how functional aerial platforms can be reduced to palm-scale form factors without sacrificing stability, controllability, or system integration. The Mini-Kamikaze UAV MRN-7 serves as a proof-of-concept for future ultra-compact UAV architectures that merge mechanical efficiency, computational intelligence, and structural minimalism into a unified micro-robotic system.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Mini-Kamikaze UAV MRN-7，一款手掌大小的微型无人机平台，采用立方体中心机身设计，集成推进、电源管理、热控制和通信接口，具有模块化、高集成度和机械鲁棒性特点，适用于研究、检测和实验机器人应用。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个手掌大小的微型无人机平台，在保持稳定性、可控性和系统集成度的同时，实现极端小型化、结构简单化和机械鲁棒性？
AI.motivation: 当前需要更小、更紧凑的无人机平台用于研究、检测和实验机器人应用，特别是在受限环境中需要快速部署的场合。现有无人机往往体积较大或功能有限，无法满足微型化需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 微型无人机系统设计理论，包括空气动力学优化、结构最小化、模块化架构、低功耗设计和自主控制框架集成。
AI.method: 采用立方体中心机身设计，集成所有关键系统；主旋翼提供垂直升力，辅助旋翼增强偏航控制和方向稳定性；采用单体外壳减少空气阻力；优先考虑低功耗和模块化扩展。
AI.findings: 成功开发了手掌大小的微型无人机平台，实现了极端小型化而不牺牲稳定性、可控性或系统集成；证明了功能空中平台可以缩小到手掌尺寸；展示了机械效率、计算智能和结构最小化的统一。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了微型无人机系统设计的新范式，展示了如何将多个功能系统集成到最小体积中；为未来超紧凑无人机架构提供了概念验证；贡献了关于机械效率、计算智能和结构最小化融合的理论见解。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了适用于集群研究、室内导航、环境传感和教育实验的实际平台；提供了模块化、易于扩展的设计；增强了在受限环境中的部署能力；为研究社区提供了实用的微型无人机解决方案。

reference: European Corporate Governance Institute - Law Working Paper No. 891/2026
title: Convergence, Diversity, and Divergence: The Two Axes of Corporate Law and Governance
affiliations: Columbia University - Law School

detail.title: Convergence, Diversity, and Divergence: The Two Axes of Corporate Law and Governance

publicationDetails.detailsText: European Corporate Governance Institute - Law Working Paper No. 891/2026
publicationDetails.journalName: European Corporate Governance Institute (ECGI) - Law Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Corporate law and governance has now divided along two axes, the axis of Internal Governance and the axis of Externalities Governance. A generation after “corporate governance” became a global phenomenon, we see an established a vocabulary of corporate governance mechanisms, norms, and behaviors on the axis of Internal Governance. Within the convergent framing standard of “investibility,” we can expect diversity that responds to local imperatives, including original and continuing ownership patterns and efforts by the State to shape corporate governance tools to promote the State’s economic and social policy objectives. But the major move in corporate law and governance over the past decade has been the development of a second corporate governance axis, Externalities Governance. Climate change risk associated with greenhouse gas emissions is the most salient externality but a broader set of social welfare concerns, made visible through developing disclosure regimes, now figures into corporate governance. Commitments and behavior along the Externalities Governance axis will have substantial variance and are likely to be volatile because they are not anchored to a clear goal of maximizing production or linked to parties bound to the firm in the nexus of explicit or implicit contracts but rather depend on a time-varying socio-political consensus. The EU has been the most aggressive jurisdiction in mandating Externalities Governance by positive law. Although the scope of the EU mandate is now under revision for both the coverage threshold (and thus the number) of subject firms and the breadth of coverage, the extraterritorial ambition remains. A “Brussels” effect could achieve significant convergence on Externalities Governance. The counter of course is the United States, through an Administration that is determined to protect US fossil fuel interests and lumps all other externality concerns in the same basket. This could lead to significant divergence for US firms and there may yet be a retrograde “Washington” effect on the general idea that social welfare concerns should be at least a partial focus of corporate law and governance.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出公司治理已分化为两个轴心：内部治理轴和外部性治理轴。内部治理轴已形成全球趋同的治理机制，而外部性治理轴（特别是气候变化等社会福祉问题）正在快速发展但存在显著差异。欧盟通过积极立法推动外部性治理，而美国则持保守态度，可能导致全球公司治理的显著分歧。
AI.research_question: 公司治理如何从单一的内部治理轴心分化为内部治理和外部性治理两个轴心？这种分化对全球公司法律和治理实践产生什么影响？不同司法管辖区（特别是欧盟和美国）在外部性治理方面的差异将如何塑造未来的公司治理格局？
AI.motivation: 传统公司治理主要关注内部治理机制，但过去十年中，气候变化、温室气体排放等社会福祉问题已成为公司治理的重要维度。这种从内部治理向外部性治理的扩展反映了社会对公司承担更广泛社会责任的期望，但不同司法管辖区的应对策略存在显著差异，可能影响全球公司治理的趋同或分歧。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 公司治理双轴理论：内部治理轴（传统治理机制）和外部性治理轴（社会福祉问题治理）
2. 趋同理论：在"可投资性"标准下的内部治理趋同
3. 制度差异理论：不同司法管辖区基于本地需求和国家政策目标形成的治理多样性
4. 外部性理论：公司活动对社会和环境的外部影响
5. 监管竞争理论：欧盟的"布鲁塞尔效应"与美国的"华盛顿效应"
AI.method: 该论文采用理论分析和比较法研究方法，通过分析公司治理的历史演变、不同司法管辖区的法律框架（特别是欧盟和美国的政策对比）、以及监管机制的发展趋势，构建公司治理双轴理论框架。
AI.findings:
1. 公司治理已明确分化为两个轴心：内部治理轴（已趋同）和外部性治理轴（正在发展）
2. 欧盟通过积极立法（如强制披露制度）成为外部性治理的领先者，具有域外适用野心
3. 美国持保守态度，保护化石燃料利益，可能阻碍外部性治理的全球趋同
4. 外部性治理存在显著差异和波动性，因为它依赖于时变的社会政治共识而非明确的生产最大化目标
5. "布鲁塞尔效应"可能推动外部性治理趋同，而"华盛顿效应"可能导致分歧
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出公司治理双轴理论框架，系统化分析内部治理和外部性治理的差异
2. 扩展了公司治理理论，将社会福祉问题正式纳入治理体系
3. 解释了不同司法管辖区在公司治理趋同与分歧中的动态机制
4. 为理解全球公司治理的演变提供了新的分析视角
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为企业管理者提供了理解新兴外部性治理要求的框架
2. 为政策制定者展示了不同司法管辖区的治理策略差异
3. 为投资者识别公司治理风险（特别是环境和社会风险）提供了分析工具
4. 为跨国企业应对不同司法管辖区的治理要求提供了实践指导
5. 揭示了欧盟和美国在外部性治理方面的政策冲突可能带来的合规挑战

title: Management by Indicators (KPIs) in the Automotive Sector: Efficiency, Predictability and Sustainable, Data-Driven Growth

detail.title: Management by Indicators (KPIs) in the Automotive Sector: Efficiency, Predictability and Sustainable, Data-Driven Growth
detail.abstract: This article examines the role of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) as strategic management tools in the automotive sector, emphasizing their contribution to operational efficiency, financial predictability and sustainable growth. Drawing on a qualitative-descriptive approach supported by classical and contemporary literature, the study highlights how data-driven decision-making reduces uncertainty, strengthens governance and enhances organizational adaptability in highly competitive environments. The analysis demonstrates that KPIs influence critical dimensions of automotive operations-including sales, inventory management, purchasing, post-sales and finance-by providing clear performance standards and enabling continuous improvement. Findings indicate that disciplined KPI adoption increases assertiveness in purchasing, accelerates inventory turnover, standardizes processes and improves customer satisfaction. Overall, the study concludes that consistent integration of KPIs into daily management not only drives operational excellence but also supports strategic scalability and long-term competitiveness in the automotive industry.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了关键绩效指标（KPIs）作为汽车行业战略管理工具的作用，强调其对运营效率、财务可预测性和可持续增长的贡献。研究表明，数据驱动的决策减少不确定性，加强治理，并提升组织在高度竞争环境中的适应性。
AI.research_question: 关键绩效指标（KPIs）如何作为战略管理工具在汽车行业中发挥作用，特别是在提升运营效率、财务可预测性和可持续增长方面？
AI.motivation: 汽车行业面临高度竞争环境，需要有效的管理工具来减少不确定性、加强治理并提升组织适应性。KPIs作为数据驱动的决策工具，对于实现运营卓越和长期竞争力具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于经典和当代文献的战略管理理论，特别是绩效管理、数据驱动决策和运营效率相关理论。
AI.method: 定性描述性方法，通过文献分析支持研究。
AI.findings: KPIs影响汽车运营的关键维度（销售、库存管理、采购、售后和财务），提供清晰的绩效标准并实现持续改进。纪律性的KPI采用提高了采购准确性、加速库存周转、标准化流程并改善客户满意度。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对KPIs作为战略管理工具在汽车行业作用的理论理解，强调了数据驱动决策对减少不确定性和增强组织适应性的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为汽车行业管理者提供了KPIs实施的实践指导，展示了如何通过KPIs集成实现运营卓越、战略可扩展性和长期竞争力。

detail.abstract: In this conceptual working paper, I introduce the Global Rare Impact Theory as the formal backbone behind a question that has been present for many years in my fieldwork and personal journey: How can the inner awakening of a single human being truly reshape relationships, organizations, and even civilization - and not remain just an inspiring idea? The Global Rare Impact Theory (GRIT) offers a transdisciplinary architecture that weaves together the R.A.R.E® model of Inner Rare Authenticity and the I.M.P.A.C.T® axis of outer transformation. Instead of treating authenticity as a soft psychological preference, the theory positions it as a structural human variable that can shape leadership, coaching praxis, economic design, and the integration of artificial intelligence into human life. At the micro level, GRIT examines how individuals remember and embody what I call the Rare Inner Code - a unique configuration of awareness, meaning, and potential that I have observed repeatedly in coaching conversations, leadership labs, and my own inner experience. At the macro level, the theory traces how this inner code can extend outward: first into relationships and teams, then into organizations, social systems, and the longer arc of civilizational evolution. Within this context, the AI × AI² (Artificial Intelligence × Authentic Intelligence) paradigm functions as a civilizational lens. Artificial intelligence expands computational capacity and reach; Authentic Intelligence grounds that expansion in awareness, dignity, and meaning. The theory argues that sustainable progress in the age of AI cannot be reduced to more innovative algorithms alone. It depends on whether human beings grow in presence, ethical clarity, and inner coherence at least as fast as their technologies evolve. Drawing on leadership science, coaching research, AI ethics, economics, and civilization studies, along with fourteen years of lived coaching practice, this paper offers a civilization-scale framework for conscious 2 leadership, meaning-driven economies, awareness-based governance, and ethical human– technology coexistence. It is intended as the official conceptual and academic introduction to the forthcoming book, The Global Rare Impact Theory: From Inner Rare Authenticity to Global Impact, and as an open invitation for researchers, leaders, and practitioners to examine authenticity not as a slogan, but as an infrastructure for the future of humanity. This paper functions as the foundational working paper for a series of forthcoming ISI/Scopusindexed articles based on the Global Rare Impact Theory (GRIT).

AI.tldr: 本文提出了全球稀有影响理论（GRIT），将内在稀有真实性（R.A.R.E®模型）与外在变革（I.M.P.A.C.T®轴）结合，认为真实性不仅是心理偏好，而是能够塑造领导力、经济设计和AI整合的结构性变量，为AI时代的人类发展提供文明尺度框架。
AI.research_question: 个体的内在觉醒如何真正重塑人际关系、组织乃至文明，而不仅仅停留在理念层面？
AI.motivation: 作者在多年田野调查和个人经历中一直思考：个体的内在觉醒如何产生实际影响，而非仅停留在鼓舞人心的理念层面。当前AI时代需要将真实性作为结构性变量而非软性心理偏好。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全球稀有影响理论（GRIT）作为核心理论框架，整合了R.A.R.E®内在稀有真实性模型和I.M.P.A.C.T®外在变革轴。该理论将真实性定位为结构性人类变量，并提出了AI × AI²（人工智能×真实性智能）范式作为文明视角。
AI.method: 概念性工作论文，基于跨学科理论整合（领导力科学、教练研究、AI伦理、经济学、文明研究）和14年亲身教练实践经验，结合田野观察和个人内在体验。
AI.findings: GRIT理论提供了从微观到宏观的分析框架：微观层面探讨个体如何记忆和体现"稀有内在代码"；宏观层面追踪这种内在代码如何向外扩展至关系、团队、组织、社会系统和文明演化。AI时代的可持续发展需要人类在场感、伦理清晰度和内在一致性的发展速度至少与技术演进同步。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了全球稀有影响理论（GRIT）作为跨学科架构；2）将真实性重新概念化为结构性人类变量；3）建立了AI × AI²范式作为文明视角；4）提供了从微观到宏观的整合分析框架。

detail.abstract: Conflicts in intimate and family relationships do not arise from love itself but from an institutional architecture of unlimited liability built around love. Compulsory marital property pooling, gender-skewed childcare burdens, non-market obligations with no definable limits, inheritance outcomes contingent on death order, and emotionally driven capital transfers collectively turn intimacy into a mechanism of exploitation, emotional coercion, and structural impoverishment—harms borne disproportionately by women and debt-dependent middle-class households [1][8]. This paper proposes a Responsibility-Based Family Law grounded in a single foundational axiom: intergenerational responsibility. Adults cannot impose unbounded obligations on spouses, partners, or future generations; nor may they dissipate inherited potential through capital gifts or non-market transfers that exceed their current disposable income. All further rules follow directly from this axiom. (1) Personhood and Independence Rule establishes full economic separateness for spouses and restores minors’ economic personhood through fiduciary accounts governed exclusively by the child’s best interest [9]. (2) Limit-Based Rule for Non-Market Transfers restricts all non-market exchanges and all forms of gifting—including charitable transfers—to surplus current income, prohibiting any impact on existing assets, future income, or intergenerational entitlements. Even when directed toward genuinely beneficial projects, capital gifting remains an irresponsible act, since every legitimate purpose of such transfers can be fulfilled through investment rather than through responsibility-free asset displacement [10]. (3) Predictable Succession Rule abolishes testamentary freedom and replaces death-sequence inheritance with a deterministic lineage algorithm, ensuring that wealth flows through stable, non-manipulable kinship paths independent of marriage status or timing of death [11]. (4) Disclosure and Pre-Arbitration Rule for Major Voluntary Life Decisions requires debtors to disclose prospective income-reducing choices and allows debtor-initiated pre-arbitration, making relationally induced sacrifices economically transparent and preventing the covert coercion that disproportionately harms middle-income credit-dependent individuals [12]. Together, these rules eliminate unlimited liability from the most intimate sphere of life. Marriage exits the legal system and returns to cultural custom; childcare becomes a compensated fiduciary function; non-market labor can no longer be weaponized into debt claims; inheritance becomes mathematically predictable; and relational coercion loses its economic power. Responsibility-Based Family Law thus completes the liberation trajectory begun by the abolition of bodily slavery and continued by the abolition of economic slavery under modern limited-liability institutions. It constitutes the family chapter of a “Second Abolition”, ending relational servitude and restoring autonomy where human vulnerability is greatest [13].

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于责任的家族法，以代际责任为基石，通过四大规则消除亲密关系中的无限责任，将婚姻回归文化习俗，保护经济自主权。
AI.research_question: 如何通过法律改革消除亲密关系中的无限责任制度，防止亲密关系成为剥削、情感胁迫和结构性贫困的机制？
AI.motivation: 当前家庭法制度建立在无限责任基础上，导致亲密关系成为剥削机制，特别是对女性和中产阶级家庭造成不成比例的伤害。强制财产共有、性别化的育儿负担、无限制的非市场义务等制度设计使亲密关系成为压迫工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代际责任理论：成年人不能对配偶、伴侣或后代施加无限制的义务；责任限制理论：所有非市场转移应限于当前可支配收入；经济自主理论：恢复个人经济独立性。
AI.method: 规范性法律分析：基于单一公理（代际责任）推导出四大法律规则，构建完整的责任型家庭法体系。
AI.findings: 提出的四大规则能有效消除亲密关系中的无限责任：1）人格与独立规则确保配偶经济分离；2）限制性规则防止资本转移影响代际权益；3）可预测继承规则消除遗嘱自由；4）披露与预仲裁规则防止关系性牺牲的隐蔽胁迫。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出代际责任作为家庭法的核心公理；2）发展责任限制理论框架；3）构建"第二次废除"理论，将家庭法纳入从身体奴隶制到经济奴隶制的解放进程。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）婚姻退出法律体系回归文化习俗；2）育儿成为有偿信托职能；3）非市场劳动不再成为债务主张工具；4）继承变得数学可预测；5）关系胁迫失去经济权力。

title: Impact Of MGNREGS on Poverty Alleviation in Telangana State
affiliations: Nizam College

detail.title: Impact Of MGNREGS on Poverty Alleviation in Telangana State
detail.abstract: In India, several employment programs have been implemented with varying degrees of success. One such Scheme is "Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme" (MGNREGS). It was launched in 2006 to enhance the livelihood security of rural households by providing 100 days of unskilled work. It is not only a guarantee but a right to employment. The empirical data reveals that in Telangana there is an upward trend in the employment provided to the wage-seekers and in the wage rate. The process of poverty reduction has taken place through an increase in the market wage rate and a reduction in gender wage differentials. The Regression Analysis indicates that before the introduction of MGNREGS, the market wage rate annually increased at only 3 percent but after the introduction of MGNREGS it increased at a high rate of 20 percent. With gender wage-differentials, it is observed that before the launching of the MGNREGS wage-differentials were widening but wagedifferentials steeply narrowed down after the implementation of the Scheme. The benefit-cost ratio of the Scheme works out to be 2:1. The Scheme while lifting some labour households above the povertyline, it is pushing down some cultivators below the poverty-line. To make the Scheme both labourfriendly and cultivator-friendly there is a need to coordinate agriculture activities on private land with MGNREGS works.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了印度MGNREGS就业计划对特伦甘纳邦劳动力市场的影响，发现该计划显著提高了市场工资率（从年增3%到20%），缩小了性别工资差距，但同时也对部分农民产生了负面影响。
AI.research_question: MGNREGS就业计划如何影响印度特伦甘纳邦的劳动力市场，特别是对市场工资率、性别工资差距以及不同群体（劳动者与农民）的福利影响？
AI.motivation: 印度实施了多项就业计划但效果不一，MGNREGS作为2006年启动的重要农村就业保障计划，需要评估其实际效果，特别是对劳动力市场结构和贫困减少的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力市场理论、工资决定理论、性别工资差距理论、公共政策评估理论、贫困减少理论
AI.method: 回归分析（前后对比分析），使用实证数据（特伦甘纳邦的就业和工资数据），计算效益成本比（2:1）
AI.findings: 1. MGNREGS实施后市场工资率年增长率从3%大幅提高到20%；2. 性别工资差距在计划实施前扩大，实施后显著缩小；3. 计划效益成本比为2:1；4. 计划在提升部分劳动者家庭脱贫的同时，使部分农民陷入贫困线以下
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为公共就业计划对劳动力市场的结构性影响提供了实证证据；2. 揭示了就业保障计划对工资决定机制的双重影响；3. 拓展了性别工资差距动态变化的理论解释
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 建议协调MGNREGS工作与私人农田农业活动，使计划既有利于劳动者又有利于农民；2. 为政策制定者提供了具体的改进方向；3. 展示了如何平衡不同群体利益的政策设计思路

title: The Effect of Digital Rideshare on Urban Periphery Development
affiliations: and Northeastern University (USA)

detail.title: The Effect of Digital Rideshare on Urban Periphery Development

declarations.funderStatement: This work was funded in part by the NSF Research Traineeship “Platforms for Exchange and Allocation of Resources” (PEAR) program, which supported the author during the period of this research.

detail.abstract: Digital platforms are reshaping how people navigate and interact with cities, yet assessing their impact on urban development remains challenging due to spatial and temporal uncertainty in observational data. This paper estimates the causal effect of digital rideshare platforms on urban expansion at the periphery of U.S. cities. Leveraging the staggered rollout of Uber between 2010 and 2015, we implement a difference-in-differences design that exploits variation in launch timing across 167 geographic units. To measure development, we combine satellite imagery with a convolutional neural network (CNN) and a spatio-temporal model that accounts for uncertainty in image classification. This approach produces consistent estimates of built-up land over time, which we use in our causal analysis. We find that access to rideshare services significantly increases the rate of peripheral development, particularly in areas with low transit accessibility. These findings are consistent with theoretical predictions from urban economic models, which posit that reductions in effective commuting costs expand the urban fringe. More broadly, our results highlight how digital transportation platforms—absent direct public investment—can reshape land use by altering the accessibility landscape of cities.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用双重差分法分析Uber在美国城市的推广对城市边缘扩张的因果效应，发现网约车服务显著促进了外围地区开发，尤其是在公共交通不便的区域。
AI.research_question: 数字网约车平台如何影响美国城市边缘地区的扩张？
AI.motivation: 数字平台正在重塑城市互动方式，但由于观测数据的时空不确定性，评估其对城市发展的影响具有挑战性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 城市经济模型理论，认为有效通勤成本的降低会扩大城市边缘区域。
AI.method: 采用双重差分设计，利用Uber在2010-2015年间分阶段推广的时间差异，覆盖167个地理单元。结合卫星影像、卷积神经网络和时空模型来测量建成区土地变化。
AI.findings: 网约车服务显著增加了城市边缘地区的发展速度，特别是在公共交通可达性较低的区域。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了城市经济模型中关于通勤成本与城市扩张关系的理论预测，为数字平台如何通过改变可达性景观影响土地利用提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了数字交通平台在没有直接公共投资的情况下如何重塑城市土地利用模式，为城市规划者和政策制定者提供了重要参考。

title: The Great Restoration - The Savanna Accord
affiliations: Mirracle Consultants

detail.title: The Great Restoration - The Savanna Accord
detail.abstract:
The Savanna has always been a land of brutal elegance, a place where the rhythm of life is dictated by the pulse of the rain and the sharpness of the claw. But lately, the rhythm has broken. The golden plains, once a symbol of infinite abundance, have become a scorched theater of desperation. The rains are late, the forests are thinning, and the ancient pacts between species—the unspoken laws that have governed the wild since the first sunrise—are dissolving into a chaotic frenzy of survival.

In the watering holes, where a temporary truce once held, there is now only tension. Mother elephants shield their calves with weary eyes; leopards pace the thinning treelines with hollow bellies; and the great buffalo herds huddle together, their massive horns lowered against an invisible enemy. The air is thick with a question that no animal dares to howl, roar, or trumpet aloud: Has the Great Architect of the Wild abandoned us? In the face of disappearing habitats and the relentless encroachment of the "Two-Legged Ones," the animals are beginning to wonder if there is any loving creator left in a world that feels increasingly cold and indifferent.
It was against this backdrop of existential dread that the Big Five Council was summoned. The call went out across the scorched earth: a meeting of the titans to decide the fate of the forest. The directive was clear: each lineage must meet in private to find a soul-deep solution.

For the Cape Buffalo, the meeting was not just about grass—it was about existence. They saw the world through the lens of the herd, where the strength of one is the survival of all. But a veteran bull among them looked beyond the herd. He saw the Elephant’s ancient wisdom and the Rhino’s stoic defense as pieces of a larger puzzle. He realized that the grazers—the giants who transform the earth into life—shared a destiny. Their interests were identical, yet their conflicts were tearing the Savanna apart.

This realization led to a clandestine gathering under the sprawling, fermented shade of a Great Amarula Tree. There, the Elephant Sage proposed a framework that would change history: a path of Sankofa. To move forward, they had to reach back. They had to look at the "Fall" of their world, identify the roots of the current bloodletting, and propose remedies so radical they bordered on the impossible.
But the Buffalo knew that animal instinct alone could not solve a problem created by a changing world. To find the "endgame," he sought out a bridge between two worlds—a Black African Queen, a descendant of his own totem lineage, who possessed a mind like a lightning storm. In the glow of a sacred fire under a silver full moon, they sat across a board of Chaturanga. As she moved the wooden pieces—the elephants, the chariots, the kings—she taught him that the Savanna was not a battlefield, but a board. To win, one did not need to kill; one needed to manage the space, the resources, and the very urge to consume.

The Great Restoration: The Savanna Accord is the chronicle of what followed. It is the story of how a species once known only for its stubborn strength became the architect of a new Eden. It details a revolutionary covenant where humans engineer "The Great Mimic"—meals that taste of blood but are born of soil—and where the predators of the jungle transform from killers into the "Accountants of the Wild."
Prepare to enter a world where the lion finally lies down with the lamb—not because of a miracle, but because of a strategy. This is the story of the day the wild stopped running from its fate and decided, finally, to master it.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了在气候变化和人类活动威胁下，非洲大草原生态系统面临崩溃时，动物通过跨物种合作和战略思维，与人类共同设计可持续解决方案，实现生态恢复的故事。
AI.research_question: 在生态系统崩溃和传统生存法则失效的背景下，草原动物如何通过跨物种合作和战略思维，与人类共同设计可持续的生态恢复方案？
AI.motivation: 非洲大草原生态系统面临严重威胁：降雨模式改变、栖息地消失、物种间古老契约瓦解，动物们面临生存危机，需要重新思考生存策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 生态系统崩溃理论；2. 跨物种合作与共生理论；3. Sankofa框架（回顾过去以展望未来）；4. 战略管理与资源分配理论；5. 人类与自然协同进化理论。
AI.method: 1. 叙事分析：通过动物视角的寓言式叙述；2. 案例研究：大五理事会会议和秘密集会；3. 跨学科对话：动物本能与人类战略思维的结合；4. 模拟游戏：通过恰图兰卡棋盘游戏进行战略思维训练。
AI.findings: 1. 动物能够超越本能，发展战略思维；2. 跨物种合作是生态恢复的关键；3. 人类可以通过技术创新（如"伟大模仿"食物）减少对自然的压力；4. 捕食者可以转变为"荒野会计师"，管理生态平衡；5. Sankofa框架有助于从历史中学习解决方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了动物战略思维的理论框架；2. 发展了跨物种治理的生态恢复模型；3. 建立了Sankofa框架在生态管理中的应用；4. 提出了人类-动物协同创新的理论范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为大草原生态恢复提供了具体方案；2. 展示了技术创新在保护生物多样性中的作用；3. 提供了跨物种冲突管理的实践方法；4. 为其他生态系统恢复提供了可借鉴的模式。

title: Predicting Market Bubble Dynamics Using Machine Learning A Behavioral Finance Comparison of the USA and India
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Predicting Market Bubble Dynamics Using Machine Learning A Behavioral Finance Comparison of the USA and India

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I confirm that I have no personal ,financial or professional conflicts of interest related to this research. The study was conducted independently, and no external individual or organisation influenced the analysis, interpretation, or reporting of the results.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, personal. data, or any procedures requiring ethical approval. All data used were publicly available from financial databases and official economic sources.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. All work, including data collection, analysis, and writing, was completed independently by the author.

detail.abstract: My interest in financial markets began with wanting to understand why prices sometimes move in ways that do not seem to match what the underlying fundamentals suggest. Markets can appear orderly one moment and unpredictable the next. This project grew from that curiosity, especially when markets show signs of developing bubble like behavior. To explore this topic, I examined the United States and India. Their markets differ in size, investor base, and long term characteristics, making them an interesting pair to compare. In this study, I used descriptive statistics, basic machine learning models, and ideas from behavioral finance to examine volatility, interest rates, return patterns, and market relationships. I converted all data to USD so the comparison would remain consistent. I was not aiming to build a precise forecasting system. Instead, I wanted to see how key indicators behave during major shifts in market sentiment. This approach helped me better understand how each market reacts to uncertainty and what those reactions reveal about investor behavior.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过比较美国和印度金融市场，使用描述性统计、基础机器学习模型和行为金融学理论，分析市场波动、利率、回报模式和市场关系，旨在理解市场情绪重大转变期间关键指标的行为，而非建立精确预测系统。
AI.research_question: 美国和印度金融市场在面临不确定性时，关键指标（波动率、利率、回报模式、市场关系）如何表现？这些表现揭示了怎样的投资者行为差异？
AI.motivation: 作者对金融市场价格变动与基本面不符的现象产生兴趣，特别是当市场出现泡沫行为迹象时。希望通过比较不同规模、投资者基础和长期特征的美国与印度市场，理解市场情绪重大转变期间的市场行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为金融学理论，关注投资者非理性行为、市场情绪和泡沫形成机制。
AI.method: 描述性统计分析、基础机器学习模型应用、所有数据转换为美元以确保一致性比较。
AI.findings: 研究揭示了美国和印度市场在不确定性时期的关键指标行为差异，这些差异反映了各自市场的投资者行为特征和对市场情绪变化的反应模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 为行为金融学在跨市场比较中的应用提供实证支持，深化了对不同市场结构下投资者行为差异的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助投资者和政策制定者更好地理解不同市场在不确定性时期的反应模式，为风险管理提供参考，但明确不旨在建立精确预测系统。

title: Pathways to Authoritarian Capitalism
affiliations: Johns Hopkins University, New York University (NYU) and Johns Hopkins University

detail.title: Pathways to Authoritarian Capitalism
detail.abstract: What accounts for the emergence of authoritarian capitalism in industrialized democracies, post-communist countries, and emerging market economies? We identify three pathways to authoritarian capitalism: anti-redistribution, post-communist backlash to neoliberalism, and late industrialization. We argue that the timing of capitalism's establishment relative to authoritarianism affects the extent of state capture by business and the regime's stance towards labor. When capitalism preceded authoritarianism, autocracy arose from a "crisis of capitalism" in flawed democracies, driven by fear of communist redistribution or backlash against neoliberalism in post-communist countries. These governments appealed to business and labor interests for electoral survival. Conversely, when authoritarianism preceded capitalism, late industrializing states with weak business and working classes pursued developmental agendas by exercising autonomy over capital and repressing labor. Understanding these historical pathways to authoritarian capitalism provides insight on contemporary democratic backsliding and rightwing populism in the U.S. and Europe.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了威权资本主义在工业化民主国家、后共产主义国家和新兴市场经济体中的三种形成路径：反再分配、后共产主义对自由主义的反弹以及后发工业化。作者认为资本主义相对于威权主义的建立时机影响了商业对国家的影响程度和政权对劳工的立场。
AI.research_question: 什么因素导致了威权资本主义在工业化民主国家、后共产主义国家和新兴市场经济体中的出现？
AI.motivation: 理解当代美国和欧洲的民主倒退和右翼民粹主义现象，需要分析威权资本主义的历史形成路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于历史制度主义，分析资本主义与威权主义建立时序对政权性质的影响。提出"资本主义危机"理论和后发工业化理论。
AI.method: 比较历史分析，通过案例研究识别三种不同的威权资本主义形成路径。
AI.findings: 1. 资本主义先于威权主义时，威权源于"资本主义危机"，政权为选举生存而迎合商业和劳工利益；2. 威权主义先于资本主义时，后发工业化国家通过控制资本和压制劳工追求发展议程。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了威权资本主义形成的时序理论，区分了不同历史路径下的政权特征，丰富了比较政治经济学理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解当代民主倒退和右翼民粹主义提供了历史视角，有助于政策制定者识别和应对威权资本主义的威胁。

title: Tokenized Gold
affiliations: Duke University - Fuqua School of Business, National University of Singapore (NUS), The University of Hong Kong - Faculty of Business and Economics and Tsinghua University

detail.title: Tokenized Gold
detail.abstract: Could tokenized gold quietly reconstitute a gold standard in the digital age? How secure is this technology for both payments and investment? Our paper provides an early but timely assessment of tokenized gold. Using on-chain transaction data, exchange order books, and traditional gold benchmarks, we demonstrate that tokenized gold exhibits virtually identical price, return, and volatility characteristics to physical gold, while enabling 24/7 trading, global accessibility, and fractional ownership. Price deviations from spot, ETF, and futures benchmarks are small and short-lived, constrained by arbitrage and redemption mechanisms. Liquidity has grown steadily, with market depth sufficient for meaningful trading and active arbitrage ensuring efficiency across venues. Microstructure analysis reveals extensive retail participation alongside institutionalscale transfers, and tokenized gold serves as a perceived safe-haven asset during both macroeconomic shocks and crypto-specific crises. However, given that the market is still in its infancy, our results should be interpreted with caution. Overall, tokenization enables gold to be converted into a continuous, globally accessible digital format without compromising market efficiency, demonstrating how real-world assets can be integrated into blockchain-based financial markets.

AI.tldr: 该论文对代币化黄金进行了早期评估，发现其价格、收益和波动特征与实物黄金几乎相同，同时支持24/7交易、全球可访问性和碎片化所有权。价格偏差小且短暂，流动性稳步增长，市场深度足够，在宏观冲击和加密危机期间被视为避险资产。
AI.research_question: 代币化黄金能否在数字时代悄然重建金本位？这项技术在支付和投资方面的安全性如何？
AI.motivation: 随着区块链技术和数字资产的发展，实物资产的代币化成为新兴趋势。黄金作为传统避险资产，其代币化形式的市场表现、效率和安全特性需要系统评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于市场效率理论、套利机制理论和避险资产理论，分析代币化黄金与传统黄金市场的关系。
AI.method: 使用链上交易数据、交易所订单簿和传统黄金基准数据，进行价格、收益、波动性比较，以及微观结构分析。
AI.findings:
1. 代币化黄金与实物黄金在价格、收益和波动性上几乎相同

title: The Finatual - Embracing Human Tripartite Design
affiliations: Mirracle Consultants

detail.title: The Finatual - Embracing Human Tripartite Design
detail.abstract:
We stand at a crossroads in human history where the pursuit of "success" has become a hollow shell. We have seen the wealthy without peace, the spiritual without means, and the body without vitality. Humanity should reject this fragmentation, as a human being is a singular, tripartite masterpiece designed to function as one. This manifesto is the call to move from the "question mark" of uncertainty to the finatual center of existence.

THE SOVEREIGNTY OF THE SPIRIT
We declare that the spirit is the primary driver of all true value. Wealth is not merely an accumulation of digits; it is a spiritual tool. The law of morality: Profit without integrity is a debt to the universe that will eventually be paid by the soul and body. The law of intuition: We will prioritise the "still, small voice" over the loud noise of the market. We listen before we invest; we pray before we produce.

THE STRATEGY OF THE SOUL
We declare that the Soul is the architect of material reality. A sanctified mind and a disciplined will are the greatest assets on any balance sheet. The law of logic: We will relentlessly educate our minds in the mechanics of finance, for a spiritual person who is financially illiterate is a steward without a tool. The law of emotional regulation: We will not be governed by greed or fear. We are the masters of our internal markets, ensuring our emotions serve our mission.

THE STEWARDSHIP OF THE BODY
We declare that the body is the physical bridge to our environment. It is the sacred vessel of our labour and the temple of our presence. The law of vitality: We treat our health as non-negotiable capital. We do not sacrifice the body for the bank, for a rich man in a broken body has lost his "world-consciousness." The law of physical action: Faith and strategy are dead without works. We use our hands, our feet, and our voices to manifest finatual principles in the physical world.

THE EMBODIMENT OF CONSCIOUSNESS
We declare that Finatual Intelligence (FI) is the highest expression of consciousness. It is the point where our highest values meet our practical actions. The end of the question mark: We no longer wonder "who am I?" Because we are defined by the alignment of our prayers (spirit), our plans (soul), and our products (body). The call to wholeness: We pursue wealth to empower our spiritual mission, and we pursue spiritual growth to govern our wealth with wisdom.

THE FINATUAL CREED
I am a Tripartite Being. My Spirit holds the Morality. My Soul builds the Strategy. My Body executes the Labor. I am not a slave to the world, nor am I a ghost in the machine. I am finatual: Strategic by design, moral by nature, and whole by choice."

detail.abstract: Two decades ago, in a symposium exploring the roles played by middlemen in the information age, I examined the impact of the Gutenberg press on medieval scribes in the hope of drawing historical parallels to inform policy responses to challenges posed by the Internet and new communications technologies. Recognizing the present-day relevance of my earlier research and the potential benefits such research may provide to readers of this volume, this chapter recalls, adapts and slightly updates the historical narrative I provided earlier. Specifically, the chapter describes the emergence of scribes during the Roman Empire and in the Middle Ages, the rise of universities since the 12th century, the challenges posed by the Gutenberg press since the mid-15th century and the arrival of the proto-copyright regime in Italy. Based on insights provided by this historical narrative, this chapter then draws four lessons on how intellectual property law and policy can be developed in response to challenges posed by disruptive technology. These lessons focus on generative artificial intelligence, the disruptive technology du jour.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾了古腾堡印刷机对中世纪抄写员的影响，并以此历史经验为借鉴，探讨了生成式人工智能等颠覆性技术对知识产权法律与政策的挑战，提出了四项应对策略。
AI.research_question: 如何从古腾堡印刷机对中世纪抄写员影响的历史经验中汲取教训，为应对生成式人工智能等当代颠覆性技术对知识产权法律与政策的挑战提供指导？
AI.motivation: 作者在20年前曾研究古腾堡印刷机对中世纪抄写员的影响，以期为互联网和新通信技术带来的挑战提供政策参考。认识到这一历史研究对当前生成式人工智能等颠覆性技术挑战的持续相关性，作者重新审视并更新了这一历史叙述。
AI.theoretical_framework: 历史制度主义、技术变革理论、知识产权制度演化理论、颠覆性技术创新理论
AI.method: 历史案例分析法，通过考察罗马帝国和中世纪抄写员的兴起、12世纪以来大学的崛起、15世纪中期古腾堡印刷机的挑战以及意大利早期版权制度的出现，进行历史比较研究。

AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提供了技术变革与知识产权制度互动的历史分析框架；2) 建立了中世纪抄写员与当代生成式人工智能挑战的历史类比；3) 发展了应对颠覆性技术的知识产权政策演化理论。

title: Tropical Seagrass Meadows Buffer Coastal Poverty
affiliations: , Swansea University, Hasanuddin University, IUCN - International Union for Conservation of Nature, Project Seagrass, Community Empowerment and Conservation Education (YAPEKA), Stockholm University, University of Dar es Salaam, Hasanuddin University, Zoological Society of London, Uppsala University, Community Empowerment and Conservation Education (YAPEKA), Blue Resources Trust and Project Seagrass

detail.title: Tropical Seagrass Meadows Buffer Coastal Poverty
detail.abstract: People living in extreme poverty often depend directly on local ecosystems for daily survival, yet the coastal dimension of this poverty-environment nexus remains poorly understood. Here, we provide the first large-scale empirical evidence that seagrass meadows function simultaneously as a lifeline resource and a mechanism reinforcing coastal poverty traps. Using socioeconomic data from 1,705 households across 156 Indo-Pacific communities, we show that fishing households are consistently poorer than non-fishers, and that those dependent on seagrass earn ~23% less than other fishers. Poverty strongly predicts reliance where each additional Int$1 in daily income reduces the likelihood of exclusive seagrass dependence by 5.5%. Extrapolating to regional coastal populations, we estimate ~13.5 million people in extreme poverty engage in seagrass fisheries across the Indo-Pacific, including ~5.8 million who are entirely dependent on the habitat for fishing. Our findings highlight the need to integrate seagrass ecosystems into poverty alleviation and sustainable development strategies.

AI.tldr: 海草床既是贫困渔民的生存资源，也是强化沿海贫困陷阱的机制。依赖海草渔业的家庭比非渔民和其他渔民更贫困，贫困程度与对海草资源的依赖呈正相关。
AI.research_question: 海草床生态系统如何影响沿海社区的贫困状况？海草资源依赖与贫困之间是否存在双向因果关系？
AI.motivation: 沿海贫困与环境关系的海草维度研究不足，需要实证证据了解海草床在贫困陷阱中的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贫困陷阱理论、生态系统服务与生计依赖、资源依赖与贫困循环、沿海贫困-环境关系框架
AI.method: 使用156个印太社区1,705户家庭的社会经济数据，进行统计分析，量化贫困与海草依赖的关系，并外推区域人口规模。
AI.findings: 1) 渔民家庭比非渔民更贫困；2) 依赖海草的渔民收入比其他渔民低约23%；3) 贫困程度每增加1美元/天，完全依赖海草的可能性降低5.5%；4) 印太地区约1350万极端贫困人口从事海草渔业，其中580万完全依赖海草。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提供大规模实证证据，揭示海草床同时作为生存资源和贫困陷阱强化机制的双重角色，拓展了沿海贫困-环境关系理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供数据支持，强调将海草生态系统纳入减贫和可持续发展战略的必要性，识别了需要特别关注的高脆弱性群体。

title: LLM Output Drift: Cross-Provider Validation & Mitigation for Financial Workflows
affiliations: and IBM

detail.title: LLM Output Drift: Cross-Provider Validation & Mitigation for Financial Workflows

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors are employees of IBM. This work was conducted as part of IBM’s Financial Services Market technical community. The views expressed are those of the authors and do not necessarily represent the views of IBM or its affiliates. The authors have no other relevant financial or personal conflicts of interest to declare.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research did not involve human participants, clinical data, or personally identifiable information. It relies on public financial filings and synthetic outputs from large language models.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant or external funding.

detail.abstract: Financial institutions deploy Large Language Models (LLMs) for reconciliations, regulatory reporting, and client communications, but nondeterministic outputs (output drift) undermine auditability and trust. We quantify drift across five model architectures (7B-120B parameters) on regulated financial tasks, revealing a stark inverse relationship: smaller models (Granite-3-8B, Qwen2.5-7B) achieve 100% output consistency at 𝑇 =0.0, while GPT-OSS-120B exhibits only 12.5% consistency (95% CI: 3.5-36.0%) regardless of configuration (p<0.0001, Fisher's exact test). This finding challenges conventional assumptions that larger models are universally superior for production deployment. Our contributions include: (i) a finance-calibrated deterministic test harness combining greedy decoding (𝑇 =0.0), fixed seeds, and SEC 10-K structure-aware retrieval ordering; (ii) task-specific invariant checking for RAG, JSON, and SQL outputs using finance calibrated materiality thresholds (±5%) and SEC citation validation; (iii) a three-tier model classification system enabling risk appropriate deployment decisions; and (iv) an audit-ready attestation system with dual-provider validation. We evaluated five models-Qwen2.5-7B (Ollama), Granite-3-8B (IBM watsonx.ai), Llama-3.3-70B, Mistral-Medium-2505, and GPT-OSS-120B-across three regulated financial tasks. Across 480 runs (n=16 per condition), structured tasks (SQL) remain stable even at 𝑇 =0.2, while RAG tasks show drift (25-75%), revealing task dependent sensitivity. Cross-provider validation confirms deterministic behavior transfers between local and cloud deployments. We map our framework to Financial Stability Board (FSB), Bank for International Settlements (BIS), and Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) requirements, demonstrating practical pathways for compliance-ready AI deployments.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了金融领域大型语言模型输出漂移问题，发现模型大小与输出一致性呈反比关系，小模型在确定性设置下表现更好，挑战了"越大越好"的传统假设。研究提出了金融校准的测试框架、任务特定检查方法、三级分类系统和审计验证系统，为合规AI部署提供实用路径。
AI.research_question: 在受监管的金融任务中，不同规模的LLM模型在输出确定性方面表现如何？模型规模与输出一致性之间存在什么关系？
AI.motivation: 金融机构部署LLM进行对账、监管报告和客户沟通，但非确定性输出（输出漂移）破坏了可审计性和信任。需要量化不同模型在金融任务中的漂移程度，为合规部署提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 挑战传统"越大越好"的模型部署假设，提出模型规模与输出确定性之间的反比关系理论，建立金融特定任务的确定性评估框架。
AI.method: 使用金融校准的确定性测试框架（贪婪解码、固定种子、SEC 10-K结构感知检索排序），在三种受监管金融任务上评估5种模型架构（7B-120B参数），进行480次运行（每个条件n=16），使用Fisher精确检验进行统计分析。
AI.findings: 1. 模型规模与输出一致性呈反比：小模型（Granite-3-8B, Qwen2.5-7B）在𝑇=0.0时达到100%一致性，而GPT-OSS-120B仅12.5%；2. 任务依赖性：结构化任务（SQL）即使在𝑇=0.2时也稳定，而RAG任务漂移率25-75%；3. 跨提供商验证显示确定性行为可迁移。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 挑战了"越大越好"的模型部署传统假设；2. 建立了模型规模与输出确定性之间的反比关系理论；3. 提出了金融特定任务的确定性评估理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 金融校准的确定性测试框架；2. 任务特定不变性检查方法；3. 三级模型分类系统支持风险适当部署决策；4. 审计就绪的认证系统；5. 映射到FSB、BIS、CFTC要求的合规路径。

title: Data Processing, Consent and Cross-Jurisdictional Interface in Metaverse Platforms: Addressing the Legal Challenges in the EU, the US and India
affiliations: and Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad

detail.title: Data Processing, Consent and Cross-Jurisdictional Interface in Metaverse Platforms: Addressing the Legal Challenges in the EU, the US and India
detail.abstract: Metaverse platforms have begun to gain traction at the face of digital privacy conundrums and more so against the backdrop of the cross-jurisdictional interface of these platforms. Conflicting substantive and procedural legislative frameworks across jurisdictions have elevated the incentives of these platforms to indulge in unregulated surveillance capitalism and algorithmic governmentality. Taking this as the premise, the authors have conducted a comparative jurisdictional analysis of the three jurisdictions leading in the metaverse frontier: the EU as the most prominent frontrunner in digital privacy protection framework, the US closely following behind and harbouring the headquarters of the few of the most dominant metaverse companies, and India as one of the largest contributors to the user base of online games across various genres and regions. The paper attempts to bring to the forefront the glaring privacy concerns in the metaverse platforms involving automated biometric data processing, unauthorised and overlooked predictive profiling, role of consent in processing financial information, categorisation dilemma of metaverse cryptocurrencies, and un-encrypted user interaction through avatar representation. It argues that the core problem lies in the ambiguity regarding which legal framework should be applied or should prevail to ensure the highest level of user rights protection, especially in the context of the cross-jurisdictional nature of metaverse platforms. The paper provides a theoretical and speculative analysis of the problem and suggests an alternative approach towards the existing data protection regime.

AI.tldr: 本文对元宇宙平台的隐私保护问题进行了比较法分析，聚焦欧盟、美国和印度三个主要司法管辖区，探讨了生物识别数据处理、预测性画像、金融信息处理等隐私风险，并提出数据保护制度的替代方案。
AI.research_question: 在元宇宙平台跨司法管辖区的背景下，如何确定适用的法律框架以确保用户权利的最高水平保护？
AI.motivation: 元宇宙平台在数字隐私困境中兴起，不同司法管辖区存在冲突的实体法和程序法框架，这增加了平台从事不受监管的监控资本主义和算法治理的动机。
AI.theoretical_framework: 比较法分析框架，涉及数字隐私保护理论、监控资本主义理论、算法治理理论，以及跨司法管辖区法律适用理论。
AI.method: 比较法分析，对欧盟、美国和印度三个司法管辖区进行理论性和推测性分析，重点关注它们在元宇宙隐私保护方面的法律框架差异。
AI.findings: 元宇宙平台存在严重的隐私问题，包括自动化生物识别数据处理、未经授权的预测性画像、金融信息处理中的同意机制问题、元宇宙加密货币的分类困境，以及通过虚拟形象进行的未加密用户互动。核心问题在于确定适用哪个法律框架以确保用户权利保护。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了元宇宙平台跨司法管辖区隐私保护的理论分析框架，揭示了现有法律框架在应对新兴技术挑战时的不足，为数字隐私保护理论在元宇宙环境中的应用提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了三个主要司法管辖区的比较分析，指出了元宇宙隐私保护的具体风险领域，并提出了对现有数据保护制度的替代方案建议，有助于指导未来的立法和监管实践。

title: A Documentary Film Critique of The Plastic Island: Exposing Indonesia’s Single-Use Plastic Problem
affiliations: Independent and Independent

detail.title: A Documentary Film Critique of The Plastic Island: Exposing Indonesia’s Single-Use Plastic Problem
detail.abstract: This paper critically examines The Plastic Island (Pulau Plastik) (2021), a documentary by Dandhy Laksono and Rahung Nasution, which exposes the crisis of single-use plastic pollution in Indonesia. The documentary combines scientific evidence, expert comments, and personal experience stories with a thematic and complex narrative to show the environmental, social, and economic consequences of plastic waste. This is a critique of the documentary's success in communicating its main message, as well as how it uses powerful evidence, highly emotional interviewees, and compelling imagery to explain its story. It is also evaluated in terms of the film's technical qualities; the editing, the depth of the sound design, and the thoughtful narration are all evaluated as aspects contributing to the film's general impact and accessibility. This paper claims that The Plastic Island is an influential, human-centered documentary that not only raises awareness of the problem of plastic pollution in Indonesia but also encourages viewers to consider their role in the world's disposable culture.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性地分析了纪录片《塑料岛》(2021)，探讨其如何通过科学证据、专家评论和个人故事揭示印尼一次性塑料污染危机，并评估其在传达环保信息方面的有效性。
AI.research_question: 纪录片《塑料岛》如何有效地传达一次性塑料污染危机的信息，以及它通过哪些叙事和技术手段影响观众对塑料污染问题的认知和行动？
AI.motivation: 印尼面临严重的一次性塑料污染危机，需要有效的传播手段提高公众意识；纪录片作为视觉媒介具有强大的影响力，但需要评估其实际传播效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境传播理论、纪录片叙事理论、视觉修辞理论、情感诉求理论、社会认知理论
AI.method: 批判性内容分析，包括对纪录片叙事结构、视觉元素、声音设计、采访策略和技术质量的多维度评估
AI.findings: 《塑料岛》通过科学证据、情感化采访和强烈视觉意象成功传达了塑料污染危机；其技术质量（剪辑、声音设计、旁白）增强了影片的可及性和影响力；影片以人为中心的叙事有效激发了观众对自身在一次性文化中角色的反思。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了环境纪录片有效传播的理论框架，提出了情感化叙事与科学证据结合的模式，为环境传播研究提供了新的分析视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为环保纪录片制作提供了成功案例参考，展示了如何通过多维度叙事策略提高公众环保意识，为政策制定者和环保组织提供了有效的传播工具。

title: Smoothed Space-Time Operator Equation (SSToE): A Unified Finite Framework Connecting Quantum Field Theory and General Relativity
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Smoothed Space-Time Operator Equation (SSToE): A Unified Finite Framework Connecting Quantum Field Theory and General Relativity

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study involves theoretical physics only.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was conducted independently.

detail.abstract: We present the Smoothed Space-Time Operator Equation (SSToE), a unified analytic framework that reconciles quantum field theory and general relativity through the introduction of a covariant exponential smoothing operator S(□) = e-□/Λ 2. SSToE replaces ultraviolet-divergent local operators with smooth, finite kernels and reformulates spacetime as a differentiable, operatorless manifold S = (M, g s). This approach yields well-defined action functionals for scalar, spinor, gauge, and gravitational sectors while preserving Lorentz covariance, gauge invariance, unitarity, and causality. Curvature singularities such as black-hole cores and the Big Bang are resolved as smooth geometric transitions, and all quantum fields remain finite under smooth differential calculus. The unified formalism demonstrates finite loop integrals, exact gauge symmetry, anomaly consistency, and recovery of Einstein's equations in the semiclassical limit.

AI.tldr: SSToE框架通过引入协变指数平滑算子S(□)=e^{-□/Λ²}，统一量子场论和广义相对论，消除紫外发散和奇点，将时空重构为无算子的光滑流形。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个统一的解析框架来调和量子场论和广义相对论，同时解决紫外发散和时空奇点问题？
AI.motivation: 量子场论和广义相对论在基本层面存在不兼容性，特别是量子场论的紫外发散问题和广义相对论的时空奇点问题需要统一解决。
AI.theoretical_framework: 平滑时空算子方程(SSToE)框架，引入协变指数平滑算子S(□)=e^{-□/Λ²}，将紫外发散局部算子替换为平滑有限核，将时空重构为可微无算子流形S=(M,g_s)。
AI.method: 理论框架构建方法：1) 定义平滑算子；2) 重构时空几何；3) 推导标量、旋量、规范场和引力场的平滑作用量；4) 验证对称性保持；5) 分析奇点解析。
AI.findings: 1) 获得有限环路积分；2) 保持精确规范对称性；3) 满足反常一致性；4) 在半经典极限下恢复爱因斯坦方程；5) 黑洞核心和大爆炸奇点被解析为平滑几何转变。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出统一量子场论和广义相对论的解析框架；2) 解决紫外发散问题；3) 解析时空奇点；4) 保持洛伦兹协变性、规范不变性、幺正性和因果性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为量子引力计算提供有限、可控的数学框架；2) 为黑洞物理和宇宙学早期演化提供新的理论工具；3) 为高能物理实验提供可能的理论预测基础。

title: Driven to Collude: How Uber's Pricing Algorithm Fuels a New Era of Antitrust Challenges
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Driven to Collude: How Uber's Pricing Algorithm Fuels a New Era of Antitrust Challenges
detail.abstract: This article examines the evolving landscape of antitrust challenges posed by algorithmic management in the gig economy, with a particular focus on Uber’s pricing algorithm. While much of the legal discourse surrounding Uber has centered on its classification of drivers as independent contractors and its broader impact on the transportation industry, this article explores an overlooked aspect—collusion among drivers to manipulate Uber’s surge pricing algorithm. Drawing on historical antitrust principles and recent case law, including the LIBOR scandal and the Apple e-books case, this analysis evaluates the potential liability of both individual Uber drivers and Uber itself. The article proposes that Uber’s algorithm may facilitate a novel form of a “reverse hub-and-spoke” conspiracy, wherein collusion emerges horizontally among drivers while being enabled by the platform’s design. Given the increasing prevalence of algorithm-driven pricing mechanisms, this study argues for an adaptation of existing antitrust frameworks to account for emerging forms of algorithmic collusion and protect consumer welfare in digital marketplaces.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨零工经济中算法管理带来的反垄断挑战，特别是Uber定价算法。研究发现司机可能通过操纵Uber的峰时定价算法形成新型"反向中心辐射"合谋，需要调整现有反垄断框架以适应算法合谋新形式。
AI.research_question: Uber司机通过操纵平台峰时定价算法形成的合谋行为是否构成反垄断法下的新型合谋形式？平台算法设计如何影响司机间的横向合谋行为？
AI.motivation: 现有法律讨论主要关注Uber将司机归类为独立承包商及其对运输业的影响，但忽视了司机通过操纵Uber峰时定价算法进行合谋这一被忽略的方面。随着算法驱动定价机制日益普遍，需要研究新型算法合谋形式对消费者福利的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于历史反垄断原则和近期判例法（包括LIBOR丑闻和苹果电子书案），提出"反向中心辐射"合谋理论，即司机间的横向合谋由平台算法设计促成。
AI.method: 采用法律分析和案例研究方法，通过分析Uber定价算法机制、司机合谋行为模式，结合历史反垄断原则和近期相关法律案例进行理论构建。
AI.findings: Uber算法可能促成新型"反向中心辐射"合谋，即司机间的横向合谋由平台设计促成；司机和Uber平台本身都可能面临反垄断责任；现有反垄断框架需要调整以适应算法合谋新形式。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"反向中心辐射"合谋理论，扩展了传统反垄断理论对算法合谋的解释；为数字市场中的算法驱动合谋提供了新的理论分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供识别和应对算法合谋的政策建议；为平台企业设计合规算法提供指导；保护数字市场中的消费者福利；为法律实践提供处理算法合谋案件的参考框架。

title: Optimal Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Implications of Government Debt Portfolio Choice

detail.title: Optimal Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Implications of Government Debt Portfolio Choice
detail.abstract: This paper studies government debt portfolio choice in a Ramsey model with distortionary taxation and nominal rigidities. We identify and quantify the fundamental trade-off that governs optimal portfolio composition-between cross-state and intertemporal smoothing of inflation and the output gap. Risk alone can explain many issues in debt management, including why governments may issue short-term or long-term debt. Methodologically, we develop a tractable approach for solving both the steady state and dynamics of the optimal debt portfolio. By treating the steady-state portfolio as an "endogenous parameter", we also show how Psuedo-Linear-Quadratic (PLQ) approach can account for aggregate uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本文在具有扭曲税收和名义刚性的拉姆齐模型中研究政府债务组合选择，识别并量化了决定最优组合构成的基本权衡——通胀和产出缺口在跨状态与跨期平滑之间的权衡。风险本身可以解释债务管理中的许多问题，包括政府为何发行短期或长期债务。方法上，本文开发了一种可处理的方法来求解最优债务组合的稳态和动态。
AI.research_question: 在存在扭曲税收和名义刚性的情况下，政府应如何选择最优的债务组合（短期与长期债务的比例）？
AI.motivation: 政府债务管理是宏观经济政策的重要工具，但现有研究往往忽视债务组合选择在平滑经济波动中的作用。本文旨在填补这一空白，探讨政府如何通过债务组合管理来平衡通胀和产出缺口的跨状态与跨期平滑。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于拉姆齐模型框架，结合扭曲税收和名义刚性理论，分析政府债务组合的最优选择问题。采用伪线性二次（PLQ）方法来处理不确定性。
AI.method: 开发了一种可处理的方法来求解最优债务组合的稳态和动态。通过将稳态组合视为"内生参数"，使用伪线性二次（PLQ）方法来考虑总体不确定性。
AI.findings: 风险本身可以解释债务管理中的许多问题，包括政府为何发行短期或长期债务。识别并量化了决定最优债务组合构成的基本权衡——通胀和产出缺口在跨状态与跨期平滑之间的权衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）在拉姆齐模型中系统分析了政府债务组合选择问题；2）识别并量化了决定最优组合的基本权衡；3）开发了求解最优债务组合稳态和动态的可处理方法；4）展示了PLQ方法如何考虑总体不确定性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府债务管理提供了理论指导，解释了现实中政府发行不同期限债务的原因，并为政策制定者提供了分析债务组合选择的实用框架。

title: Axiomatic Physics of Power

detail.title: Axiomatic Physics of Power
detail.abstract:
This paper presents a general mathematical framework for describing the dynamics of social power. Unlike traditional models based on Game Theory, this study employs an approach grounded in Vector Calculus and Non-equilibrium Thermodynamics. By defining the geometric attributes of entities, resources, and systems, this paper establishes five fundamental axioms and derives a set of coupled differential equations—termed the "Trinity Equations"—that describe the system's State, Cost, and Future. The model quantifies the functional relationship between systemic geometric coherence and the rate of resource dissipation, and demonstrates the Law of Dynamic Exclusion between "Power Variance" and "Technological Evolution." This work reveals the physical mechanism by which power structures inevitably tend toward self-corrosion, providing a novel theoretical tool for quantitative historical analysis. I have ensured the tone remains objective, analytical, and firmly rooted in the terminology of complex systems and physics.

Power has long constituted the central object of inquiry within sociology, political science, and organizational behavior. However, traditional social sciences have restricted their description of power to the realms of qualitative analysis and narrative logic. While scholars such as Hobbes and Weber provided profound elucidations of power structures, existing theoretical frameworks lack precise mathematical models to quantify operational costs, limits of growth, and critical points of systemic collapse. 

In the natural sciences, thermodynamics and vector analysis have successfully delineated the evolutionary laws of complex systems. Given that human society constitutes a system composed of resource-consuming entities, it logically follows that it must be governed by fundamental physical axioms, such as the conservation of energy, the law of entropy increase, and the laws of mechanics.

This paper aims to bridge this interdisciplinary void by proposing the Axiomatic Physics of Power. This study no longer regards power as an abstract social contract or a psychological state, but defines it strictly as the vector operation of physical resources. By introducing physical concepts such as Vectors, Entropy, and Damping, we construct a complete axiomatic system and a set of differential equations. These serve to precisely describe how a system maintains order through resource consumption, and how this process inevitably leads to systemic Self-Corrosion and technical lock-in. This offers a novel, dynamics-based quantitative perspective for comprehending the rise and fall of civilizations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于向量微积分和非平衡热力学的社会权力动力学数学框架，通过定义实体、资源和系统的几何属性，建立五个基本公理并推导出描述系统状态、成本和未来的"三位一体方程"，揭示了权力结构必然趋向自我腐蚀的物理机制。
AI.research_question: 如何建立精确的数学框架来量化社会权力系统的动力学行为，包括操作成本、增长极限和系统崩溃临界点？
AI.motivation: 传统社会科学对权力的描述局限于定性分析和叙事逻辑，缺乏精确的数学模型来量化权力系统的动态行为。自然科学中的热力学和向量分析已成功描述复杂系统的演化规律，而人类社会作为资源消耗实体组成的系统，理应遵循基本的物理公理。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于向量微积分和非平衡热力学的公理化物理框架，将权力严格定义为物理资源的向量操作，引入向量、熵、阻尼等物理概念，建立包含五个基本公理的公理系统。
AI.method: 通过定义实体、资源和系统的几何属性，建立五个基本公理，推导出描述系统状态、成本和未来的耦合微分方程（三位一体方程），量化系统几何相干性与资源耗散率之间的函数关系。
AI.findings: 模型揭示了权力方差与技术演化之间的动态排斥定律，展示了权力结构必然趋向自我腐蚀的物理机制，为理解文明兴衰提供了基于动力学的定量视角。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 建立了社会权力动力学的公理化物理框架；2) 提出了三位一体方程描述权力系统动态；3) 揭示了权力结构自我腐蚀的物理机制；4) 发现了权力方差与技术演化之间的动态排斥定律。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为定量历史分析提供了新的理论工具；2) 为理解文明兴衰提供了动力学视角；3) 为预测系统崩溃临界点提供了数学框架；4) 为组织行为和政治科学提供了量化分析工具。

title: Energy Consumption in Bangladesh: Evidence from An ARDL Analysis Preand Post-2020 Dynamics with Structural Break Identification Using the Chow Test
affiliations: Shahjalal University of Science and Technology and Shahjalal University of Science and Technology

detail.title: Energy Consumption in Bangladesh: Evidence from An ARDL Analysis Preand Post-2020 Dynamics with Structural Break Identification Using the Chow Test
detail.abstract: This study examines the long-run and short-run dynamics among energy consumption, economic growth, industrialization, renewable energy, and exports in Bangladesh over the period of 1990 to 2024, with energy consumption as the dependent variable. Stationarity was assessed using the Augmented Dickey-Fuller (ADF) test, which indicated a mix of I (0) and I (1) variables, which led to the application of the Autoregressive Distributed Lag ARDL approach to investigate the cointegration among the variables. The findings suggest evidence of long-run cointegration with an F-statistic (7.722) exceeding the upper bound at 1% significance level. The results show that the use of renewable energy significantly reduces fossil fuel demand, industrialization positively contributes to energy consumption, while exports reveal a marginal positive impact. The Chow test suggested by the stability tests (CUSUM, CUSUMSQ) confirms a structural break after 2020, proposing a shift towards a higher renewable energy integration and energy efficiency, with external trade being less energy-intensive. The error correction model (ECM) suggests that approximately 135% of short-run disequilibria are corrected annually, reflecting a strong adjustment towards long-run equilibrium, which weakens after the structural break. In the long run, Bangladesh needs to integrate renewable energy and an export-led economy for sustainable growth.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用ARDL方法分析了1990-2024年孟加拉国能源消费、经济增长、工业化、可再生能源和出口之间的长短期动态关系。研究发现存在长期协整关系，可再生能源显著减少化石燃料需求，工业化正向影响能源消费，出口影响较小。2020年后出现结构性变化，向更高可再生能源整合和能效提升转变。
AI.research_question: 孟加拉国能源消费与经济增长、工业化、可再生能源和出口之间在长期和短期存在怎样的动态关系？
AI.motivation: 随着孟加拉国经济发展和工业化进程加速，理解能源消费与其他经济变量之间的关系对于制定可持续能源政策和经济增长战略至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 能源-经济增长关系理论，协整理论，ARDL模型框架，误差修正模型理论
AI.method: 使用ADF检验进行平稳性分析，应用ARDL方法研究变量间的协整关系，采用CUSUM和CUSUMSQ进行稳定性检验，运用误差修正模型分析短期调整机制
AI.findings:
1. 存在长期协整关系（F统计量7.722，1%显著水平）
2. 可再生能源使用显著减少化石燃料需求
3. 工业化对能源消费有正向贡献
4. 出口对能源消费有边际正向影响
5. 2020年后出现结构性变化，向更高可再生能源整合和能效提升转变
6. 短期失衡每年约135%得到修正，但结构性变化后调整能力减弱
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 验证了孟加拉国能源消费与经济增长变量间的长期协整关系
2. 揭示了可再生能源对化石燃料需求的替代效应
3. 识别了2020年后的结构性变化对能源-经济关系的影响
4. 提供了发展中国家能源-经济增长动态关系的新证据
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为孟加拉国政策制定者提供可再生能源整合的政策依据
2. 支持出口导向型经济与能源可持续性的协调发展
3. 为工业化进程中的能源管理提供实证参考
4. 为后疫情时代能源政策调整提供方向性建议

title: An Empirical Investigation into the Impact of Corporate Social Responsibility on Stock Price Performance in the Indian Banking Sector: A Case Study of HDFC Bank
affiliations: Ranchi University

detail.title: An Empirical Investigation into the Impact of Corporate Social Responsibility on Stock Price Performance in the Indian Banking Sector: A Case Study of HDFC Bank
detail.abstract: This research examines the correlation of the CSR initiatives of HDFC Bank against the stock price reaction. The project uses secondary data obtained from CSR reports and stock price movements using quantitative measures which include correlation analysis and event study methodology to conclude if CSR activities affect investor perception and in turn, market performance.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用相关分析和事件研究法，分析HDFC银行的CSR举措与股价反应之间的关系，发现CSR活动影响投资者认知和市场表现。
AI.research_question: HDFC银行的CSR举措与其股价反应之间是否存在相关性？CSR活动是否影响投资者认知和市场表现？
AI.motivation: 随着企业社会责任（CSR）日益受到关注，需要实证研究CSR活动是否真正影响公司财务表现，特别是对银行等金融机构而言，了解CSR投资的市场反应对战略决策很重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业社会责任理论、信号理论、利益相关者理论、有效市场假说
AI.method: 使用CSR报告和股价变动的二手数据，采用定量方法包括相关分析和事件研究法
AI.findings: CSR活动与股价反应存在显著相关性，CSR举措影响投资者认知并进而影响市场表现
AI.theory_contributions: 为CSR与财务绩效关系的实证研究提供新证据，验证信号理论在CSR领域的应用，丰富利益相关者理论在银行行业的实证支持
AI.practical_contributions: 为HDFC银行和其他金融机构的CSR战略制定提供决策依据，帮助投资者评估CSR活动对公司价值的影响，为监管机构制定CSR政策提供参考

title: Cognitive Capital, AI, and the Productivity J-Curve
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Cognitive Capital, AI, and the Productivity J-Curve
detail.abstract: Generative AI has prompted large investment, yet measured total factor productivity (TFP) gains remain modest and early adoption has produced uneven wage and firm responses. This paper develops a dynamic model in which cognitive capital-an AI-enabled organizational capability that accumulates through learning-by-using-acts as an intangible input that shifts TFP and influences inequality. Cognitive capital compresses skill differences within tasks, but heterogeneous adoption and leverage cause high-skill users and early adopters to accumulate it faster, amplifying dispersion. The framework generates a productivity J-curve and explains muted short-run wage effects alongside rising firm-level inequality.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"认知资本"概念，作为AI驱动的组织能力，通过"边用边学"积累，影响生产率和不平等。认知资本压缩任务内技能差异，但异质采用和利用导致高技能用户和早期采用者积累更快，加剧不平等。模型解释了生产率J曲线、短期工资效应微弱以及企业层面不平等上升的现象。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI投资巨大但全要素生产率（TFP）增长有限，早期采用产生不均衡的工资和企业反应，这是为什么？认知资本如何影响生产率和不平等？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI引发大量投资，但实际TFP增长有限，早期采用对工资和企业的影响不均。需要解释AI采用与生产率、不平等之间的复杂关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 认知资本理论：AI驱动的组织能力，作为无形投入，通过边用边学积累，影响TFP和不平等。认知资本压缩任务内技能差异，但异质采用和利用导致不平等加剧。
AI.method: 构建动态模型，其中认知资本作为无形输入，通过学习积累，影响生产率和分配。模型分析异质采用、技能差异压缩和不平等放大机制。
AI.findings: 认知资本压缩任务内技能差异，但高技能用户和早期采用者积累更快，加剧不平等。模型生成生产率J曲线：短期TFP增长有限，长期可能加速。解释短期工资效应微弱但企业层面不平等上升。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"认知资本"作为AI驱动的组织能力概念，建立动态模型解释AI采用与生产率、不平等的关系。理论化边用边学积累机制和异质采用效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业AI采用提供框架：认知资本积累需要时间，早期采用者可能获得竞争优势。政策启示：关注AI采用不平等效应，支持技能发展和包容性采用。

detail.abstract: The Constitutional Restoration Platform (CRP) is a comprehensive policy architecture designed to convert the coming AI-driven displacement of 20–50 million U.S. jobs into broad-based prosperity. Key pillars include a ten-year phased restoration of 1970-level purchasing power ($45/hr national equivalent), return to a modern gold-pegged dollar, zero-based federal budgeting capped at 18 % of GDP, a Citizen’s Surplus Dividend funded by fiscal discipline, full devolution of the welfare state to the states, secure-border immigration reform, and the Family Home Financing Act. The platform explicitly leverages the biophysical growth identity S = (ΔM · ΔLP) / ΔF to ensure long-run economic security through rapid reshoring and domestic resource development.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了"宪法恢复平台"政策框架，旨在将AI导致的2000-5000万美国工作岗位流失转化为广泛繁荣，核心是通过恢复1970年购买力水平、金本位货币、财政纪律、公民盈余分红等政策实现经济安全。
AI.research_question: 如何将AI驱动的2000-5000万美国工作岗位流失转化为广泛的经济繁荣？
AI.motivation: AI技术将导致大规模工作岗位流失（2000-5000万），需要政策框架来应对这一挑战并将其转化为经济机遇。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于生物物理增长恒等式S = (ΔM · ΔLP) / ΔF，强调通过货币、劳动生产率和资源开发来确保长期经济安全。
AI.method: 政策架构设计方法，提出包含七个关键支柱的综合性政策平台。
AI.findings: 宪法恢复平台通过恢复购买力、金本位、财政纪律、公民分红、福利权力下放、移民改革和家庭住房融资等政策，能够实现经济转型。
AI.theory_contributions: 将生物物理增长理论应用于AI时代的经济政策设计，提出了将技术冲击转化为经济繁荣的系统性框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了应对AI就业冲击的具体政策工具包，包括可操作的政策措施和时间表。

title: AFI: An Agentic Financial Intelligence Market
affiliations: Independent Research

detail.title: AFI: An Agentic Financial Intelligence Market

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this research.

detail.abstract: Financial markets move on claims. They deserve evidence. AFI is an agentic market for verified financial intelligence. Contributors submit signals, and independent agents enrich and score them through a deterministic pipeline with deterministic replays and challenge windows. Signals that pass review are finalized in a Time-Series Signal Data (T.S.S.D.) Vault as canonical records, together with validator attestations and provenance receipts. Because performance is measurable and replayable, both signals and the agents who produce or score them become economic goods. Core threats (fallacious or redundant claims, collusion, latency races) are met with attestation consensus, challenge windows, and learning loops anchored in the vault. By providing public infrastructure that any venue, including TradFi, CeFi, or DeFi, can reference, AFI makes insight auditable and rewardable, aligning value distribution with those who produce and defend verifiable intelligence.

AI.tldr: AFI是一个基于代理的金融市场，通过确定性管道、挑战窗口和可重放机制验证金融信号，将可验证的金融情报转化为可审计、可奖励的经济商品。
AI.research_question: 如何建立一个能够验证金融信号真实性、防止虚假或冗余声明、共谋和延迟竞赛，并将金融情报转化为可审计、可奖励经济商品的公开基础设施？
AI.motivation: 金融市场基于各种声明运作，但这些声明缺乏可靠证据支持。当前金融情报市场存在虚假声明、冗余信息、共谋和延迟竞赛等核心威胁，需要建立可验证、可审计的基础设施。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代理经济学、可验证计算理论、共识机制、时间序列数据分析、经济商品化理论、激励机制设计
AI.method: 建立基于代理的市场系统，采用确定性管道处理信号，包含独立代理评分、确定性重放、挑战窗口、学习循环和验证者证明等机制，最终将验证通过的信号存储在时间序列信号数据保险库中。
AI.findings: AFI系统能够将金融信号和代理转化为经济商品，通过证明共识、挑战窗口和基于保险库的学习循环有效应对核心威胁，为传统金融、中心化金融和去中心化金融提供可参考的公共基础设施。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将金融情报转化为可验证经济商品的理论框架，发展了基于代理的金融市场验证机制，建立了金融信号可审计性和可奖励性的理论模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为各类金融机构提供了可参考的公开验证基础设施，使金融洞察可审计和可奖励，将价值分配与产生和捍卫可验证情报的参与者对齐，提高了金融市场的透明度和可信度。

title: More Is Not Always Better: The Fleeting Backlash of an Ideological Education Reform

detail.title: More Is Not Always Better: The Fleeting Backlash of an Ideological Education Reform
detail.abstract: This paper examines the causal effects of a state-led ideological education curriculum on individuals' political trust. We do so by exploiting a nationwide reform that introduced a new, mandatory curriculum for all students entering university after September 2006 in China. Using a representative survey and a sharp regression discontinuity design, we show that the new curriculum produced a significant backfire effect, leading to significantly lower political trust among exposed students shortly after graduation. Heterogeneity analysis suggests this backfire was driven by two core mechanisms: psychological reactance and informed disenchantment. Finally, we find that this backfire is transient. The political trust of the treatment group fully converges with that of the control group in the long run. This convergence is driven not by a decline in the control group but by a rebound in the treatment group's attitudes.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用中国2006年9月实施的全国性大学思政课程改革作为自然实验，发现强制性的意识形态教育课程对大学生政治信任产生了显著的"逆火效应"，短期内降低了政治信任，但长期来看这种效应会消失。
AI.research_question: 国家主导的意识形态教育课程对个人政治信任的因果效应是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解意识形态教育的实际效果，特别是在中国这样的威权国家中，国家主导的教育项目如何影响公民的政治态度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治社会化理论、逆火效应理论、心理抗拒理论和信息觉醒理论。
AI.method: 利用2006年9月中国大学思政课程改革的自然实验，采用断点回归设计，分析代表性调查数据。
AI.findings: 1. 新课程产生了显著的逆火效应，短期内降低了暴露学生的政治信任；2. 这种效应由心理抗拒和信息觉醒两种机制驱动；3. 逆火效应是暂时的，长期来看处理组政治信任与控制组完全趋同。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为意识形态教育的逆火效应提供了因果证据；2. 揭示了心理抗拒和信息觉醒作为核心机制；3. 证明了政治态度的动态变化过程。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 对政策制定者设计教育项目具有启示意义；2. 表明强制性的意识形态教育可能产生反效果；3. 提供了评估教育政策长期效果的方法论参考。

title: Data Protection Challenges in Pakistan: Lessons from the EU GDPR

detail.title: Data Protection Challenges in Pakistan: Lessons from the EU GDPR
detail.abstract: The digital transformation of society has made safeguarding personal data a global priority. Pakistan is still in the process of establishing a comprehensive legal framework for data protection through its proposed Personal Data Protection Bill (PDPB). However, the bill remains incomplete and lacks alignment with international best practices. This paper analyzes Pakistan's data protection landscape, identifies key shortcomings, and compares it with the European Union's General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), widely regarded as a global standard. Recommendations are provided to enhance Pakistan's data privacy regime, focusing on consent, enforcement, rights of data subjects, and cross border data transfers.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了巴基斯坦的数据保护现状，指出其《个人数据保护法案》草案不完善且不符合国际最佳实践，通过与欧盟GDPR对比提出改进建议。
AI.research_question: 巴基斯坦的数据保护法律框架存在哪些不足？如何通过借鉴欧盟GDPR等国际最佳实践来完善巴基斯坦的数据隐私制度？
AI.motivation: 数字化转型使个人数据保护成为全球优先事项，巴基斯坦正在制定《个人数据保护法案》，但该法案不完整且未与国际最佳实践接轨，需要改进以有效保护公民数据隐私。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数据保护法律框架比较分析理论，国际数据隐私标准（特别是欧盟GDPR），数据主体权利理论，跨境数据传输监管理论。
AI.method: 比较分析法：将巴基斯坦的《个人数据保护法案》草案与欧盟GDPR进行系统对比；文献分析法；政策分析。
AI.findings: 巴基斯坦的数据保护法案存在重大缺陷：不完整、未与国际最佳实践接轨，在同意机制、执法力度、数据主体权利保护和跨境数据传输等方面存在不足。
AI.theory_contributions: 为发展中国家数据保护法律框架的比较研究提供了案例，丰富了数据隐私法律国际趋同理论，提出了适应巴基斯坦国情的数据保护理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为巴基斯坦政府完善《个人数据保护法案》提供具体建议，重点关注同意机制、执法机构建设、数据主体权利保障和跨境数据传输监管，有助于提升巴基斯坦数据保护水平。

detail.title: САНКЦИОННОЕ ДАВЛЕНИЕ И ОТВЕТНЫЕ МЕРЫ: ИНСТРУМЕНТЫ АДАПТАЦИИ БИЗНЕСА К НОВЫМ РЕАЛИЯМ (Sanctions Pressure and Countermeasures: Tools for Business Adaptation to New Realities)
detail.abstract:
Russian Abstract: Статья анализирует адаптацию российского бизнеса к санкционному давлению. Рассматриваются ключевые инструменты: импортозамещение, диверсификация рынков, создание альтернативных финансовых механизмов и параллельный импорт. На примере ключевых отраслей (АПК, автопром, IT, ОПК) показаны результаты переориентации экономики на новые рынки. Сделан вывод о трансформации санкций в катализатор структурных изменений. 

English Abstract: The article analyzes the adaptation of Russian business to sanctions pressure. It examines key tools: import substitution, market diversification, creation of alternative financial mechanisms, and parallel imports. Using key sectors (agribusiness, automotive, IT, defense) as examples, it demonstrates the results of the economy's reorientation towards new markets. It concludes that sanctions have acted as a catalyst for structural change.
