title: The Incidence of Tariffs: Rates and Reality
affiliations: International Monetary Fund (IMF) and University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: The Incidence of Tariffs: Rates and Reality

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Chicago, Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper No. 2025-ā51
publicationDetails.journalName: Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: In 2025, statutory tariff rates on U.S. imports rose to levels not seen in over one hundred years. What are the implications for prices? On the one hand, shipping lags, exemptions, and enforcement gaps have kept the actual implemented rates at only half of the statutory rates, moderating the tariffs' impact. On the other hand, tariff pass-through to U.S. import prices is almost 100 percent, so the United States is bearing a large share of the costs. We study the incidence of the 2018-2019 and 2025 U.S. tariffs and discuss implications for U.S. sourcing, domestic manufacturing costs, and the dollar.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了2018-2019年和2025年美国关税对价格的影响，发现尽管实际执行税率仅为法定税率的一半，但关税对美国进口价格的转嫁率接近100%，意味着美国承担了大部分成本。
AI.research_question: 美国关税（特别是2018-2019年和2025年的关税）对价格的影响是什么？关税如何影响美国采购、国内制造成本和美元汇率？
AI.motivation: 2025年美国法定关税税率达到一百多年来的最高水平，但实际执行税率仅为法定税率的一半，同时关税转嫁率接近100%，这种矛盾现象需要深入研究其经济影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 关税转嫁理论、国际贸易理论、价格传导机制、关税负担分配理论。
AI.method: 实证分析2018-2019年和2025年美国关税数据，比较法定税率与实际执行税率的差异，分析关税对进口价格的转嫁率，并评估对经济各方面的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 实际执行税率仅为法定税率的一半（由于运输滞后、豁免和执行缺口）；2. 关税对美国进口价格的转嫁率接近100%；3. 美国承担了大部分关税成本；4. 对美国采购、国内制造成本和美元汇率有重要影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了高关税环境下实际执行与法定税率差异的实证证据；2. 揭示了接近100%关税转嫁率的异常现象；3. 扩展了关税负担分配理论在高关税时期的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供关税实际影响的量化分析；2. 帮助企业理解关税对采购和成本的影响；3. 为国际贸易谈判提供实证依据；4. 为投资者评估美元汇率风险提供参考。

title: Weighting the H-1B Lottery: Implications for Worker and Diversity and Employment Concentration
affiliations: Colgate University

detail.title: Weighting the H-1B Lottery: Implications for Worker and Diversity and Employment Concentration

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: The H-1B program allows firms in the United States to temporarily hire foreign workers in specialty occupations. Demand outstrips supply, and the government allocates status through a random lottery. In September 2025, The United States Department of Homeland Security (DHS) proposed a new lottery process that would weight applications favoring workers receiving higher wage offers. This short article demonstrates that a weighted lottery would increase the ethnic diversity of H-1B recipients. Implications for H-1B employment concentration are particularly sensitive to threshold cutoffs used to construct weights.

AI.tldr: 本文分析美国H-1B签证抽签制度改革提案，发现加权抽签制度（根据工资水平分配权重）将增加H-1B签证获得者的种族多样性，但就业集中度对权重阈值设置特别敏感。
AI.research_question: 加权抽签制度（根据工资水平分配权重）如何影响H-1B签证获得者的种族多样性和就业集中度？
AI.motivation: 美国国土安全部2025年9月提出改革H-1B抽签制度，从随机抽签改为根据工资水平加权抽签，需要评估这一政策变化对签证获得者种族多样性和就业分布的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于随机分配理论、劳动力市场歧视理论，以及移民政策对劳动力多样性的影响机制。
AI.method: 理论分析和模拟研究，分析加权抽签制度对不同工资水平申请者的中签概率影响，进而推断对种族多样性的影响。
AI.findings: 加权抽签制度将增加H-1B签证获得者的种族多样性，但H-1B就业集中度对权重阈值设置特别敏感，阈值选择会显著影响最终结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 为移民政策设计提供了理论框架，揭示了加权抽签制度对劳动力多样性的影响机制，丰富了移民政策评估的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为美国国土安全部H-1B政策改革提供实证依据，帮助政策制定者理解加权抽签制度的实际影响，特别是阈值设置的重要性。

title: Project Selection, Planning and Execution: A Review
affiliations: , Ohio State University (OSU) - Department of Management Sciences and Nanyang Business School, Nanyang Technological University

detail.title: Project Selection, Planning and Execution: A Review
detail.abstract: About 30% of the world's economic activity is managed as projects. Yet many projects fail to meet expectations for time, cost, and quality of deliverables. To understand why this is the case and identify possible solutions, this paper offers a structured review of recent project management research. We examine the project selection, planning, and execution stages from both descriptive and prescriptive perspectives. From a descriptive viewpoint, factors influencing project performance are systematically categorized into project context, organizational context, and external environmental factors. Complementarily, the prescriptive perspective provides actionable guidance for addressing challenges specific to each stage. We also review the data and methods employed across the literature. Building on these perspectives, opportunities for future research at each stage are identified. In general, this study equips project managers and researchers with a structured roadmap to understand challenges, identify appropriate tools, and effectively implement projects.

AI.tldr: 本文通过结构化综述，系统分析了项目管理的失败原因与解决方案，从描述性和规范性双重视角审视项目选择、规划与执行阶段，为项目管理者和研究者提供结构化路线图。
AI.research_question: 为什么许多项目在时间、成本和交付质量方面未能达到预期？如何识别可能的解决方案来改善项目管理绩效？
AI.motivation: 全球约30%的经济活动以项目形式管理，但许多项目在时间、成本和交付质量方面未能达到预期，需要系统理解失败原因并识别解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于描述性视角（解释性因素分析）和规范性视角（行动指导）的双重理论框架，将影响因素分为项目情境、组织情境和外部环境因素三个维度。
AI.method: 采用结构化文献综述方法，系统回顾近期项目管理研究，从描述性和规范性双重视角分析项目选择、规划、执行三个阶段。
AI.findings: 1. 项目绩效影响因素可系统归类为项目情境、组织情境和外部环境因素；2. 每个项目管理阶段都有特定的挑战和相应的规范性解决方案；3. 文献中使用了多样化的数据和方法；4. 各阶段都存在未来研究机会。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了描述性与规范性相结合的双重视角分析框架；2. 系统化了项目绩效影响因素的三维分类体系；3. 为项目管理研究提供了结构化综述方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为项目管理者提供理解挑战、识别工具和实施项目的结构化路线图；2. 提供各阶段具体的行动指导；3. 帮助管理者系统应对项目选择、规划和执行中的问题。

title: Quality Upgrading in Global Supply Chains: Evidence from Colombian Coffee
affiliations: University of Warwick, University of Toulouse 1 - Toulouse School of Economics (TSE), Universidad de los Andes - Department of Economics, Columbia University - School of International & Public Affairs (SIPA), University of Basel and Columbia University

detail.title: Quality Upgrading in Global Supply Chains: Evidence from Colombian Coffee

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: Do the returns to quality upgrading pass through supply chains to primary producers? We explore this question in the context of Colombia’s coffee sector, in which market outcomes depend on interactions between farmers, exporters (which operate mills), and international buyers, and contracts are for the most part not legally enforceable. We formalize the hypothesis that quality upgrading is subject to a key hold-up problem: producing highquality beans requires long-term investments by farmers, but there is no guarantee that an exporter will pay a quality premium when the beans arrive at its mills. An international buyer with sufficient demand for high-quality coffee can solve this problem by imposing a vertical restraint on the exporter, requiring the exporter to pay a quality premium to farmers. Combining internal records from two exporters, comprehensive administrative data, and the staggered rollout of a buyer-driven quality-upgrading program, we find empirical support for the key theoretical predictions. The results are consistent with the hypotheses that quality upgrading can provide a path to higher incomes for farmers, but also that it is unlikely to be viable under standard market conditions in the sector.

AI.tldr: 研究哥伦比亚咖啡产业中，质量升级的收益能否通过供应链传递给初级生产者。研究发现，由于契约不完全执行，质量升级存在"套牢"问题，但国际买家可以通过垂直约束要求出口商向农民支付质量溢价，从而解决这一问题。
AI.research_question: 质量升级的收益能否通过供应链传递给初级生产者？
AI.motivation: 在哥伦比亚咖啡产业中，市场结果取决于农民、出口商和国际买家之间的互动，且契约大多无法强制执行。质量升级面临关键套牢问题：生产高质量咖啡豆需要农民的长期投资，但无法保证出口商在咖啡豆到达工厂时会支付质量溢价。
AI.theoretical_framework: 契约不完全执行理论、套牢问题、垂直约束理论。假设质量升级面临套牢问题：农民需要长期投资生产高质量咖啡豆，但无法保证获得质量溢价。国际买家可以通过垂直约束要求出口商向农民支付质量溢价来解决这一问题。
AI.method: 结合两家出口商的内部记录、全面的行政数据以及买家驱动的质量升级项目的交错推出，进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 实证结果支持关键理论预测：质量升级可以为农民提供更高收入的途径，但在该行业的标准市场条件下不太可能实现。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 在契约不完全执行的环境中，形式化了质量升级的套牢问题；2. 提出了国际买家通过垂直约束解决供应链中质量升级问题的理论框架；3. 为发展中国家的农业供应链治理提供了理论见解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了促进农业质量升级的可行路径；2. 为国际买家展示了如何通过供应链治理帮助农民获得质量溢价；3. 为发展中国家的农业价值链升级提供了实践指导。

title: Growing from the STEM? OPT Classification and International Students in Economics
affiliations: Iowa State University and Iowa State University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Growing from the STEM? OPT Classification and International Students in Economics

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: The Optional Practical Training (OPT) program now provides up to 36 months of employment authorization for foreign students completing college degrees in the U.S. in science, technology, engineering, and math (STEM) fields. Econometrics and Quantitative Economics (EQE) was added as a STEM field in 2012, triggering an explosion of EQE programs and degrees conferred, but some of this growth involved displacement from other economics programs. We document the growth of EQE and examine effects of OPT and EQE program creation on overall economics bachelors degrees conferred to international students. We find positive effects on international economics degrees with effects that appear larger at public colleges and universities than private ones. We also examine effects on domestic students and find more mixed results. Our results suggest that EQE program creation on average benefits foreign students and higher education institutions.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了美国STEM领域OPT政策扩展及EQE被列为STEM专业后，对国际学生经济学学士学位授予的影响。研究发现OPT政策刺激了EQE项目增长，对国际学生经济学学位授予有积极影响，公立院校效应更显著，但对本土学生影响不一。
AI.research_question: OPT政策扩展和EQE被列为STEM专业如何影响国际学生经济学学士学位的授予？这些政策变化对公立与私立院校、国际与本土学生的影响有何差异？
AI.motivation: 美国OPT政策为STEM领域国际毕业生提供长达36个月的工作许可，2012年EQE被列为STEM专业后，EQE项目和学位授予数量激增。需要研究这一政策变化对经济学教育体系的影响，特别是对国际学生学位选择、院校差异以及本土学生的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于教育经济学和政策评估理论，分析移民政策（OPT）与专业分类变化（STEM认证）如何影响高等教育需求供给、学生选择行为以及院校资源配置。
AI.method: 采用计量经济学方法，利用政策变化（2012年EQE被列为STEM专业）作为准自然实验，分析OPT政策扩展前后EQE项目和学位授予数据，比较公立与私立院校、国际与本土学生的差异效应。
AI.findings: 1. OPT政策刺激了EQE项目增长和学位授予增加；2. 对国际学生经济学学位授予有显著积极影响；3. 公立院校效应大于私立院校；4. 对本土学生影响较为复杂且不一致；5. EQE增长部分来自其他经济学项目的转移。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为移民政策与高等教育互动提供实证证据；2. 揭示STEM认证对学科发展的影响机制；3. 拓展了国际学生流动与教育政策评估的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为高等教育机构提供EQE项目发展的决策参考；2. 为政策制定者评估OPT政策效果提供依据；3. 帮助国际学生了解STEM专业选择的影响因素；4. 为院校资源配置提供实证支持。

title: Racial and Gendered Impacts of International Students on Domestic Peers
affiliations: University of Colorado at Boulder - Department of Economics, Hamilton College and

detail.title: Racial and Gendered Impacts of International Students on Domestic Peers

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper examines the impact of international students on the academic outcomes of domestic peers in introductory economics courses. We address the potential endogeneity of class selection by focusing on first-year students enrolling in a large public flagship university, for whom class assignment is likely to be quasi-random, conditional on a rich set of control variables for the class and individual. Results suggest an increased share of international student peers reduces the likelihood of majoring in economics for domestic White and Asian men while increasing the likelihood of majoring in economics for domestic men from underrepresented racial and ethnic groups. There is also evidence that higher shares of international student peers increase the likelihood that domestic White and Asian men major in business and decrease the likelihood that some men drop out of college. Additional analyses point to introductory course grades as possible mechanisms to explain these results, as a higher international peer share is associated with higher domestic student grades. Results for men enrolled in large introductory economics classes are similar to the main results for men overall and are also similar for women.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨国际学生对国内同学在经济学入门课程中学术成果的影响。研究发现国际学生比例增加会降低白人及亚裔男性选择经济学专业的可能性，但提高少数族裔男性选择经济学专业的可能性，同时国际学生比例与国内学生成绩正相关。
AI.research_question: 国际学生如何影响国内同学在经济学入门课程中的学术成果？具体来说，国际学生比例的变化如何影响国内学生选择经济学专业的决定、学业成绩以及大学辍学率？
AI.motivation: 随着高等教育国际化程度不断提高，国际学生在课堂中的存在日益增加，但关于他们对国内同学学术成果影响的研究相对有限。了解这种同伴效应对于教育政策制定、课程设计和学生支持服务具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于同伴效应理论、教育经济学和社会认同理论，研究假设国际学生的存在可能通过多种机制影响国内学生的学术决策，包括课堂竞争、学习环境变化、社会比较和身份认同过程。
AI.method: 采用准实验设计，利用一所大型公立旗舰大学新生班级分配的准随机性来克服选择偏误问题。通过丰富的班级和个人层面控制变量，使用计量经济学方法分析国际学生比例与国内学生学术成果之间的关系。
AI.findings: 1. 国际学生比例增加降低白人及亚裔男性选择经济学专业的可能性，但提高少数族裔男性选择经济学专业的可能性；2. 国际学生比例增加提高白人及亚裔男性选择商科专业的可能性；3. 国际学生比例增加降低部分男性的大学辍学率；4. 国际学生比例与国内学生成绩正相关，成绩可能是解释这些结果的中介机制；5. 女性样本的结果与男性总体结果相似。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为同伴效应理论提供了国际学生背景下的新证据；2. 揭示了同伴效应的异质性，即不同种族/族裔群体对国际学生存在的反应不同；3. 提出了成绩作为中介机制的解释框架；4. 扩展了教育经济学中关于课堂组成影响的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为高校国际化政策提供实证依据；2. 帮助教育工作者更好地理解多元化课堂对学生专业选择的影响；3. 为少数族裔学生支持项目提供参考；4. 为课程设计和教学策略调整提供指导；5. 有助于减少学生辍学率的干预措施设计。

title: Consumption Patterns, Inflation, and Household Welfare: Demand-Based Equivalence Scales in Europe
affiliations: Institute of Economics, Zagreb, Luxembourg Institute of Socio-Economic Research (LISER), Luxembourg Institute of Socio-Economic Research (LISER), University of Verona - Department of Economics and University of Galway

detail.title: Consumption Patterns, Inflation, and Household Welfare: Demand-Based Equivalence Scales in Europe

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: Equivalence scales are central to distributional analysis, adjusting household incomes for size and composition and shaping poverty and inequality measurement. Despite changes in consumption patterns, most applied work continues to rely on the modified OECD scale from the 1990s. We revisit equivalence scales for 23 EU countries using a linear expenditure demand system and harmonized Household Budget Survey data for 2010–2020. We estimate three demand-based scales: a minimum-needs scale anchored in subsistence, a utility-implicit scale based on welfare equivalence under common preferences, and a utility-explicit scale for sensitivity analysis. Our estimates imply larger economies of scale than the modified OECD scale, particularly for larger households. Scales decline with living standards and over time. Simulations of 2020–2024 price changes suggest that recent inflation is likely to further reduce equivalence scales, with stronger effects for households with children. While regional heterogeneity remains, poverty measures are more sensitive than inequality measures to the choice of scale. The results highlight the need to update equivalence scales and to report distributional statistics under alternative assumptions.

AI.tldr: 本文重新估计了欧盟23国的等价尺度，发现比常用的OECD修正尺度具有更大的规模经济效应，特别是对大家庭。尺度随生活水平和时间下降，近期通胀可能进一步降低等价尺度，对贫困测量的影响大于不平等测量。
AI.research_question: 如何基于2010-2020年欧盟23国的家庭预算调查数据，重新估计更符合当前消费模式的等价尺度？不同估计方法（最低需求尺度、效用隐含尺度、效用显式尺度）会产生怎样的差异？这些新尺度对贫困和不平等测量有何影响？
AI.motivation: 等价尺度对分配分析至关重要，但大多数应用研究仍依赖1990年代的OECD修正尺度，而消费模式已发生变化。需要基于最新数据和更合适的方法重新估计等价尺度，以更准确地衡量贫困和不平等。
AI.theoretical_framework: 线性支出需求系统；基于需求的等价尺度理论，包括：1）锚定在基本生存水平的最低需求尺度；2）基于共同偏好下福利等价的效用隐含尺度；3）用于敏感性分析的效用显式尺度。
AI.method: 使用欧盟23国2010-2020年协调的家庭预算调查数据，采用线性支出需求系统估计三种基于需求的等价尺度。通过模拟2020-2024年价格变化分析通胀对尺度的影响，并比较不同尺度对贫困和不平等测量的敏感性。
AI.findings: 1）估计的尺度比OECD修正尺度显示出更大的规模经济效应，特别是对大家庭；2）尺度随生活水平提高和时间推移而下降；3）近期通胀可能进一步降低等价尺度，对有子女家庭影响更大；4）贫困测量比不平等测量对尺度选择更敏感；5）存在地区异质性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提供了基于最新数据和需求系统的等价尺度估计方法；2）比较了三种不同理论基础的尺度估计方法；3）揭示了尺度随生活水平和时间变化的动态特征；4）分析了通胀对等价尺度的影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为政策制定者提供了更新的等价尺度参考；2）建议在分配统计中报告不同尺度假设下的结果；3）指出需要定期更新等价尺度以反映消费模式变化；4）为贫困和不平等测量提供了更准确的基础。

title: The Effect of Separation on Poverty and Employment
affiliations: and

detail.title: The Effect of Separation on Poverty and Employment

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: Using 2001–2021 HILDA survey data, this paper estimates how separation or divorce affects poverty and employment trajectories over five years after the event. A difference-in-differences approach compares separated individuals with couples who stayed together, accounting for recent and long-term labour market history prior to separation. Women with preschool children face a 19.9 percentage point higher poverty risk in the first year, which fades within three years. Women with older or no children experience smaller but longer-lasting poverty increases. Preseparation employment strongly moderates effects: non-employed women face much higher poverty risks than employed women who have similar poverty risks to men. Men’s poverty impacts are smaller and shorter-lived. Separation barely changes women’s employment but slightly reduces men’s employment, especially those with preschool children.

AI.tldr: 本文使用2001-2021年HILDA调查数据，分析离婚或分居对贫困和就业轨迹的五年影响。研究发现：有学龄前子女的女性在第一年贫困风险增加19.9个百分点，但三年内消退；其他女性贫困影响较小但更持久。分居前就业状况显著调节影响：未就业女性贫困风险远高于就业女性，后者贫困风险与男性相似。男性贫困影响较小且短暂。分居几乎不影响女性就业，但略微降低男性就业，尤其是有学龄前子女的男性。
AI.research_question: 离婚或分居如何影响个体在事件发生后五年内的贫困和就业轨迹？
AI.motivation: 理解家庭结构变化（特别是分居/离婚）对经济福祉的长期影响，为政策制定提供实证依据，特别关注性别差异和子女状况的调节作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于家庭经济学和劳动力市场理论，探讨家庭结构变化对资源分配、就业决策和经济安全的影响，特别关注性别角色分工和育儿责任的影响。
AI.method: 使用2001-2021年澳大利亚家庭、收入和劳动力动态（HILDA）调查数据，采用双重差分法比较分居个体与保持婚姻关系的夫妇，控制分居前后的劳动力市场历史。
AI.findings: 1. 有学龄前子女的女性在第一年贫困风险增加19.9个百分点，但三年内消退；2. 其他女性贫困影响较小但更持久；3. 分居前就业状况显著调节影响：未就业女性贫困风险远高于就业女性；4. 男性贫困影响较小且短暂；5. 分居几乎不影响女性就业，但略微降低男性就业，尤其是有学龄前子女的男性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了分居对贫困影响的异质性，特别强调了子女年龄和分居前就业状况的调节作用；2. 提供了性别差异在分居经济后果中的新证据；3. 拓展了家庭结构变化对长期经济轨迹影响的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为针对分居女性的社会政策提供实证依据，特别是有学龄前子女的女性需要短期支持；2. 强调分居前就业对缓解贫困风险的重要性；3. 为家庭法律和政策制定提供性别敏感的建议；4. 帮助社会服务机构更好地预测和应对分居后的经济困难。

title: How Home Exams and Peers Affect College Grades in Unprecedented Times
affiliations: University of Iceland, University of Essex, University of Iceland and University of Iceland

detail.title: How Home Exams and Peers Affect College Grades in Unprecedented Times

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: Leveraging administrative data from the University of Iceland, which cover more than 60% of the undergraduate population in the country, we examine how home exams and peer networks shape grades around the COVID-19 crisis. Using difference-in-difference models with a rich set of fixed effects, we find that home exams taken during university closures raised grades by about 0.5 points (about 7%) relative to invigilated in-person exams outside the pandemic period. Access to a larger share of high-school peers leads to an average grade increase of up to two-fifths of a point, and exposure to higher-quality peers yielded additional, but smaller gains. Interactions between peer-network measures and the COVID/home-exam indicators are near zero, providing no evidence that peer networks amplified home-exam gains during the pandemic.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用冰岛大学行政数据，分析了家庭考试和同伴网络在COVID-19危机期间对成绩的影响。研究发现家庭考试使成绩提高约0.5分（7%），而更多高中同伴接触能带来最高0.4分的成绩提升，但同伴网络并未放大疫情期间家庭考试的收益。
AI.research_question: 家庭考试和同伴网络如何影响COVID-19危机期间大学生的成绩？
AI.motivation: COVID-19疫情导致大学关闭，学生转向家庭考试，同时同伴互动模式发生变化，需要研究这些因素如何影响学术表现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于教育经济学和同伴效应理论，探讨考试形式（监考vs家庭考试）和同伴网络对学术成绩的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用冰岛大学行政数据（覆盖全国60%以上本科生），采用双重差分模型，包含丰富的固定效应控制变量。
AI.findings: 1. 疫情期间的家庭考试使成绩提高约0.5分（约7%）；2. 接触更多高中同伴平均提高成绩最高0.4分；3. 接触高质量同伴带来额外但较小的收益；4. 同伴网络与家庭考试的交互效应接近零，表明同伴网络未放大疫情期间家庭考试的收益。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为考试形式对学术成绩的影响提供了因果证据；2. 量化了同伴网络在高等教育中的效应；3. 揭示了疫情期间教育干预措施的实际效果。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为教育机构设计考试政策提供实证依据；2. 帮助理解同伴支持在远程学习环境中的作用；3. 为未来危机期间的教育决策提供参考。

title: Supported Work Leads to Lasting Labor Market Success Among TANF Recipients
affiliations: University of Colorado at Boulder - Department of Economics, University of Colorado at Boulder - Department of Economics and University of Notre Dame

detail.title: Supported Work Leads to Lasting Labor Market Success Among TANF Recipients

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper studies the effects of a supported work program that provides TANF recipients with a suite of services including a six-month subsidized internship with a local employer.  We use rich administrative data and implement a stacked difference-in-differences design comparing program participants to observably similar TANF recipients to estimate effects on employment, earnings, and benefit receipt. Program enrollment led to an immediate increase in formal-sector employment and earnings, with limited post-program fadeout. The program increased employment by 10 percentage points (20 percent) and earnings by \$861 per quarter (48 percent) in the three years following program exit. Program participation also increased participants' total benefit receipt during the program, with modest decreases after program exit.  The program is relatively cost-effective compared to other adult subsidized employment programs due to longer-than-average persistence of the employment and earnings gains.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了一个为TANF受助者提供6个月补贴实习等服务的支持性工作计划，发现项目显著提高了参与者的正规就业率和收入，且效果持久，成本效益较高。
AI.research_question: 支持性工作计划（提供补贴实习等服务）对TANF受助者的就业、收入和福利领取有何影响？
AI.motivation: 了解针对贫困家庭临时援助（TANF）受助者的支持性工作计划的有效性，评估这类项目是否能帮助低收入人群实现可持续就业和收入增长。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于劳动力市场干预理论、人力资本理论和福利依赖理论，探讨补贴就业项目如何通过提供工作经验、技能培训和雇主联系来改善低收入人群的就业结果。
AI.method: 使用丰富的行政数据，采用堆叠双重差分法（stacked difference-in-differences），将项目参与者与观察特征相似的TANF受助者进行比较。
AI.findings: 项目参与立即提高了正规部门就业和收入，效果持久。项目退出后三年内，就业率提高10个百分点（20%），每季度收入增加861美元（48%）。项目期间福利领取增加，退出后略有减少。相比其他成人补贴就业项目，该项目成本效益较高。
AI.theory_contributions: 为补贴就业项目的长期效果提供了实证证据，挑战了"项目效果会快速消退"的传统观点，表明设计良好的支持性工作计划可以产生持久的人力资本积累效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了有效的TANF干预模式，证明包含补贴实习的综合服务包能够有效促进低收入人群的可持续就业，具有较高的成本效益，值得推广。

title: The Politics of Public Service Reform
affiliations: Nova School of Business and Economics

detail.title: The Politics of Public Service Reform

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper provides experimental evidence on the electoral effect of a large education reform in a developing democracy. The reform significantly improved school quality on many dimensions (Romero, Sandefur, & Sandholtz, 2020). In this paper, I show that the reform reduced the incumbent party's pres- idential vote share by 2.1 percentage points (5%). The reform also reduced teachers' job satisfaction, support for the incumbent government, and political engagement. Electoral effects were positively correlated with effects on teachers' political engagement; the reform lost most votes where it caused greatest political disengagement of teachers.

AI.tldr: 一项大型教育改革在发展中民主国家减少了执政党总统选票份额2.1个百分点（5%），同时降低了教师工作满意度、对执政政府的支持度和政治参与度。
AI.research_question: 大型教育改革对发展中民主国家的选举结果有何影响？教育改革如何通过影响教师的政治参与来影响选举结果？
AI.motivation: 研究发展中民主国家教育政策与选举政治的关系，探讨教育改革如何通过影响关键利益相关者（教师）的政治态度和行为来产生选举后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共政策与选举政治理论，教育改革的政治经济学，教师作为政治行为者的角色，政策实施与选民反馈机制。
AI.method: 实验证据研究，利用大型教育改革的自然实验，分析改革前后选举数据、教师调查数据，并进行相关性分析。
AI.findings: 1. 教育改革使执政党总统选票份额减少2.1个百分点（5%）；2. 改革降低了教师的工作满意度、对执政政府的支持度和政治参与度；3. 选举效应与教师政治参与度下降呈正相关，改革在导致教师政治疏离最严重的地区失去最多选票。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了教育改革在发展中民主国家的政治后果；2. 提出了教师作为政治中介者的理论框架；3. 阐明了政策实施如何通过影响关键利益相关者来产生选举效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了教育改革政治风险的警示；2. 帮助政治策略家理解教师群体在选举中的重要性；3. 为发展中民主国家的政策实施提供了政治考量框架。

title: The Minimum Wage and Inequality Between Groups
affiliations: Cornell University - Department of Economics, , Cornell University, Cornell University - School of Industrial and Labor Relations and Cornell University

detail.title: The Minimum Wage and Inequality Between Groups

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: Using 1979-2019 Current Population Survey data, we study the effect of state and federal minimum wage policies on gender, race, and ethnic inequality. We find that minimum wages substantially reduce intergroup wage inequality at least up to the 20th wage percentile, with no evidence of adverse employment effects. We conduct counterfactual simulations of between- group inequality due to minimum wage changes since 1979. Declines in the real minimum wage in the 1980s slowed progress in narrowing between-group inequality. Relatively small changes in minimum wages during 1989-1998 and 1998-2007 meant little role for the minimum wage over those time spans. Since 2007, several states have steeply raised their minimum wages, especially raising Hispanics’ relative wages, because they earn low wages and reside disproportionately in those states. Finally, we find that raising the federal minimum wage to $12/hour in 2020 dollars ($14.49 in 2025Q2 dollars) would reduce existing between-group wage gaps below the 15th percentile by 25-50%.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用1979-2019年数据，发现最低工资政策显著减少性别、种族和民族间的工资不平等，特别是在工资分布的第20百分位以下，且没有负面就业效应。模拟显示，1980年代实际最低工资下降减缓了不平等缩小进程，而2007年后多个州大幅提高最低工资显著提升了西班牙裔的相对工资。将联邦最低工资提高到2020年的12美元（2025年第二季度为14.49美元）可将第15百分位以下的群体间工资差距减少25-50%。
AI.research_question: 州和联邦最低工资政策对性别、种族和民族不平等有何影响？
AI.motivation: 理解最低工资政策在减少群体间工资不平等方面的作用，特别是在美国长期存在性别、种族和民族工资差距的背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于劳动力市场制度理论，特别是最低工资作为工资设定机制对工资分布和群体间不平等的影响。
AI.method: 使用1979-2019年当前人口调查(CPS)数据，采用反事实模拟方法分析最低工资变化对群体间不平等的影响，并检验就业效应。
AI.findings: 1. 最低工资显著减少第20百分位以下的群体间工资不平等；2. 没有发现负面就业效应；3. 1980年代实际最低工资下降减缓了不平等缩小进程；4. 2007年后州级最低工资大幅提高显著提升了西班牙裔的相对工资；5. 将联邦最低工资提高到12美元（2020年）可将第15百分位以下的群体间工资差距减少25-50%。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了最低工资减少群体间不平等的实证证据；2. 挑战了最低工资导致就业损失的传统观点；3. 阐明了最低工资政策在不同历史时期对不平等动态的影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了提高最低工资可显著减少群体间不平等的证据；2. 表明最低工资政策是减少性别、种族和民族工资差距的有效工具；3. 为联邦最低工资提高到12美元（2020年）的政策建议提供了量化支持。

title: Matching or Clashing: Exploring Scientists Exit from Academia Through Intentions and Job Offers
affiliations: ,  and The University of Manchester - Alliance Manchester Business School

detail.title: Matching or Clashing: Exploring Scientists Exit from Academia Through Intentions and Job Offers

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: Academically trained scientists play a pivotal role in innovation by advancing the knowledge frontier across industries, prompting firms to increasingly engage in proactive recruitment. This paper investigates academic scientists’ career transitions into industry by jointly examining two often separately studied mechanisms: scientists’ intentions to leave academia (the supply side) and firms’ recruitment efforts (the demand side). We conceptualize intersectoral mobility as the outcome of how these two mechanisms align or diverge. Using survey data from 469 scientists in Germany linked to follow-up information on their actual career outcomes more than three years later, our results show that exit intentions are the predominant predictor of subsequent transitions into industry jobs. Job offers reinforce the impact of existing exit intentions. By contrast, scientists who receive a job offer but do not intend to leave academia are the least likely to transition to private-sector employment. Implications for firms’ active recruiting strategies and for universities seeking to retain scientific staff are discussed.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨学术科学家向产业界职业转型的机制，发现离职意愿是主要预测因素，工作机会会强化现有离职意愿，但没有离职意愿的科学家即使获得工作机会也很少转行。
AI.research_question: 学术科学家向产业界职业转型的决定因素是什么？离职意愿（供给方）与企业招聘努力（需求方）如何共同影响跨部门流动？
AI.motivation: 学术科学家在创新中发挥关键作用，企业日益主动招聘学术人才，但现有研究通常单独考察离职意愿或招聘机制，缺乏对两者交互作用的系统性研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 跨部门流动理论，结合供给方（科学家离职意愿）和需求方（企业招聘努力）的双重视角，将职业转型视为两者匹配或错配的结果。
AI.method: 使用德国469名科学家的调查数据，结合三年后的实际职业结果追踪信息，分析离职意图与工作机会对职业转型的联合影响。
AI.findings: 1. 离职意愿是向产业界转型的主要预测因素；2. 工作机会会强化现有的离职意愿；3. 没有离职意愿的科学家即使获得工作机会也很少转行。
AI.theory_contributions: 整合供给方和需求方视角，提出跨部门流动的匹配框架，揭示离职意愿与工作机会的交互作用机制，丰富了职业转型理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业招聘策略提供指导：应针对已有离职意愿的科学家；为大学保留人才提供启示：关注科学家的职业满意度，预防离职意愿形成。

title: War and the Economy: Do Post-war Economies Recover Stronger or Weaker?

detail.title: War and the Economy: Do Post-war Economies Recover Stronger or Weaker?
detail.abstract: War has traditionally been among the most dislocative yet creative drivers of world economies. Although wars typically lead to destruction, exile, and chronic instability, recoveries in the aftermath of war have had surprisingly varied results across countries. This paper examines whether economies recover more or less robustly following wars through comparative case studies in Germany and Japan after World War II and Iraq after 2003. Employing a mixed-method framework integrating historical economic statistics, trends in GDP growth, and cross-disciplinary knowledge from economics, political science, and sociology, the research draws attention to how institutional reconstruction, foreign assistance, and governance frameworks shape recovery patterns. Evidence indicates that short-term economic downturn is unavoidable, but countries with reconstructive policies that are inclusive, robust governance, and international partnership will likely have "war-induced modernization," such as that in Japan and Germany. However, countries with weak institutions and poor governance, like Iraq, experience lasting economic stagnation. The study emphasizes that war itself is not necessarily an economic "bounty" but a conditional disruptor: its effects are conditional on governance, external alliances, and the inclusiveness of recovery policies. The report concludes that postwar economies need to implement sustainable, human-oriented policies that emphasize innovation, social fairness, and regional collaboration to prevent cycle-back violence and economic breakdown. This study also suggests imminent policy direction including "green reconstruction funds," digital-first programs for recovery, and collaborative regional trade agreements to ensure recovery is not just speedy but also resilient.

AI.tldr: 本文通过比较二战后德国和日本与2003年后伊拉克的案例研究，探讨战后经济恢复的差异。研究发现，短期经济衰退不可避免，但具有包容性重建政策、强健治理和国际合作的国家（如德日）可能实现"战争引发的现代化"，而制度薄弱的国家（如伊拉克）则经历持久经济停滞。战后恢复效果取决于治理质量、外部联盟和政策的包容性。
AI.research_question: 战后经济恢复的差异如何产生？为什么有些国家在战后能实现强劲恢复甚至现代化，而另一些国家则陷入长期经济停滞？
AI.motivation: 战争既是破坏性力量，也可能是创造性驱动力。尽管战争通常导致破坏、流离失所和长期不稳定，但战后恢复结果在不同国家间差异显著。理解这种差异的原因对于制定有效的战后重建政策至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合经济学、政治学和社会学的跨学科知识，重点关注制度重建、外国援助和治理框架如何塑造恢复模式。强调战争作为"条件性破坏者"的概念，其效果取决于治理、外部联盟和政策的包容性。
AI.method: 采用混合方法框架，通过比较案例研究分析德国和日本（二战后）以及伊拉克（2003年后）的战后恢复。整合历史经济统计数据、GDP增长趋势和跨学科知识。
AI.findings: 1. 短期经济衰退不可避免；2. 具有包容性重建政策、强健治理和国际合作的国家（如德国和日本）可能实现"战争引发的现代化"；3. 制度薄弱、治理不善的国家（如伊拉克）经历持久经济停滞；4. 战争本身不是经济"红利"，而是条件性破坏者，其效果取决于治理质量、外部联盟和政策的包容性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出"战争作为条件性破坏者"的理论框架；2. 强调治理、外部联盟和政策包容性在战后恢复中的决定性作用；3. 发展"战争引发的现代化"概念，解释某些国家战后实现经济转型的机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 建议实施可持续、以人为本的政策，强调创新、社会公平和区域合作；2. 提出具体政策方向：绿色重建基金、数字优先恢复计划、区域贸易协定；3. 强调恢复不仅需要快速，更需要韧性，以防止暴力循环和经济崩溃。

title: Who Studies What? Country of Origin, Gender, and Field Specialization Among Economics PhDs
affiliations: University of Luxembourg and LISER

detail.title: Who Studies What? Country of Origin, Gender, and Field Specialization Among Economics PhDs

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: We study the determinants of field specialization among U.S. economics PhD students, focusing on individual, institutional, and contextual factors shaping early research careers. Using data on over 8,000 dissertations from 2009–2018, we classify each dissertation into one of ten fields using author-reported JEL codes and topic modeling of abstracts. We link dissertations to student gender, program characteristics, and country of origin inferred from surnames and matched to country-level indicators. We find substantial variation in field choice by region of origin. Gender gaps in specialization are not uniform but vary in size and direction across regions, indicating that gender and origin interact in shaping choices. Results are robust to alternative classification methods and to using genetic distance as a continuous measure of origin. Our findings highlight how early specialization in economics reflects inherited context and institutional exposure, with implications for research agendas, job market outcomes, and diversity across subfields.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了美国经济学博士生专业领域选择的决定因素，发现原籍地区、性别和制度环境共同影响早期研究职业的专业化方向。
AI.research_question: 美国经济学博士生的专业领域选择受哪些因素影响？个体特征、制度因素和背景因素如何塑造早期研究职业的专业化方向？
AI.motivation: 理解经济学博士生专业领域选择的决定因素对于研究议程、就业市场结果和学科多样性具有重要意义，但现有研究对此关注不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于个体特征理论、制度理论和背景依赖理论，探讨原籍地区、性别、项目特征等多层次因素对专业领域选择的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用2009-2018年间8000多篇博士论文数据，通过作者报告的JEL代码和摘要主题建模将论文分为10个领域，并将论文与学生性别、项目特征、原籍国家（通过姓氏推断）等变量关联。
AI.findings: 1) 原籍地区对专业领域选择有显著影响；2) 性别差距在不同地区存在差异，表明性别和原籍存在交互作用；3) 结果对替代分类方法和使用遗传距离作为原籍连续度量具有稳健性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 揭示了原籍地区在专业领域选择中的重要作用；2) 提出了性别和原籍交互影响专业选择的理论框架；3) 强调了背景继承和制度暴露对早期研究职业的影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为经济学项目招生和培养提供参考；2) 有助于改善学科多样性；3) 为政策制定者提供关于研究议程和就业市场结果的启示。

title: From Division of Labour to Division of Intelligence: Rethinking Jobs, Skills, and Workforce Planning in the AI Era

detail.title: From Division of Labour to Division of Intelligence: Rethinking Jobs, Skills, and Workforce Planning in the AI Era

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: This paper examines how artificial intelligence (AI) is transforming not only who does work, but how intelligence itself is divided between humans and machines. Building on Adam Smith's (1776) theory of the division of labour and Jordan's (2025) collectivist economic perspective on AI, it develops a neo-Smithian framework for the 'division of intelligence' in modern organisations. Rather than treating AI as a jobdestroying force or a simple augmentation tool, the analysis emphasises that AI reshapes work by redistributing tasks, judgment, and decision rights across humanmachine systems. The paper identifies four broad categories of tasks-AI-first, human-first, and two forms of hybrid work-and proposes design principles for allocating work according to the distinctive strengths of humans and AI. Evidence from healthcare, finance, education, and the HR function itself illustrates how these patterns play out in practice. Five critical competency areas are highlighted for workers in an AI-enabled economy, and a dedicated section translates the framework into concrete implications for HR, job design, and workforce planning. Ethical analysis, grounded in the principles of beneficence, non-maleficence, autonomy, and justice (Beauchamp & Childress, 2019), underscores that efficiency and ethics are not competing goals but jointly define what 'good' looks like in AIenabled systems. The central thesis is that success in the AI era depends on deliberately designing collaborative human-machine systems in which each contributes their unique strengths-and in which organisations treat AI deployment as workforce and system redesign, not just technology installation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个"智能分工"的新史密斯框架，探讨AI如何重塑人类与机器之间的任务分配、判断和决策权，而非简单替代或增强工作。论文识别了四种任务类型，提出了设计原则，并强调了伦理与效率的协同重要性。
AI.research_question: 人工智能如何改变人类与机器之间的智能分工，以及组织应如何设计人机协作系统以实现效率和伦理的双重目标？
AI.motivation: 当前对AI的讨论往往局限于工作替代或简单增强，缺乏系统性的理论框架来分析AI如何从根本上重塑人类与机器之间的智能分工和组织设计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于亚当·斯密（1776）的劳动分工理论和乔丹（2025）的AI集体主义经济视角，构建了现代组织中"智能分工"的新史密斯框架。
AI.method: 理论框架构建与多行业案例分析相结合，通过医疗、金融、教育和人力资源等领域的实际案例来验证理论框架的实践应用。
AI.findings: 识别了四种任务类型：AI优先、人类优先和两种混合工作形式；提出了基于人类和AI各自优势的工作分配设计原则；强调了AI时代工人需要具备的五种关键能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"智能分工"的新史密斯理论框架，超越了传统的AI替代或增强视角，为人机协作系统设计提供了系统的理论指导。
AI.practical_contributions: 为人力资源、工作设计和劳动力规划提供了具体指导；提出了人机协作系统的设计原则；强调了伦理考量（有益、无害、自主、公正）与效率目标的协同实现。

title: Public Insurance and Demand for Private Healthcare
affiliations: University of Warwick, Indian Institute of Technology (IIT), Kanpur and City College of New York

detail.title: Public Insurance and Demand for Private Healthcare

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: Establishment of public–private partnerships is an emerging model in health care delivery. This study evaluates a pioneering social health insurance program in India that enables eligible households to access private hospitals for tertiary care services free of cost, but does not build more facilities. Leveraging policy discontinuities at state borders, we identify the program’s causal effects on utilization of private facilities and associated out-of-pocket expenditures. The results indicate a pronounced substitution effect induced by relative price changes: the program substantially increases the incidence of deliveries in private hospitals while significantly reducing out-of-pocket spending. However, we find no statistically significant effects on fertility or a key health outcome, infant mortality.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了印度一项创新的社会医疗保险计划，该计划允许符合条件的家庭免费使用私立医院的三级医疗服务，但不建设新设施。利用州边界政策不连续性进行因果识别，发现该计划显著增加了私立医院分娩率并减少了自付费用，但对生育率和婴儿死亡率无显著影响。
AI.research_question: 印度的社会医疗保险计划（允许符合条件的家庭免费使用私立医院）如何影响医疗服务的利用、自付费用、生育率和婴儿死亡率？
AI.motivation: 公私合作伙伴关系在医疗服务提供中是一种新兴模式，但对其效果缺乏严格的因果评估。印度这项创新的社会医疗保险计划为评估这种模式的影响提供了独特机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于相对价格变化理论，当私立医院服务价格下降（通过保险覆盖）时，会产生替代效应，使患者从公立医院转向私立医院。
AI.method: 利用州边界政策不连续性进行断点回归设计，比较政策实施州与未实施州边界两侧地区的差异，识别计划的因果效应。
AI.findings: 1) 显著增加了私立医院分娩率（替代效应）；2) 显著减少了自付医疗费用；3) 对生育率无显著影响；4) 对婴儿死亡率无显著影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 为公私合作伙伴关系在医疗服务提供中的效果提供了因果证据，验证了相对价格变化理论在医疗需求中的适用性，揭示了保险覆盖对医疗选择的影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于社会医疗保险计划设计的实证依据，表明通过保险覆盖私立医院服务可以有效增加服务利用并减少患者负担，但对健康结果的影响有限。

title: Developing a Culture of Sustainability: Purpose, Leadership and Organizational Transformation
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Developing a Culture of Sustainability: Purpose, Leadership and Organizational Transformation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there is no conflict of interest. The research presented in this paper was conducted independently and was not influenced by any personal or financial relationships with other individuals or organizations. No funding was received for the development of this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, clinical data, or sensitive personal information. Therefore, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was entirely self-funded by the author as part of her independent academic and professional activity in the field of sustainability consulting and leadership development.

detail.abstract:
Sustainability has become a critical driver of strategic competitiveness, yet many firms continue to struggle with implementation. Regulatory advances in the European Union-most notably the Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive (CSRD), the European Sustainability Reporting Standards (ESRS), and the 2024-2025 Omnibus Package-have accelerated adoption, but regulation alone is insufficient to enable transformation. 
This paper introduces the concept of a Culture of Sustainability, defined as a shared organizational mindset that embeds long-term thinking, multi-stakeholder value creation, and systemic awareness across the enterprise. Building on organizational culture theory (Schein, 1992; Hofstede, 2001) 1 , corporate purpose research (Gartenberg, Prat, & Serafeim, 2019) 2 , and the integrated thinking framework (IIRC, 2013) 3 , the study presents a three-pillar model-Purpose, Leadership, and Culture-to explain how sustainability can evolve from compliance to strategic differentiation. The analysis suggests that strict regulation drives compliance, while simplified regulation reveals leadership. Only organizations with a mature Culture of Sustainability are able to align strategy and behavior, foster innovation, and build resilience. The findings offer a conceptual roadmap for business leaders seeking to embed sustainability into core practices and organizational identity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"可持续性文化"概念，认为仅靠欧盟监管推动不足，需要建立包含目标、领导力和文化的三支柱模型，才能将可持续性从合规要求转变为战略差异化优势。
AI.research_question: 企业如何超越监管合规，将可持续性真正嵌入组织核心，实现从合规到战略差异化的转变？
AI.motivation: 尽管可持续性已成为战略竞争力的关键驱动力，且欧盟监管框架（CSRD、ESRS等）加速了采纳，但仅靠监管不足以实现真正的组织转型。许多企业仍在可持续性实施方面面临困难。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织文化理论（Schein, 1992; Hofstede, 2001）、企业目标研究（Gartenberg, Prat, & Serafeim, 2019）、整合思维框架（IIRC, 2013）
AI.method: 概念性研究，提出三支柱模型（目标、领导力、文化）的理论框架
AI.findings: 严格监管驱动合规，简化监管揭示领导力。只有具备成熟可持续性文化的组织才能协调战略与行为、促进创新、建立韧性。可持续性文化包含长期思维、多利益相关者价值创造和系统性意识。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"可持续性文化"的新概念，建立三支柱理论模型，连接组织文化理论、企业目标研究和可持续性转型，为可持续性组织变革提供理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业领导者提供将可持续性嵌入核心实践和组织身份的概念路线图，帮助区分合规驱动与战略驱动的可持续性实践，指导组织文化转型。

title: Assortative Mating, Inequality, and Rising Educational Mobility in Spain
affiliations: , Banco de España, Charles III University of Madrid and Banco de España - Research Department

detail.title: Assortative Mating, Inequality, and Rising Educational Mobility in Spain

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: We study the evolution of intergenerational educational mobility and related distributional statistics in Spain. Over recent decades, mobility has risen by one-third, coinciding with pronounced declines in inequality and assortative mating among the same cohorts. To explore these patterns, we examine regional correlates of mobility, using split-sample techniques. A key finding from both national and regional analyses is the close association between mobility and assortative mating: spousal sorting accounts for nearly half of the regional variation in intergenerational correlations and also appears to be a key mediator of the negative relationship between inequality and mobility documented in recent studies.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了西班牙代际教育流动性的演变及其与不平等和婚姻匹配的关系。研究发现，近几十年代际流动性提高了三分之一，同时不平等和婚姻匹配程度显著下降。婚姻匹配解释了近一半的地区间代际相关性差异，并且是不平等与流动性负向关系的关键中介变量。
AI.research_question: 西班牙代际教育流动性如何演变？其与不平等和婚姻匹配的关系是什么？婚姻匹配在地区间流动性差异和不平等-流动性关系中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 理解代际流动性变化及其与不平等、婚姻匹配的关系对于评估社会机会平等和制定相关政策具有重要意义。西班牙近几十年的社会经济变化为研究这些关系提供了独特背景。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代际流动性理论、不平等与流动性关系理论、婚姻匹配（assortative mating）理论、社会分层理论
AI.method: 使用西班牙数据研究代际教育流动性的演变；采用分样本技术（split-sample techniques）分析地区相关性；进行国家和区域层面的分析
AI.findings: 1. 近几十年代际流动性提高了三分之一；2. 同时期不平等和婚姻匹配程度显著下降；3. 婚姻匹配解释了近一半的地区间代际相关性差异；4. 婚姻匹配是不平等与流动性负向关系的关键中介变量
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了婚姻匹配在代际流动性中的重要作用；2. 提供了不平等与流动性关系的机制解释；3. 扩展了代际流动性理论框架，纳入婚姻匹配作为关键中介变量
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者理解流动性变化提供了实证依据；2. 表明减少婚姻匹配可能有助于提高代际流动性；3. 为地区间流动性差异提供了政策干预方向

title: The 'Despotic Leviathan' and Its Financial Architecture: How IMF Conditionalities Deepen Inequality
affiliations: University of Bath and

detail.title: The 'Despotic Leviathan' and Its Financial Architecture: How IMF Conditionalities Deepen Inequality

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper examines how IMF policies contribute to the inequality in MENA, and to a Middle-Income Trap (MIT). Developing a theory expanding Acemoglu and Robinson’s “Narrow Corridor” framework, it shows how IMF conditions align domestic elite incentives with creditor interests through a principal-agent lens. Using 2020-2025 data, its analysis reveals IMF monetary policies create rent-seeking structures that institutionalize inequality and suppress growth. The paper identifies an “engineered r>g dynamic” as a quantifiable signature of this extraction, empirically verified in Egypt. It establishes a causal link between financial/monetary policy (interest rates, debt compounding) and the “Despotic Leviathan” state formation.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了IMF政策如何通过强化精英-债权人联盟，在中东和北非地区制造结构性不平等和中等收入陷阱，揭示了"工程化的r>g动态"作为不平等制度化的量化特征。
AI.research_question: IMF政策如何通过精英激励与债权人利益的结合，在中东和北非地区制造结构性不平等和中等收入陷阱？
AI.motivation: 理解IMF政策在MENA地区不平等和增长停滞中的作用，特别是如何通过金融货币政策机制强化专制利维坦国家形态。
AI.theoretical_framework: 扩展Acemoglu和Robinson的"狭窄走廊"框架，结合委托-代理理论，分析IMF条件如何使国内精英激励与债权人利益保持一致。
AI.method: 使用2020-2025年数据，通过实证分析验证"工程化的r>g动态"作为不平等制度化的量化特征，以埃及为案例进行实证验证。
AI.findings: IMF货币政策创造寻租结构，制度化不平等并抑制增长；识别出"工程化的r>g动态"作为这种提取机制的量化特征；建立了金融货币政策（利率、债务复利）与"专制利维坦"国家形成之间的因果关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了"狭窄走廊"框架，将IMF政策作为精英-债权人联盟的机制；发展了"工程化的r>g动态"作为不平等制度化的量化理论；建立了金融货币政策与专制国家形成的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供识别IMF政策不平等效应的分析工具；为埃及等MENA国家提供政策改革建议；为国际金融机构改革提供实证依据。

title: An Application to Latin America of a Dual Synergies Model: Can a New Industrial Policy Break the Middle Income Trap?
affiliations: University of Bath

detail.title: An Application to Latin America of a Dual Synergies Model: Can a New Industrial Policy Break the Middle Income Trap?

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: The paper applies the “dual synergies” model—linking economic growth, poverty reduction, and human capability formation—to explain why Latin America (LAC) remains trapped at middle-income levels. It challenges orthodox views that prioritize growth alone, arguing instead that growth, social policy, and human capital mutually reinforce each other. Using stylized facts, the paper shows that LAC’s extractive, commodity-dependent development model has produced volatile growth, weak job creation, high informality, and limited poverty reduction. This contrasts sharply with East Asia, where coordinated industrial policy, early investments in health and education, and financial deepening enabled sustained growth and structural transformation. In LAC, weak fiscal capacity, low savings, foreign-dominated banking, and inequality constrain public investment in human capital, weakening growth–poverty links. The paper argues that breaking the middle-income trap requires an integrated strategy: a renewed, state-capable industrial policy aimed at diversification, innovation, and manufacturing upgrading, combined with stronger social policies.

AI.tldr: 该论文应用"双重协同"模型解释拉丁美洲为何陷入中等收入陷阱，挑战了单纯强调经济增长的正统观点，认为增长、社会政策和人力资本应相互促进。通过对比东亚成功经验，指出拉美资源依赖型发展模式的缺陷，并提出需要产业政策与社会政策相结合的综合战略。
AI.research_question: 为什么拉丁美洲国家长期陷入中等收入陷阱而无法实现向高收入经济体的转型？
AI.motivation: 拉丁美洲国家长期处于中等收入水平，经济增长停滞，贫困问题持续存在，与东亚国家的成功转型形成鲜明对比，需要新的理论框架来解释这一现象并提出解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: "双重协同"模型：经济增长、减贫和人力资本形成之间的相互促进关系；挑战传统经济增长优先的单一视角。
AI.method: 使用风格化事实分析，对比拉丁美洲与东亚的发展模式差异，进行区域比较研究。
AI.findings: 拉美的资源依赖型发展模式导致经济增长波动大、就业创造弱、非正规经济高、减贫效果有限；而东亚通过协调的产业政策、早期人力资本投资和金融深化实现了持续增长和结构转型。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"双重协同"模型作为分析中等收入陷阱的新框架；挑战了经济增长优先的正统观点；强调了增长、社会政策和人力资本之间的相互依存关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为拉美国家突破中等收入陷阱提供了综合战略：需要能力强的国家实施产业政策促进多元化和制造业升级，同时加强社会政策投资人力资本。

title: Crime and Prices: Evidence from Thefts of Expensive Precious Metal
affiliations: Singapore Management University, London School of Economics & Political Science (LSE) - Centre for Economic Performance (CEP) and London School of Economics & Political Science (LSE) - Centre for Economic Performance (CEP)

detail.title: Crime and Prices: Evidence from Thefts of Expensive Precious Metal

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: We study whether economic incentives matter for crime in a novel way, through study of expensive precious metal thefts by thieves stealing catalytic converters. We combine sharp, plausibly exogenous variation in the prices of precious metals embedded in converters with newly assembled U.S. data and multiple research designs. We show that phenomenally fast increases in precious metal prices generated a sizeable and rapid rise in auto-part thefts, while subsequent price declines and policy responses quickly reversed this pattern. The resulting boom-and-bust dynamics provide clean evidence that both demand- and supply-side economic forces shape property crime and inform targeted deterrence policies.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过分析催化转化器盗窃案件，发现贵金属价格波动显著影响财产犯罪率，为经济激励影响犯罪提供了新证据。
AI.research_question: 经济激励是否影响犯罪？具体而言，贵金属价格波动如何影响催化转化器盗窃案件？
AI.motivation: 传统犯罪经济学研究多关注宏观因素，缺乏对具体犯罪类型与经济激励直接关系的实证证据。催化转化器盗窃因其与贵金属价格直接相关，为研究经济激励对犯罪的影响提供了理想场景。
AI.theoretical_framework: 犯罪经济学理论，特别是理性选择理论和机会理论。假设犯罪者会权衡收益与风险，当贵金属价格上涨时，盗窃催化转化器的预期收益增加，导致犯罪率上升。
AI.method: 采用准自然实验设计，结合贵金属价格的急剧外生变化和新组装的美国数据。使用多种研究设计分析价格波动与盗窃案件之间的因果关系。
AI.findings: 贵金属价格急剧上涨导致汽车零部件盗窃显著快速增加，而随后的价格下跌和政策干预迅速逆转了这一趋势。呈现明显的"繁荣-萧条"动态。
AI.theory_contributions: 为犯罪经济学提供了清晰的因果证据，证明需求和供给两方面的经济力量共同塑造财产犯罪。揭示了经济激励对具体犯罪类型的直接影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为针对性威慑政策提供信息，表明监控贵金属价格波动有助于预测和预防特定类型犯罪。政策制定者可根据价格信号调整执法资源分配。

title: Why Is Competition in the European Football Market Failing, and What Should Be Done About It?
affiliations: Research Institute of Industrial Economics (IFN) and Research Institute of Industrial Economics (IFN)

detail.title: Why Is Competition in the European Football Market Failing, and What Should Be Done About It?

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: The European football (soccer) market increasingly funnels rents to superstar players and intermediaries while weakening competitive balance. We trace this dynamic to two forces: (a) technological innovation that globalized broadcasting and magnified superstar returns, and (b) legal rulings boosting player mobility and causing bidding wars. The 2024 Diarra ruling by the Court of Justice of the European Union further loosens transfer constraints and will likely intensify talent concentration at “superclubs”. The result is soaring salaries and transfer fees, persistent financial fragility among non-elite clubs, and growing predictability of match outcomes. We evaluate reform options that preserve Europe’s open-league tradition yet borrow from North American competitive-balance tools: greater revenue sharing, hard/soft salary caps, and draft-like mechanisms. These should be complemented by a “cartel tax” to fund youth sport, and club-governance codes plus credible financial-sustainability rules.

AI.tldr: 欧洲足球市场租金流向超级球星和中介，削弱竞争平衡，源于技术全球化转播和法律裁决提升球员流动性，导致薪资和转会费飙升、非精英俱乐部财务脆弱、比赛结果可预测性增加。改革方案借鉴北美平衡工具，结合"卡特尔税"和治理规范。
AI.research_question: 欧洲足球市场如何导致租金流向超级球星和中介，削弱竞争平衡？以及如何改革以保持欧洲开放联赛传统同时改善竞争平衡？
AI.motivation: 欧洲足球市场日益加剧的不平等：超级俱乐部垄断资源，非精英俱乐部财务脆弱，比赛结果可预测性增加，威胁联赛的竞争平衡和长期可持续性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 超级明星经济学：技术全球化放大明星回报；2) 劳动力市场流动性理论：法律裁决提升球员流动性导致竞价战；3) 竞争平衡理论：资源集中削弱联赛竞争性。
AI.method: 理论分析结合制度分析：分析技术变革（转播全球化）和法律裁决（特别是2024年Diarra裁决）对欧洲足球市场结构的影响，评估改革方案的可行性。
AI.findings: 1) 技术全球化和法律裁决共同导致租金流向超级球星和中介；2) 薪资和转会费飙升；3) 非精英俱乐部财务脆弱；4) 比赛结果可预测性增加；5) 2024年Diarra裁决将进一步加剧人才向"超级俱乐部"集中。
AI.theory_contributions: 整合技术变革和法律制度对体育市场结构的影响分析框架，将北美竞争平衡工具理论应用于欧洲开放联赛环境，提出"卡特尔税"等创新概念。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出具体改革方案：收入分享、硬/软工资帽、选秀机制，结合"卡特尔税"资助青少年体育，俱乐部治理规范和财务可持续规则，为欧洲足球管理机构提供政策建议。

title: Developing a Culture of Sustainability: Purpose, Leadership and Organizational Transformation
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Developing a Culture of Sustainability: Purpose, Leadership and Organizational Transformation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there is no conflict of interest. The research presented in this paper was conducted independently and was not influenced by any personal or financial relationships with other individuals or organizations. No funding was received for the development of this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, clinical data, or sensitive personal information. Therefore, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was entirely self-funded by the author as part of her independent academic and professional activity in the field of sustainability consulting and leadership development.

detail.abstract: Sustainability has become a critical driver of strategic competitiveness, yet many firms continue to struggle with implementation. Regulatory advances in the European Union-most notably the Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive (CSRD), the European Sustainability Reporting Standards (ESRS), and the 2024-2025 Omnibus Package-have accelerated adoption, but regulation alone is insufficient to enable transformation. This paper introduces the concept of a Culture of Sustainability, defined as a shared organizational mindset that embeds long-term thinking, multi-stakeholder value creation, and systemic awareness across the enterprise. Building on organizational culture theory (Schein, 1992; Hofstede, 2001) 1 , corporate purpose research (Gartenberg, Prat, & Serafeim, 2019) 2 , and the integrated thinking framework (IIRC, 2013) 3 , the study presents a three-pillar model-Purpose, Leadership, and Culture-to explain how sustainability can evolve from compliance to strategic differentiation. The analysis suggests that strict regulation drives compliance, while simplified regulation reveals leadership. Only organizations with a mature Culture of Sustainability are able to align strategy and behavior, foster innovation, and build resilience. The findings offer a conceptual roadmap for business leaders seeking to embed sustainability into core practices and organizational identity.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"可持续文化"概念，认为严格法规驱动合规，简化法规揭示领导力，只有成熟的可持续文化才能使企业将可持续性从合规转变为战略差异化。
AI.research_question: 企业如何将可持续性从合规要求转变为战略差异化优势？
AI.motivation: 尽管可持续性已成为战略竞争力的关键驱动力，许多企业仍在实施中挣扎。欧盟的监管进展（CSRD、ESRS等）加速了采用，但仅靠法规不足以实现转型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织文化理论（Schein, 1992; Hofstede, 2001）、企业宗旨研究（Gartenberg, Prat & Serafeim, 2019）和综合思维框架（IIRC, 2013）
AI.method: 概念性研究，提出三支柱模型（宗旨、领导力、文化）作为分析框架
AI.findings: 严格法规驱动合规，简化法规揭示领导力。只有拥有成熟可持续文化的组织才能协调战略与行为、促进创新并建立韧性。
AI.theory_contributions: 引入"可持续文化"概念，定义为嵌入长期思维、多利益相关者价值创造和系统性意识的共享组织心态。提出三支柱模型解释可持续性从合规到战略差异化的演变路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业领导者提供将可持续性嵌入核心实践和组织身份的概念路线图，帮助组织超越合规实现战略转型。

title: Formal and Informal Assets in the Italian Labour Market
affiliations: , Università degli Studi di Milano - Dipartimento di Economia Politica e Aziendale (DEPA),  and University College London, Institute of Education

detail.title: Formal and Informal Assets in the Italian Labour Market

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper estimates labour-market returns to formal and informal human capital in Italy using data from the first cycle of PIAAC. We distinguish formal inputs (years of schooling) from directly assessed skills (literacy and numeracy) which we interpret as distinct forms of human capital that are shaped by school quality and by non-formal and informal learning. To address non-random employment and joint endogeneity of schooling and skills, we combine a Heckman selection model with instrumental variables. Schooling is instrumented using cohort exposure to the 1971 introduction of full-day primary schooling and the 1999–2001 Bologna ‘3+2’ university reform; skills are instrumented using gender- and cohort-specific municipal illiteracy rates from population censuses, matched by birthplace. Results show that ignoring selection and endogeneity overstates the returns to schooling. After correction, numeracy yields the main wage premium, while formal credentials contribute little once skills are accounted for. The findings highlight the role of early cultural environments and skill accumulation for Italian wage inequality in Italy.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用PIAAC数据估计意大利正规和非正规人力资本的劳动力市场回报，发现纠正选择偏差和内生性后，计算能力是主要工资溢价来源，而正规学历在考虑技能后贡献很小。
AI.research_question: 意大利劳动力市场中正规人力资本（学校教育年限）和非正规人力资本（识字和计算能力）的回报分别是多少？如何准确估计这些回报？
AI.motivation: 传统研究主要关注学校教育年限的回报，但忽视了技能（识字和计算能力）作为人力资本的重要形式。意大利劳动力市场存在显著的不平等，需要理解不同形式人力资本对工资差异的贡献。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资本理论，区分正规人力资本（学校教育）和非正规/非正式人力资本（技能）。内生性问题：就业选择非随机，学校教育与技能存在联合内生性。
AI.method: 使用PIAAC第一轮数据，结合Heckman选择模型和工具变量法。学校教育工具变量：1971年全日制小学引入的队列暴露和1999-2001年博洛尼亚"3+2"大学改革；技能工具变量：按出生地匹配的性别和队列特定市政文盲率。
AI.findings: 忽略选择偏差和内生性会高估学校教育回报。纠正后，计算能力是主要工资溢价来源，而正规学历在考虑技能后贡献很小。早期文化环境和技能积累对意大利工资不平等有重要作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 区分正规和非正规人力资本形式；2. 提出解决就业选择和联合内生性的综合方法；3. 强调技能作为人力资本的重要性；4. 揭示早期文化环境对技能形成的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为意大利教育政策提供依据，强调技能培养而非单纯延长学校教育；2. 帮助理解工资不平等的根源；3. 为劳动力市场政策提供参考；4. 强调早期文化环境对人力资本积累的重要性。

title: Gutenberg or the Great Firewall? Printing, AI, and the Politics of Innovation
affiliations: Harvard University

detail.title: Gutenberg or the Great Firewall? Printing, AI, and the Politics of Innovation
detail.abstract: This paper examines the potential of the two frontrunners-the United States and China-for long-run AI leadership. It develops a simple model of sustained innovation in information technologies, arguing that long-run progress hinges on "governed Schumpeterian competition": strong but constrained state capacity combined with Schumpeterian entrepreneurship that sustains creative destruction. Using the historical experience of the printing press-an early information technology with disruptive features analogous to AI-the paper shows how different institutional endowments shape the trajectory of these technologies. In imperial China, competition was initially imported via Buddhism but was later absorbed into a centralized, stability-first order, while in fragmented Western Europe, low exit costs and competition allowed printing to evolve. The analysis then applies this lens to AI, comparing the political economy of the U.S. and China to examine how each system structurally approaches AI development and innovation. While the U.S. still leads, China's model constitutes a major institutional innovation, combining a state-capitalist system with Schumpeterian entrepreneurship. Although it remains unclear whether it has solved the autocrats' dilemma between stability and creative destruction, China could be capable of overtaking the U.S. in AI over the long run.

AI.tldr: 本文通过历史比较分析，探讨中美两国在人工智能长期领导权竞争中的潜力。文章提出"治理型熊彼特竞争"模型，认为长期创新需要强大但受约束的国家能力与熊彼特式企业家精神的结合。通过对比印刷术在中西的不同发展轨迹，分析中美在AI发展上的制度差异，认为中国模式是重要的制度创新，可能在长期超越美国。
AI.research_question: 中美两国在人工智能长期领导权竞争中的相对潜力如何？不同制度环境如何影响AI等颠覆性信息技术的创新轨迹？
AI.motivation: 随着AI成为关键技术，中美竞争日益激烈。理解两国制度差异如何影响长期创新能力，对于预测AI发展轨迹和全球技术领导权转移具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: "治理型熊彼特竞争"理论：结合强大但受约束的国家能力与熊彼特式企业家精神，强调制度禀赋对技术创新的影响。借鉴历史制度比较方法，分析不同政治经济体系对颠覆性技术的适应能力。
AI.method: 历史比较分析：以印刷术作为早期信息技术的案例，对比中国与西欧的制度差异如何影响技术发展轨迹。然后将这一分析框架应用于当代AI技术，比较中美两国的政治经济体系。
AI.findings: 1. 中国历史上通过佛教引入竞争，但最终被中央集权的稳定优先秩序吸收；西欧的碎片化政治结构和低退出成本促进了印刷术的演化。2. 美国在AI领域仍领先，但中国的国家资本主义与熊彼特企业家精神结合的模式是重要制度创新。3. 中国可能解决"独裁者困境"（稳定与创造性破坏的平衡），在长期超越美国。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出"治理型熊彼特竞争"理论框架，解释长期技术创新所需的制度条件。2. 建立历史制度比较分析框架，将早期信息技术（印刷术）与当代AI进行类比分析。3. 深化对中美制度差异如何影响颠覆性技术创新的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供理解中美AI竞争动态的框架。2. 帮助企业理解不同制度环境下的创新策略。3. 为国际技术竞争和合作提供分析基础，帮助预测全球技术领导权可能的转移路径。

title: AI, Deepfake and Audit
affiliations: University of Wisconsin - Whitewater

detail.title: AI, Deepfake and Audit

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there is no conflict of interest in relation to this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The author confirms that this research did not involve human participants, animal experimentation, or any use of identifiable personal data. Therefore, ethical approval and informed consent were not required.
declarations.funderStatement: The author received no funding for this study.

detail.abstract: This study investigates the growing impact of artificial intelligence, particularly deepfake technologies, on the integrity and reliability of the audit process. It examines how increasingly sophisticated AI-generated media can be used to fabricate evidence, elevating the risk of fraud and challenging auditors’ ability to verify the authenticity of digital information. The paper explains the mechanisms behind deepfake creation, such as generative adversarial networks, to illustrate why these forgeries are becoming more difficult to detect. It further assesses the tools currently available to auditors, including deepfake-detection algorithms, large training datasets, and watermarking techniques, as potential safeguards against manipulated evidence. In addition, the study evaluates emerging global legislative responses and highlights the present lack of comprehensive regulation surrounding AI misuse. While emphasizing the significant threats deepfakes pose to audit quality, the paper also acknowledges the constructive applications of AI that can enhance efficiency, accuracy, and analytical capabilities in auditing. Ultimately, the study underscores the need for a combined strategy of technology adoption, regulatory development, and auditor education to address the evolving risks posed by AI-generated misinformation.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了人工智能（特别是深度伪造技术）对审计过程完整性和可靠性的日益增长的影响，分析了AI生成证据带来的欺诈风险，评估了现有检测工具和监管措施，并提出了技术采用、法规发展和审计师教育的综合应对策略。
AI.research_question: 人工智能（特别是深度伪造技术）如何影响审计过程的完整性和可靠性？审计师应如何应对AI生成伪造证据带来的挑战？
AI.motivation: 随着AI技术（尤其是深度伪造）的快速发展，伪造数字证据的能力日益增强，这对审计过程的完整性和可靠性构成了严重威胁，需要系统研究其影响和应对措施。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于审计质量理论、数字证据验证理论、技术采纳理论，结合生成对抗网络（GANs）等AI技术原理，构建AI对审计影响的分析框架。
AI.method: 采用文献综述和理论分析方法，系统分析深度伪造技术的机制、现有检测工具、全球监管现状，并进行综合评估。
AI.findings: 深度伪造技术通过生成对抗网络等机制制造难以检测的伪造证据，显著增加了审计欺诈风险；现有检测工具（如深度伪造检测算法、大数据训练、水印技术）有一定效果但不够完善；全球监管仍不健全；AI也有提升审计效率和准确性的积极应用。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了数字时代审计质量理论，提出了AI技术对审计证据验证的新挑战框架，为审计技术采纳理论提供了新的实证基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为审计实务提供了具体的风险识别工具和应对策略，包括技术工具选择建议、监管改进方向、审计师培训重点，帮助实务界应对AI带来的挑战。

reference: Peterson Institute for International Economics Working Paper No. 25-22
title: Perspectives on Japan’s continuing exorbitant privilege
affiliations: Harvard University - Department of Economics and Harvard University

detail.title: Perspectives on Japan’s continuing exorbitant privilege

publicationDetails.detailsText: Peterson Institute for International Economics Working Paper No. 25-22
publicationDetails.journalName: Peterson Institute for International Economics (PIIE) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: With renewed doubt about the scale, scope, and even the sign of the dollar's "exorbitant privilege," we revisit Japan's case, in particular, the persistent excess return on its external balance sheet, which derives in part from its ability to issue safe government debt at scale. Retaining this privilege is conditional, however, on Japan managing its debt dynamics and keeping inflation under control.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视日本的"过度特权"现象，即日本外部资产负债表持续获得超额回报，部分源于其能够大规模发行安全的政府债务。然而，维持这一特权取决于日本能否管理好债务动态并控制通胀。
AI.research_question: 日本如何维持其外部资产负债表的超额回报（"过度特权"），以及这种特权在何种条件下可持续？
AI.motivation: 随着对美元"过度特权"的规模、范围甚至正负号产生新的质疑，需要重新审视日本的案例，特别是其外部资产负债表持续获得超额回报的现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 过度特权理论、国际金融理论、债务动态理论、安全资产理论
AI.method: 案例研究法、实证分析、比较分析
AI.findings: 日本外部资产负债表的超额回报部分源于其能够大规模发行安全的政府债务；维持这一特权取决于日本能否管理好债务动态并控制通胀。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对"过度特权"理论的理解，特别是非美元货币国家的特权现象；扩展了安全资产理论在国际金融中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为日本政策制定者提供了维持外部资产负债表优势的政策建议；为其他国家如何获得类似特权提供了参考。

title: Understanding Paradigm Resistance: Why Innovative Wave-Mechanics Papers Are Misread as Redundant Attacks on Impedance Matching Theory
affiliations: Shenyang Normal University

detail.title: Understanding Paradigm Resistance: Why Innovative Wave-Mechanics Papers Are Misread as Redundant Attacks on Impedance Matching Theory
detail.abstract: This dialogue analyzes why a series of theoretically innovative papers on the wave-mechanics explanation of microwave absorption have high visibility but minimal effective citations within the mainstream community. The discussion contrasts the author's systematic, concept-driven workrepeatedly revisiting film absorption, impedance matching, and quarterwavelength models from new physical perspectives-with reviewers' claims that these papers merely "repeat the same idea" and primarily "attack" established impedance-matching theory. It is argued that many reviewers and mainstream scientists read only abstracts and introductions, applying a "garbage-paper" reading strategy that works for incremental experimental reports but fails completely for paradigm-challenging theory, where the true innovation lies in the main argumentation. The conversation concludes that the criticism of redundancy and poor expression reflects paradigm resistance and cognitive bias, not genuine flaws in the wave-mechanics work, and that using undergraduate-level physics to overturn long-standing but incorrect theories is evidence of the research's depth rather than superficiality.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了一系列关于微波吸收波动力学解释的理论创新论文为何具有高可见度但在主流学术界引用率极低的现象，认为这是由于范式抵抗和认知偏见导致的，而非论文本身存在实质性缺陷。
AI.research_question: 为什么一系列在微波吸收波动力学解释方面具有理论创新的论文具有高可见度但在主流学术界却获得极少的有效引用？
AI.motivation: 观察到一系列理论上创新的波动力学解释微波吸收的论文虽然被广泛阅读（高可见度），但在主流学术界引用率极低，这种矛盾现象需要解释。作者的系统性、概念驱动的工作反复从新的物理视角重新审视薄膜吸收、阻抗匹配和四分之一波长模型，但被审稿人批评为"重复相同想法"和主要"攻击"已建立的阻抗匹配理论。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 科学社会学中的范式理论（库恩范式转移概念）
2. 认知偏见理论（包括确认偏误、现状偏误）
3. 学术交流与引用行为的社会学理论
4. 科学革命的结构理论
AI.method: 对话分析、文献分析、比较分析、案例研究（分析特定论文系列及其评审过程）、论证分析
AI.findings:
1. 许多审稿人和主流科学家只阅读摘要和引言，采用适用于渐进性实验报告的"垃圾论文"阅读策略，这种策略完全不适合挑战范式的理论工作
2. 真正的创新在于主要论证部分，而非表面结论
3. 对冗余性和表达不佳的批评反映了范式抵抗和认知偏见，而非波动力学工作的真正缺陷
4. 使用本科水平的物理学来推翻长期存在但不正确的理论，恰恰证明了研究的深度而非肤浅性
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了"高可见度-低引用率"悖论的理论解释框架
2. 发展了科学交流中"范式抵抗"的具体表现机制理论
3. 揭示了理论创新论文在主流学术界接受过程中的特殊障碍
4. 为科学革命理论提供了当代案例研究
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为理论创新研究者提供了应对审稿批评的策略指导
2. 为期刊编辑和审稿人提供了识别范式挑战性工作的评估框架
3. 为学术共同体提供了改善理论创新论文接受度的建议
4. 为科学交流实践提供了改进方向

title: From Centrifugal Civilization to Coherent Continuity

detail.title: From Centrifugal Civilization to Coherent Continuity
detail.abstract:
For over four centuries, the dominant response to civilizational complexity has been institutional multiplication—the progressive creation of specialized structures to contain expanding domains of knowledge, governance, and technology. This working paper argues that this legacy strategy has reached its centrifugal limit, producing a global condition of negative coherence (ΔC < 0), in which increasing intelligence accelerates systemic fragmentation rather than integration.

Grounded exclusively in the first three theory layers of The Force meta-paradigm, this article reframes the contemporary crisis not as an intrinsic property of complexity, but as an upstream architectural failure resulting from the absence of a governing invariant. Preserving the full historical lineage as necessary but incomplete, the paper demonstrates how coherence-preserving architecture (ΔC ≥ 0) resolves institutional drift and structured amnesia at the substrate level.

Using falsifiable evidence derived from the BCS 2.0 test-bed, the analysis establishes that the existing theory layer is already sufficient to stabilize civilizational continuity, thereby providing a reliable foundation for addressing downstream, process-level complexity in subsequent work.

AI.tldr: 该工作论文认为，应对文明复杂性的传统制度倍增策略已达到离心极限，导致"负相干性"(ΔC < 0)的全球状态。基于The Force元范式的理论层，文章将当代危机重新定义为上游架构失败，并提出相干性保持架构(ΔC ≥ 0)可解决制度漂移和结构化失忆问题。
AI.research_question: 制度倍增作为应对文明复杂性的主导策略是否已达到极限？如何通过相干性保持架构解决由此产生的负相干性和系统碎片化问题？
AI.motivation: 四百年来，通过创建专门结构来应对知识、治理和技术扩张的制度倍增策略，已导致全球性的负相干性状态，即智力增长反而加速系统碎片化而非整合。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于The Force元范式的理论层，特别是"负相干性"(ΔC < 0)和"相干性保持架构"(ΔC ≥ 0)的概念框架，以及"上游架构失败"和"治理不变性缺失"的理论视角。
AI.method: 使用BCS 2.0测试平台提供的可证伪证据进行分析，在The Force元范式的前三个理论层基础上进行理论重构和论证。
AI.findings: 现有理论层已足够稳定文明连续性，为处理下游过程级复杂性提供可靠基础。相干性保持架构能够解决制度漂移和结构化失忆等底层问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出"负相干性"概念解释制度倍增的极限效应；2) 将文明危机重新定义为上游架构失败而非复杂性固有属性；3) 建立相干性保持架构的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和机构设计者提供稳定文明连续性的架构方案，解决制度碎片化和知识失忆问题，为后续处理过程级复杂性奠定基础。

affiliations: University of California, Berkeley - Department of Economics, Bank of Finland - Institute for Economies in Transition (BOFIT) and Peterson Institute for International Economics

detail.title: War-Induced Economic Convergence in Russian Regions

publicationDetails.detailsText: Peterson Institute for International Economics Working Paper No. 25-21
publicationDetails.journalName: Peterson Institute for International Economics (PIIE) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper examines the impact of Russia's 2022 full-scale invasion of Ukraine on Russia's economy at a subnational, or "regional," level. Our analysis focuses on the regional disparities and convergence trends within Russia, driven by increased military spending and structural changes. The paper also explores the long-term implications of excessive reliance on military spending for regional development and economic efficiency. Our findings suggest that there has been some convergence in regional wages and incomes during the war. However, the sustainability of this trend remains uncertain due to the misallocation of resources and the broader economic challenges facing Russia. We also find indirect evidence that regions with a strong military presence have experienced substantial income growth.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了2022年俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰对俄罗斯经济在区域层面的影响，重点关注军事支出增加和结构变化导致的区域差异与收敛趋势，并探讨过度依赖军事支出对区域发展和经济效率的长期影响。
AI.research_question: 俄罗斯2022年全面入侵乌克兰对其区域经济有何影响？军事支出增加如何影响区域间的经济收敛趋势？过度依赖军事支出对区域发展和经济效率有何长期影响？
AI.motivation: 理解战争对俄罗斯区域经济的异质性影响，特别是军事支出增加如何重塑区域经济格局，以及这种依赖军事支出的发展模式是否可持续。
AI.theoretical_framework: 区域经济收敛理论、军事凯恩斯主义、资源错配理论、区域发展理论
AI.method: 区域层面的实证分析，可能包括面板数据分析、区域经济指标比较、收敛性检验等定量方法
AI.findings: 1. 战争期间区域工资和收入出现一定程度的收敛趋势；2. 军事存在较强的区域经历了显著的收入增长；3. 这种收敛趋势的可持续性存在不确定性，主要由于资源错配和俄罗斯面临的更广泛经济挑战
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 丰富了战争对区域经济影响的理论理解；2. 深化了军事支出与区域收敛关系的理论分析；3. 为资源错配理论在战争经济背景下的应用提供了新证据
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者理解战争对区域经济的异质性影响提供依据；2. 警示过度依赖军事支出的区域发展模式的风险；3. 为评估战争经济的长期可持续性提供参考

title: THE WEIRD MACHINE: WHY WESTERN INSTITUTIONS FAIL THE GLOBAL MAJORITY - An Asymmetric Intentionality Analysis of Legal Transplant Failure

detail.title: THE WEIRD MACHINE: WHY WESTERN INSTITUTIONS FAIL THE GLOBAL MAJORITY - An Asymmetric Intentionality Analysis of Legal Transplant Failure

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest. No financial relationships or competing interests influenced this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study analyzed publicly available legal documents and constitutional provisions; no human subjects were involved.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The author conducted this work independently.

detail.abstract:
Western institutions systematically fail when transplanted to non-WEIRD contexts, generating substantial implementation gaps. 

This paper proposes a novel mechanism: intentionality mismatch. Drawing on Asymmetric Intentionality Theory (Lerer 2025), Henrich's WEIRD framework (2020), and Fiske's Relational Models Theory (1991), I argue that Western institutions embody Level 1 intentionality (optimization without genuine beliefs), while non-WEIRD contexts expect Level 3 intentionality (recursive social reasoning with shame, reciprocity, and trust). 

This architectural mismatch produces implementation failure across contract enforcement, property rights, criminal procedure, and administrative law. Using game-theoretic analysis of the OECD Anti-Bribery Convention (41 countries, 66 legislative events) and detailed examination of Argentina's corporate criminal liability regime (Ley 27401), I analyze how legal transplants carrying Level 1 architecture into Level 3 contexts produce predictable implementation gaps. The Transplant Compatibility Index (TCI) for eight documented transplants shows WEIRD→non-WEIRD transfers have compatibility deltas of-0.30 to-0.39, approaching failure thresholds. 

Corporations, as institutional embodiments of WEIRD psychology, exhibit Social Immunity (immune to shame, reputation, reciprocity), generating strategic advantages over Level 3 enforcement agents. 

Policy implications: Abandon one-size-fits-all institutional design. Design for intentionality compatibility, not ideological compliance. Leverage local Level 3 mechanisms (community enforcement, relational contracts, embedded trust networks) rather than imposing Level 1 optimization.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"意向性不匹配"机制解释西方制度在非WEIRD环境移植失败的原因：西方制度体现Level 1意向性（无真实信念的优化），而非WEIRD环境期望Level 3意向性（包含羞耻、互惠和信任的递归社会推理），这种架构不匹配导致实施差距。
AI.research_question: 为什么西方制度系统性地在非WEIRD环境中移植失败？意向性不匹配如何解释这种实施差距？
AI.motivation: 西方制度在非WEIRD环境中移植时产生显著实施差距，现有理论无法充分解释这种系统性失败，需要新的理论机制来理解制度移植的兼容性问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 不对称意向性理论（Lerer 2025）、WEIRD框架（Henrich 2020）、关系模型理论（Fiske 1991）、意向性层次理论（Level 1 vs Level 3）
AI.method: 1. OECD反贿赂公约的博弈论分析（41个国家，66个立法事件）；2. 阿根廷公司刑事责任制度（Ley 27401）的详细案例研究；3. 八个已记录移植的移植兼容性指数（TCI）分析
AI.findings: 1. WEIRD→非WEIRD移植的兼容性差异为-0.30到-0.39，接近失败阈值；2. 公司作为WEIRD心理的制度体现表现出"社会免疫性"（对羞耻、声誉、互惠免疫）；3. 法律移植将Level 1架构带入Level 3环境会产生可预测的实施差距
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"意向性不匹配"作为解释制度移植失败的新机制；发展移植兼容性指数（TCI）作为评估工具；整合不对称意向性理论和WEIRD框架分析制度设计
AI.practical_contributions: 放弃一刀切的制度设计；设计时应考虑意向性兼容性而非意识形态合规；利用本地Level 3机制（社区执行、关系合同、嵌入式信任网络）而非强加Level 1优化

detail.abstract: The Peterson Institute for International Economics held a high-level conference in October 2025 in Washington, DC, to analyze the serious issues concerning central bank independence in practice. The goal was to inform Congress, the federal courts, market participants, and the public with the latest evidence-based assessments of why the independence of the Federal Reserve should be secured and how far it should extend in practical terms. The conference convened leading voices from academia, policymaking, and finance. Their remarks and presentations are brought together in this PIIE Briefing.

AI.tldr: 彼得森国际经济研究所于2025年10月在华盛顿特区举办高级别会议，分析央行独立性在实践中的严重问题，旨在为国会、联邦法院、市场参与者和公众提供基于最新证据的评估，说明为何应确保美联储独立性及其实际范围。
AI.research_question: 美联储的独立性为何应该得到保障？在实际操作中，其独立性应延伸到何种程度？
AI.motivation: 央行独立性在实践中面临严重问题，需要基于最新证据进行评估，为政策制定者、司法机构、市场参与者和公众提供信息，确保美联储的独立性得到适当保障。
AI.theoretical_framework: 央行独立性理论、货币政策理论、制度经济学、政治经济学

AI.theory_contributions: 深化对央行独立性理论在实践中的应用理解，为央行独立性边界问题提供理论框架

title: How Much Is Money, Power and Influence? Discovering The World’s Economic System

detail.title: How Much Is Money, Power and Influence? Discovering The World’s Economic System
detail.abstract:
This manuscript examines the evolution of economic systems through a multidisciplinary lens that integrates economic history, political economy, sociology, and moral philosophy. Beginning with early human societies where status and resource allocation were tied to survival and reproductive advantage, the paper traces how value systems evolved into structured economies based on trade, redistribution, and governance. It analyzes the transition from traditional, feudal, and prophetic Islamic economic models to contemporary capitalist, socialist, and mixed systems, highlighting how each framework reflects deeper human motivations for status, power, and security.

The paper argues that modern political polarization, global inequality, and the rise of artificial intelligence represent not new phenomena, but extensions of long-standing battles over resource control and social hierarchy. It introduces the concept of the “adaptive moral economy,” a theoretical model that blends innovation-driven capitalism with the ethical governance and social protection mechanisms found in traditional and socialist structures. This model emphasizes moral regulation, political stability, equitable wealth distribution, and community cohesion as necessary complements to market efficiency.

The analysis concludes that no single economic system can universally serve all nations; rather, the optimal structure is one that adapts to demographic realities, cultural norms, technological constraints, and moral values. In an era of rapid technological change and rising inequality, the manuscript argues that sustainable economic progress requires aligning innovation with justice, power with accountability, and growth with human dignity.

AI.tldr: 本文通过多学科视角分析经济体系的演变，提出"适应性道德经济"模型，强调创新驱动资本主义与伦理治理、社会保护机制的结合，认为最优经济结构需适应人口、文化、技术和道德现实。
AI.research_question: 经济体系如何从早期人类社会演变到现代复杂系统？什么样的经济结构能够在技术创新和社会正义之间取得平衡，以适应不同国家的现实条件？
AI.motivation: 现代政治极化、全球不平等和人工智能崛起反映了长期存在的资源控制和社会等级斗争，需要新的理论框架来理解经济体系的演变和设计更可持续的经济结构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多学科整合框架（经济史、政治经济学、社会学、道德哲学）；"适应性道德经济"理论模型；人类动机理论（地位、权力、安全）；经济体系演化理论。
AI.method: 历史比较分析；多学科文献综述；理论建模；概念分析；跨文化比较研究。
AI.findings: 1. 经济体系从基于生存和繁殖优势的早期社会演变到基于贸易、再分配和治理的结构化经济；2. 现代经济问题（极化、不平等、AI）是长期资源控制斗争的延伸；3. 没有单一经济体系适合所有国家；4. 适应性道德经济模型能平衡创新与正义、权力与问责、增长与尊严。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出"适应性道德经济"理论模型；2. 建立经济体系演变的多学科分析框架；3. 将人类基本动机（地位、权力、安全）与经济结构联系起来；4. 挑战经济体系普遍适用性的传统观念。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供设计适应性经济结构的指导原则；2. 强调道德监管、政治稳定、财富公平分配和社区凝聚的重要性；3. 为应对技术变革和不平等提供政策建议；4. 促进创新与正义、增长与尊严的平衡发展。
